title: Fahrzeug eines Medienunternehmens in Brand gesetzt
summary: A media company's vehicle was set on fire overnight on Knesebeckstraße and almost completely destroyed. The State Security unit is investigating a possible political motive for the arson.

title: Transporter-Fahrer nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 38-year-old van driver left the carriageway for unclear reasons on the A100 motorway tunnel and hit the wall and an emergency exit. He died later in hospital from his injuries, which he sustained on 8 November.

title: Hochschwangere Frau und ihre beiden Kinder wieder da
summary: A missing pregnant 23-year-old woman and her two young sons, who had left a residential group in Berlin-Buch, have been found safe and well. They were located in the Tempelhof district the previous evening.

title: Mutmaßliche Wohnungseinbrecher auf frischer Tat festgenommen
summary: Three men were caught in the act after neighbours heard noises from an apartment whose residents were on holiday; stolen gold jewellery was found on them. Police also seized a folding knife found at the scene.

title: Erstes Urteil gegen zwei Männer nach Schüssen in der Ebersstraße
summary: Two men were convicted on 10 November 2026 of attempted manslaughter over a March 2026 shooting of a 38-year-old man in Schöneberg; a third accused was acquitted. The verdict is not yet final.

title: Festnahmen nach versuchtem Totschlag – Sieben Personen in Untersuchungshaft
summary: Shots were fired at a 20-year-old man in Adlershof in the early morning; seven people have since been arrested and remain in custody on suspicion of attempted manslaughter. Investigations are ongoing.

title: Sachbeschädigung mit Nahost-Bezug
summary: White paint lettering with a Middle East reference was found on a pavement on Kottbusser Damm, placed directly below three Stolpersteine. Police removed the lettering and investigations continue.

title: Handtaschenraub mit Schusswaffe
summary: An unknown man threatened an elderly woman and her companion with a gun and took the woman's handbag, injuring the 78-year-old man. He fled on a rental bicycle.

title: Durchsuchungen wegen des Verdachts des illegalen Waffenbesitzes – Schusswaffen beschlagnahmt und eine Festnahme
summary: Police and prosecutors searched three properties in Spandau and Prenzlauer Berg over illegal weapons possession. Eight live firearms with ammunition were seized and a 28-year-old man was arrested.

title: Mann auf Parkplatz angefahren – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A hit-and-run driver struck a 75-year-old pedestrian on a supermarket car park in Hellersdorf and drove off. The pedestrian suffered bruises and fractures; police are seeking witnesses.

title: Farbschmierereien mit politischem Bezug
summary: Red paint with political slogans was sprayed on the facade of a district citizens' office in Kreuzberg overnight. The state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Tötungsdelikt zum Nachteil der 13-jährigen Lisa T. – Polizei sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen zu einem Fahrzeug
summary: A 13-year-old girl who disappeared on her way to school in Marzahn was found dead in a vacant building in Altglietzen on 8 November. Police are seeking witnesses regarding a Citroën C5 estate suspected to have been used in the crime.

title: Regenbogenflagge beschädigt – Staatsschutz ermittelt
summary: Unknown persons burned a hole into and bent the mount of a rainbow flag on a library forecourt in Schöneberg. The police state security unit is investigating.

title: Durchsuchungen wegen des Verdachts des gewerbsmäßigen Bandenbetrugs im Gesundheitswesen
summary: Searches at 14 residential and commercial premises in Berlin, Brandenburg and Saxony targeted six suspects over alleged gang fraud against statutory health insurers via an occupational therapy practice. The alleged damage exceeds 6.7 million euros, and cash, accounts and two vehicles were seized.

title: Mann mit Schussverletzung
summary: A 40-year-old man was shot in the leg in a residential building hallway in Schöneberg; unknown men fled. Police found two firearms and secured them.

title: Geldautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators blew up a cash machine in the vestibule of a supermarket in Sewanstraße at about 3:20 a.m. The explosion destroyed the machine and damaged windows and a neighbouring pharmacy; nobody was hurt.

title: Zigarettenautomat aufgesprengt – mehrere Fahrzeuge beschädigt
summary: A cigarette vending machine on Landsberger Allee in Marzahn was blown up overnight, damaging three parked vehicles nearby. Nobody was injured.

title: Zwei verletzte Seniorinnen nach Stürzen im Bus – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: An unknown car driver cut into the bus lane on Rhinstraße, forcing a BVG bus driver to brake hard. Two elderly passengers fell; one was taken to hospital with serious injuries, and police are seeking witnesses to the hit-and-run.

title: Mann in der Schlange einer Essensausgabe verhetzend beleidigt
summary: A 29-year-old man was racially insulted by a 35-year-old man while queuing at a charity meal distribution point in Charlottenburg. The Staatsschutz took over the investigation.

title: Mutmaßlichen Betäubungsmittellieferdienst nach Handyverstoß festgestellt
summary: Police stopped a driver after spotting a phone violation and found suspected cocaine portions, cash and a delivery-service flyer, leading to a drug-dealing investigation. The driver was detained and released after identity checks, and the car's owner faces an insurance-law charge.

title: Litfaßsäule einer Gedenkaktion beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons stuck stickers with a pro-Palestinian reference over the eyes of people on a memorial campaign advertising column in Siegfriedstraße, and the images were damaged when the stickers were removed. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation for criminal damage.

title: Verbotenes Kraftfahrzeugrennen endet mit Unfall
summary: An 18-year-old driver allegedly under the influence of drugs ran a red light at high speed during a police chase and crashed through a railing into the Landwehrkanal. Two passengers ended up in the canal; both were taken to hospital, one remaining as an inpatient.

title: Teenagerin bewusstlos geschlagen - Zeugenaufruf
summary: A man allegedly threatened a 17-year-old pedestrian with what appeared to be a firearm and struck her on the head with it, causing her to lose consciousness. Police are appealing for witnesses.

title: Schüsse auf Fahrschule
summary: Several bullet holes were found in the entrance door and facade of a driving school office in Wittenau. Nobody was hurt; the state police homicide-related task force BAO Ferrum has taken over the investigation.

title: Mann flüchtet nach Messerangriff zu Polizeikräften - Zwei Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: A 19-year-old man was stabbed and held by another man in Spandau and later flagged down a passing police car. Two suspects were arrested.

title: Raubüberfall mit Hammer
summary: Three unknown men attacked a 27-year-old man with a hammer on Simon-Dach-Straße and took his valuables. The victim was treated as an outpatient for leg and upper-body injuries.

title: Flagge der deutschen Einheit zu Boden geworfen
summary: A 22-year-old man climbed the national monument flagpole, threw the German unity flag to the ground and raised a Palestinian flag, with two other men assisting. The state security unit is investigating offences including insulting state symbols.

title: Verletzter nach Schussabgaben
summary: A 45-year-old man was shot in the leg after a verbal dispute with two unknown men in front of an apartment building entrance. The suspects fled toward Kantstraße.

title: Fußgänger nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: An 85-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car while crossing a road in Tegel on 27 October 2026 and later died in hospital. The driver was an 86-year-old motorist.

title: Durch Messerangriffe verletzte Männer
summary: Two men were stabbed in separate knife attacks near Schlesisches Tor in Kreuzberg overnight and early in the morning. Police are investigating whether the cases are connected.

title: Volksverhetzende Musik abgespielt
summary: Two teenagers were found playing inflammatory extremist music loudly in a park in Köpenick. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: In Brand gesetzt
summary: After a dispute following alleged sexual harassment, a 24-year-old allegedly doused an 18-year-old with a flammable liquid and set him on fire. The 18-year-old suffered burns and the suspect was arrested nearby.

title: Handyortung überführt mutmaßliche Taschendiebe
summary: A 27-year-old woman's mobile phone was stolen by pickpocketing on a tram near Warschauer Brücke; police located the phone and arrested two suspects. Investigations are ongoing.

title: Schnittverletzungen an Händen und einem Bein
summary: A 25-year-old man was found with multiple cut injuries to both hands and a leg after an altercation with an unknown man who allegedly had a knife-like object. The suspect fled by car, and the injured man was taken to hospital.

title: Überfall in Wohnung – Täterinnen flüchten mit Beute
summary: Two women forced their way into a 92-year-old man's flat, held him down and fled with property. The victim was hurt on the arms and taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Bildungs- und Kunstprojekt beschädigt
summary: A double-decker bus used as an education and art project on democracy was found damaged while parked at Olympischer Platz; windows and two doors were apparently damaged in the days before. Police assume a political motive and the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Verkehrsunfallflucht – Mann im Krankenhaus
summary: Overnight a collision between an Opel and a VW at a junction in Friedrichshain injured the 35-year-old Opel driver, who was taken to hospital. The VW driver fled the scene.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse wegen des Verdachts des bandenmäßigen Drogenhandels vollstreckt – vierzehn Festnahmen
summary: Police and prosecutors executed 28 search warrants in Berlin and Brandenburg against 20 suspects accused of commercial drug trafficking. Fourteen suspects were arrested, and drugs, cash, knives and a blank-firing gun were seized.

title: Bewaffneter Überfall auf Tankstelle
summary: A masked man threatened a 27-year-old gas station employee with a gun and took the cash register contents before fleeing. The register was recovered nearby.

title: Vermisster Senior verstorben
summary: A 74-year-old man reported missing since 3 November 2026 was found dead in Mitte today. Police see no indication of third-party involvement.

title: Mann durch Schüsse schwer verletzt
summary: A 22-year-old man was seriously injured by gunshots in Wedding on the evening before publication. Homicide investigators are looking into a suspected attempted killing.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit gestohlenem Motorrad und ohne Führerschein
summary: A motorcyclist was injured after colliding with a car while changing lanes in the morning. The unlicensed rider admitted drug use, and the stolen motorcycle was seized.

title: Polizist bestohlen - Festnahme
summary: An off-duty police officer caught a pickpocket who had opened his backpack in Schöneberg and detained him until more officers arrived. The suspect resisted arrest and was found with a pepper spray and a pocket knife, which were seized.

title: Politiker tot im Hotelzimmer aufgefunden – Todesermittlungsverfahren eingeleitet
summary: A man was found dead in a hotel room in Berlin-Mitte. A death investigation was opened by the prosecutor and the homicide unit to determine the cause and rule out third-party involvement.

title: Randalierende Frau verletzt Security-Mitarbeiter und zwei Polizeikräfte
summary: A 39-year-old woman entered a men's hostel without permission, threw glass bottles and struck a security guard with a road sign, then hit a police officer and injured an officer during arrest. The security guard and two police officers were hurt or attacked.

title: Schaufenster eingeschlagen und Schmuck entwendet
summary: Two masked people smashed a jewelry shop window with a shovel in the early morning and took jewelry before fleeing by car. The getaway car had stolen number plates.

title: Schuss auf Reifen eines flüchtenden Fahrzeugs
summary: A police officer fired a shot at the tyre of a car whose 44-year-old driver had fled a traffic check and endangered people. The driver and his 43-year-old passenger were arrested; nobody was injured.

title: Tierskulpturen im Großen Tiergarten beschmiert
summary: Two animal sculptures in the Großer Tiergarten were smeared with red paint containing hateful slogans. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Fanschal geraubt – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: An unknown suspect violently tore a football scarf from the neck of a 25-year-old on the platform of Residenzstraße subway station. Police published images and appealed for information.

title: Mutmaßlicher Räuber festgenommen
summary: A suspected robber was arrested after four robberies of shops and flower shops in Charlottenburg on the evening of 2 November. The first robbery, in Wilmersdorfer Straße, was attempted, and the suspect fled with cash from a later one in Pestalozzistraße.

title: Festnahme in Wohnung
summary: Two women were arrested at an 84-year-old woman's flat in Steglitz while trying to collect money from her in a suspected fraud scheme. The victim had reported the scam to police after initially handing over a large sum and her phone number.

title: Mann bei Angriff im Gesicht verletzt
summary: A 38-year-old man was punched in the face by an unknown attacker at Münsinger Park and fled. Police found his left cheek had been pierced and an ambulance took him to hospital.

title: Farbschmierereien mit politischem Hintergrund
summary: Several large graffiti were sprayed in a courtyard of a residential and commercial building in Kreuzberg. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Feuer in einem Café – Personen durch Rauchgase verletzt
summary: A fire broke out in the women's toilet of a café on Residenzstraße, causing smoke in the stairwell and forcing firefighters to open apartment doors. Two people were treated for smoke inhalation; police are investigating suspected attempted arson.

title: Raub auf Tankstelle
summary: Two masked men robbed a petrol station in Köpenick and took cash. One of them fired a shot from a suspected blank-firing gun at the ceiling during the robbery.

title: Schussabgabe auf Gewerbegelände
summary: Bullet holes were found in the roller door of a rented garage on a commercial site in Neukölln; shots were fired while no one was present. The case is being investigated by the BAO Ferrum unit of the LKA.

title: Polizeieinsatz nach Entfernung eines Patienten aus Rettungsstelle
summary: A 42-year-old man in a psychological crisis left a hospital emergency room and was found by police. He held a lighter, not a weapon, and was taken back to hospital for treatment.

title: Unbekannte werfen Steine auf Straßenbahnen
summary: Unknown persons threw stones at two trams in Marzahn, breaking windows. Passengers were in both trams but were not hurt.

title: Bilanzmeldung zum stadtweiten Einsatzgeschehen "Halloween"
summary: Police summary of Halloween night across Berlin: illegal fireworks, arson of bins and vehicles, thrown objects at police and buses, and 16 arrests. Incidents were spread over several districts.

title: Böller und Brandsatz in Kneipe geworfen
summary: Masked attackers threw an incendiary device and, about thirty minutes earlier, a pyrotechnic item into a pub in Neukölln. The device did not ignite, and nobody was injured.

title: Schüsse vor Restaurant
summary: Shots were fired from a vehicle outside a restaurant in the early morning after an earlier confrontation in which an employee was hit and threatened with a gun. No one inside was injured and the perpetrators fled.

title: Bürgerbüro beschmiert
summary: Paint graffiti was sprayed on the facade and windows of a citizens' office in Britz. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Schüsse auf Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: Shots were fired at an apartment building in Lankwitz overnight, leaving bullet holes in the front door and adjacent glass. Nobody was hurt; the State Criminal Police Office has taken over the investigation.

title: Queerfeindliche Straftaten – Streit im Fitnessstudio und Vorfall an einem Bahnhof
summary: Two anti-queer threat cases were reported: a 30-year-old was verbally abused and threatened with a raised hand in a gym in Wedding, and a 21-year-old was insulted and shown a folded knife near S-Bahnhof Landsberger Allee in Prenzlauer Berg. The Staatsschutz has taken over both investigations.

title: Senior fährt gegen Baum
summary: An 86-year-old driver lost consciousness on Spandauer Damm and crashed into a tree with his 85-year-old wife as passenger. Both were injured; the husband was admitted to hospital and the wife was treated as an outpatient.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach mutmaßlicher Trunkenheitsfahrt – zwei Frauen im Krankenhaus
summary: A driver with about 1.7 per mille alcohol crashed into another car on Alt-Friedrichsfelde after allegedly changing lanes at speed. Two women were injured and taken to hospital with head injuries.

title: Motorradfahrer nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus
summary: A motorcyclist was injured after a collision with a car at a junction on Gitschiner Straße in Kreuzberg. He was taken to hospital for treatment of a head injury.

title: Verhaltensauffällige Frau sticht einem Polizisten bei Widerstandshandlungen in den Arm
summary: A woman in a psychiatric emergency transport stabbed at a police officer's arm with a knife during an arrest in Prenzlauer Berg. The officer was treated in hospital as an outpatient and went off duty.

title: DEIG-Einsatz gegen Randalierer
summary: A 35-year-old man damaged parked cars with a wooden batten and threatened passers-by and police with a glass bottle. He was subdued after a Taser deployment had no effect and taken to a hospital.

title: Schwerer Raub auf Tankstelle
summary: Two unknown suspects threatened a 53-year-old gas station employee with a firearm and forced her to hand over the cash from the register. The suspects fled with the money.

title: Unfall zwischen Fahrrad und E-Scooter – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A cyclist aged 54 was hit head-on by an e-scooter that had ridden from the pavement onto the cycle path, and the e-scooter riders fled the scene. Police are asking witnesses to come forward.

title: Pyrotechnische Gegenstände und sogenannte Selbstlaborate beschlagnahmt
summary: Police searched a flat in Neukölln under explosives law and seized pyrotechnic items, self-made explosive preparations (about six kg net explosive mass), phones, a knuckle-duster and a knife. A 24-year-old suspect was provisionally arrested.

title: Farbschmiererei an Parteibüro
summary: Paint was smeared on a window frame of a party office in Hellersdorf. The state security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall in Mitte
summary: Shortly after midnight, a collision between a taxi and a car on Torstraße killed the 56-year-old taxi driver, who was trapped in the vehicle. The 38-year-old car driver, who was drunk, and his 29-year-old passenger were injured.

title: Einschusslöcher an Pkw festgestellt
summary: Bullet holes were found in a car parked in Obstallee in Staaken, reported by its 22-year-old driver. Nobody was hurt, and the vehicle was secured for forensic examination.

title: Polizist bei Verkehrsunfall von Regelungstonne geschleudert
summary: At a crossing with a failed traffic light, a car collided with another vehicle while police were directing traffic, throwing a police officer off a pedestal. The officer was taken to hospital.

title: Explosion auf Balkon eines Mehrfamilienhauses
summary: An explosion occurred on a balcony of an apartment building in Ullsteinstraße shortly after midnight, damaging the balcony and part of the flat. Nobody was injured; the State Criminal Police Office's explosives unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Mann durch Schüsse lebensgefährlich verletzt – Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: Unknown perpetrator fired several shots at a 31-year-old man in Lichtenrade, who was seriously wounded. A homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing.

title: Festnahme nach Schüssen auf ein Auto
summary: After a vehicle was forced off the road in Spandau, several men allegedly shot at the car and attacked its driver. Four suspects aged 21 to 31 were arrested, and the BMW driver was treated in hospital.

title: Autofahrer flüchtet vor Verkehrskontrolle – Polizeibeamter verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old driver fled a traffic check in Mariendorf, driving into bushes and a parked car and injuring an police officer who had climbed onto the hood. The driver was later found in a hospital, and he had no valid driving licence.

title: Autofahrer prallt gegen Baum und Lichtmast
summary: A 50-year-old driver left the road at night in Fennpfuhl, crashed into a tree and a light pole, and was seriously injured. The car was written off.

title: Festnahme nach Handel mit Pyrotechnik
summary: A youth was arrested for illegal sale of fireworks at Leipziger Straße and Axel-Springer-Straße; he sprayed pepper spray at officers and fled, and his flat was searched, seizing over 2,000 pyrotechnic items. Three passers-by and one officer suffered eye and airway irritation.

title: Lkw-Fahrerin fährt Fußgängerin um
summary: A truck turning right hit a 31-year-old pedestrian crossing Badstraße in Gesundbrunnen, who was seriously injured and run over in part. She was taken to hospital for emergency surgery.

title: Schuss durch Wohnungstür
summary: Shots were apparently fired at a closed apartment door in a residential building in Lankwitz overnight. A bullet hole, projectile and cartridge case were found, and nobody was hurt.

title: Geldautomat auf U-Bahnsteig gesprengt
summary: Two unknown men blew up a freestanding cash machine at Gneisenaustraße subway station in the early hours, after spraying surveillance cameras with paint. The station was closed to passengers during the investigation.

title: Stichverletzung nach körperlicher Auseinandersetzung
summary: After a physical altercation between two men on Tempelhofer Damm, one man, 24, was found with a stab wound to the upper body and taken to hospital. Police seized a knife found in a parked car nearby.

title: Ermittlungen nach mutmaßlichem Schuss auf Wohnungstür
summary: Bullet holes were found in an apartment door and a refrigerator behind it, with a cartridge case in the stairwell of an apartment building. Nobody was hurt.

title: Mann mit Messer verletzt – Festnahme
summary: A 47-year-old man allegedly stabbed a 42-year-old man in Oderberger Straße in Prenzlauer Berg on the evening before publication. The suspect was arrested in a nearby venue and the knife was seized.

title: Mit gestohlenem Roller vor Polizei geflüchtet - Festnahmen
summary: Police stopped two suspects on a stolen scooter, which fled and crashed into a police vehicle. Both suspects were arrested with minor injuries and later released.

title: Mutmaßlich antisemitisch motivierte Körperverletzung
summary: A 60-year-old Jewish man was attacked on a park bench in Schöneberg with antisemitic remarks and beaten, sustaining bruises and a cut. The state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Wohnungsbrand - toter Mann aufgefunden
summary: A fire broke out in a flat in Emmentaler Straße, Reinickendorf, and firefighters found the dead body of a 27-year-old male tenant. Police say there is no indication of third-party involvement so far, and the cause of death is still under investigation.

title: Einsatz nach Bedrohung endet mit Angriff auf Polizeibeamten
summary: After a hotel guest threatened hotel staff early in the morning, police were called. A 17-year-old hit an officer in the face with a beer can, and the officer was slightly injured.

title: Schussabgabe auf Bar
summary: Several shots were fired at the front window of a bar in Wilmersdorf around 6:30 a.m., damaging it. No one inside was injured, and cartridge casings were secured on the sidewalk and road.

title: Zwei Männer mit Messer verletzt
summary: Three unknown attackers were refused entry to a bar in Neukölln, attacked staff, and then stabbed two men who came to help. Both men were operated on, and the Kriminalpolizei is investigating.

title: Fahrzeuge durch Brand beschädigt
summary: A motorhome caught fire on Sonnenallee in Neukölln and two more vehicles were damaged by the flames. The street was closed for about an hour while the fire was extinguished.

title: Informationstafel zerkratzt – Sachbeschädigung mit antisemitischem Hintergrund
summary: An unknown person scratched an information board at a library entrance with a broken beer bottle and made antisemitic remarks. State security (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Zwei Festnahmen nach Graffiti-Schmiererei
summary: Police arrested two suspects after a group was seen spraying graffiti on subway cars on a siding between Kochstraße and Hallesches Tor stations overnight. Four others fled, and spray cans were seized.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe nach Flucht vor der Polizei beschlagnahmt
summary: After a police stop at a petrol station, a 20-year-old driver fled at high speed in a Kia during an illegal street race and was arrested. A loaded firearm was seized, and he was taken for a blood test.

title: Radfahrer verstorben
summary: A 71-year-old cyclist fell on Hansastraße in Weißensee and was seriously injured. He died in hospital the following morning.

title: Mann bei Auseinandersetzung im Straßenverkehr verletzt
summary: After a verbal dispute at a red light, two 20-year-old men allegedly punched a 25-year-old driver and sprayed irritant spray at him. Plainclothes officers arrested both suspects at the scene.

title: Auffahrunfall auf der Stadtautobahn – elf Verletzte
summary: A truck driver rear-ended a traffic jam on the A100 motorway in Tempelhof, causing a collision with eight other vehicles. Eleven people were injured.

title: Prävention im Fokus: Polizei Berlin lädt zur Sonderberatung am Tag des Einbruchschutzes am 25. Oktober 2026 ein
summary: Police and a carpentry guild invite the public to a free burglary prevention advice day on 25 October 2026 at the police headquarters. Security equipment will be shown and a window break-in test demonstrated.

title: Nachbarschaftsstreit in Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: A neighbour dispute in an apartment building in Britz escalated into threats, with one suspect allegedly wielding an axe-like object and another imitating loading a firearm. Two suspects were arrested, and police later searched their flats and seized weapons and prescription medication; two officers were hurt while taking a cat into protective custody.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Rollerfahrer verletzt
summary: A 56-year-old scooter rider was injured in a collision with a car turning from Rubensstraße onto Hauptstraße in Friedenau. The rider was taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Mann durch Stich ins Gesäß verletzt
summary: A 20-year-old man was stabbed in the buttock in the courtyard of a school in Donaustraße overnight. He was taken to hospital, and no suspects were found at the scene.

title: Messerangriff in Hellersdorf
summary: An 18-year-old young adult was stabbed with a knife by several unknown attackers in a park in Hellersdorf and taken to hospital. The suspects fled toward Hellersdorf U-Bahn station.

title: Gefährliche Körperverletzung im Straßenverkehr
summary: After a lane change in traffic, a van driver and passenger attacked a cyclist on Alexanderstraße, hitting him with a metal bar. The cyclist was injured in the arm and hand and the attackers fled.

title: Fußgänger bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A pedestrian aged 43 was hit by a car on Stralauer Straße after stepping into the road, and a second car then collided with the first. The pedestrian was taken to hospital with serious injuries, and the two occupants of the second car were treated at the scene.

title: Unbekannte Personen stehlen Fahrräder und flüchten vor der Polizei
summary: Several people stole bicycles from properties in Kladow and fled from police in a van, abandoning it with seven bikes inside. A woman in a nearby house lost consciousness during the search and was taken to hospital.

title: Flucht mit E-Scootern endet mit Festnahmen
summary: Two 15-year-olds fled from police on e-scooters at high speed, one repeatedly braking in front of the patrol car; both were detained. A 45-year-old father was pepper-sprayed after allegedly attacking officers, and was treated by paramedics.

title: An Bushaltestelle angefahren
summary: A 72-year-old woman was hit by the right mirror of a bus at a bus stop in Mariendorf and suffered fractures to her legs and hip. Investigations by the traffic unit are ongoing.

title: In Wohnung gewürgt – Täter flüchtet
summary: A 61-year-old man was allegedly strangled from behind in his apartment by an acquaintance, who fled after the victim grabbed a kitchen knife. The victim was hospitalized with head and shoulder injuries.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Flucht – Motorrad überschlägt sich
summary: A 17-year-old motorcyclist crashed after a collision with an Audi at a junction in Marzahn. The Audi driver fled the scene.

title: Fahrzeuge durch Brand beschädigt
summary: Several vehicles and a mobile lifting platform were damaged by a fire in Buckow, which a passer-by spotted at around 1:15 a.m. Nobody was hurt, and the arson unit of the LKA is investigating.

title: Versuchtes Tötungsdelikt – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Early on 17 October 2026, a group attacked a 28-year-old man outside a late-night shop on Oranienstraße, kicking and beating his head; he was left in life-threatening condition. Police are seeking witnesses and information on a dark car used by the suspects.

title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenkäufer leistet Widerstand und verletzt Polizeikräfte
summary: Plainclothes officers observed a suspected drug deal in Hakenfelde; the 57-year-old suspect threw away bags, struck and resisted arrest, injuring two officers. He was treated in hospital and released after identification measures.

title: Mutmaßlicher Wohnungseinbrecher festgenommen
summary: A 30-year-old suspect was arrested after two attempted break-ins into ground-floor flats on the same street in Britz. Both residents disturbed him and he fled, but was caught nearby.

title: Polizeiliche Maßnahmen wegen des Verdachts der Arzneimittelkriminalität
summary: Police searched a property in Naunynstraße, Kreuzberg, over suspected illegal trade in prescription medicines, finding medicines, narcotics, data carriers and cash. About 140 people gathered in a protest; no one was injured.

title: Beifahrerin ebenfalls im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: An 82-year-old driver collided with another car at a junction in Spandau; he and his 84-year-old wife died in hospital from their injuries. The other driver was unhurt.

title: Öffentlichkeitsfahndung nach gefährlicher Körperverletzung erfolgreich
summary: Two suspects allegedly insulted a 30-year-old man with homophobic remarks and beat him on a U6 platform; two 18-year-old suspects have since surrendered. Two bystanders were also allegedly hurt.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit drei Beteiligten
summary: A 36-year-old driver allegedly ran a red light at the Landsberger Allee/Weißenseer Weg junction and collided with another car and a cyclist. Three people were hurt, and the driver was found to have about 1.6 per mille alcohol and no valid driving licence.

title: Falscher Paketbote und Komplizen rauben Frau aus
summary: Three men gained entry to a 74-year-old woman's apartment by posing as a parcel courier, knocked her to the floor, threatened her and stole jewelry. The woman complained of neck pain but did not need medical treatment.

title: Motorradfahrerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car turning at a gap in the median strip collided with a motorcyclist, a 20-year-old woman, who braked and fell. She was taken to hospital with suspected spinal injury; the driver was unhurt.

title: Fußgängerin nach Zusammenstoß mit Auto verletzt
summary: A pedestrian crossing Berliner Straße was hit by a car after stepping in front of a bus, which braked hard to avoid a collision. The 25-year-old woman was seriously injured in one foot and taken to hospital.

title: Scheibe mit Stein eingeworfen
summary: Unknown persons threw a stone through the shop window of a coffee chain branch overnight. The State Security unit took over the investigation because a political motive is suspected.

title: Fußgängerin mit Gesichtsverletzungen in Krankenhaus gebracht
summary: A truck's wing mirror struck a 23-year-old pedestrian in the face while she crossed Heerstraße at a traffic light in Staaken. She was taken to hospital with a suspected facial fracture and brain injury.

title: Kind nach Unfall im Krankenhaus
summary: A car driver hit a four-year-old girl who allegedly ran onto the road in Rosenthal. The girl was taken to hospital with a suspected head injury.

title: 82-Jähriger nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: An 82-year-old driver collided with a car at a junction in Spandau and was seriously hurt. He died in hospital the following night, and his 84-year-old wife was also seriously injured.

title: Polizeibeamter bei Verkehrskontrolle angegriffen
summary: After a traffic check, a 20-year-old driver fled on foot and sprayed irritant spray into a police officer's face, injuring the officer. The suspect was arrested later in a garden plot and found with two irritant spray devices.

title: Erneut Schüsse auf Café
summary: Shots were fired at a closed café on Silbersteinstraße from a car around 5:40 a.m., leaving bullet holes in the shop window. Nobody was hurt.

title: Festnahmen nach Angriff auf Heranwachsende
summary: Two 18-year-old men were attacked by a group; one was stabbed in the back and the other was hit and robbed of his phone, bank card and music box. Two suspects were arrested nearby, and a third fled.

title: Mann mit Stichverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: A 24-year-old man was attacked by three unknown men near a bus stop and suffered stab wounds to his back and leg. He was taken to hospital and was not in mortal danger.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car driver hit a pedestrian crossing the Falkenberger Chaussee in Neu-Hohenschönhausen in the evening. The 47-year-old pedestrian, who had a breath alcohol reading of about 1.8 per mille, suffered a suspected head injury and was taken to hospital.

title: Kleinkrafträder gestohlen - Festnahmen
summary: Two teenagers were arrested in Johannisthal after police saw them riding a stolen scooter without helmets; a second stolen scooter was seized. Investigations are ongoing.

title: Schlag gegen mutmaßliche kriminelle Vereinigung – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse und Haftbefehle vollstreckt sowie Vermögenswerte in Millionenhöhe gesichert
summary: Police and prosecutors executed four arrest warrants and searches at 16 properties in Berlin and Brandenburg against a suspected criminal group accused of money laundering. Around 2 million euros in bank funds were frozen, along with cash, gold, a diamond, luxury watches and a Lamborghini.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Parteibüros – eine Festnahme
summary: Overnight, political posters were put up and property damaged at several party offices in Britz, Kreuzberg and Wilmersdorf. One 25-year-old woman was briefly detained and later released; the state security unit is investigating.

title: Verkehrsunfall – beim Fahrstreifenwechsel Motorradfahrer übersehen
summary: A car driver changing lanes on Heerstraße overlooked a motorcyclist, who was thrown to the road and injured. The 65-year-old was taken to hospital.

title: Mann bedroht Ehefrau und Kinder – Festnahme
summary: A 52-year-old man threatened to kill his wife and three children at a house in Altglienicke, and the family locked themselves in a bedroom. Special forces arrested him; he suffered a facial injury and was issued a restraining order.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Fahrerflucht – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A driver ran a red light on Kreuzbergstraße and crashed head-on into a waiting car, then the two occupants of the car fled on foot. The 47-year-old driver of the other car was injured and taken to hospital; police are appealing for witnesses.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Schüsse
summary: Several suspected bullet holes were found in the shop windows of a flower shop in Wilmersdorf, which had been damaged overnight. This is the second such incident at the shop, and nobody was hurt.

title: Brandstiftung auf Fahrbahn
summary: Unknown masked people set fire to e-scooters and debris in the middle of a road junction, damaging the road surface and a street lamp. The case has been taken over by the state security unit.

title: Schussabgabe eines Polizeibeamten
summary: After a reckless drive through central Berlin, police stopped a 40-year-old driver, who sped off again and was shot in the leg by an officer when he allegedly drove at a police officer. The man was then arrested and taken to hospital.

title: Verdacht der Beihilfe zum Computerbetrug – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse und Haftbefehle vollstreckt
summary: Berlin police, with Serbian authorities, executed search warrants and arrest warrants against suspects accused of aiding computer fraud via a spoofed-number VoIP service used in fake bank and police phone scams. Further searches took place in Berlin, Hesse and North Rhine-Westphalia, and the platform's infrastructure was seized.

title: Schüsse auf Café
summary: Several men are suspected of firing shots at a closed café in Neukölln overnight; bullet holes were found in a façade and shop window. Nobody was hurt, and a black car with several occupants was seen leaving at high speed.

title: Mutmaßlicher Einbrecher festgenommen
summary: A 39-year-old suspected burglar was arrested after breaking a shop window of a convenience store and leaving with stolen goods. Police found stolen items on him during a search.

title: Ermittlungen der BAO Ferrum nach mutmaßlicher Sprengstoffexplosion
summary: Overnight, a suspected explosive device went off at Stuttgarter Platz, damaging two vehicles, a third vehicle and apartment windows nearby. Nobody was hurt; the state criminal police's special commission BAO Ferrum took over the investigation.

title: Vorrichtungen zum Anbringen von versteckten Kameras entdeckt
summary: Witness found several suspected devices for mounting hidden cameras in women's toilets at a university campus; police seized them and found no cameras. Investigations are ongoing.

title: Festnahmen und Haftbefehle wegen mutmaßlichen schweren Bandendiebstahls
summary: Four men aged 21 to 28 were arrested in Britz for alleged gang theft of car rims; arrest warrants were issued and stolen tyre sets seized. Police said the investigation continues.

title: Auf gestohlenem Motorrad eingeschlafen - Festnahme
summary: Police arrested a 21-year-old man found asleep on a motorbike suspected of being stolen, with manipulated ignition. The motorcycle had reportedly been stolen in Gropiusstadt earlier in the week.

title: 3. Seniorensicherheitstag 2026 der Polizei Berlin
summary: Police announce the 3rd Senior Safety Day on 13 October 2026 with prevention events across Berlin, including reaction and eye tests, crime and traffic safety advice. The events are held at several locations.

title: Schussabgaben auf Einfamilienhaus
summary: Shots were fired in the Märkisches Viertel early in the morning, leaving bullet holes in a house façade. Two people reportedly fled in a vehicle, and nobody was injured.

title: Vermisste Frau wieder da
summary: A 38-year-old woman who went missing after leaving her hotel on the morning of 11 October 2026 has been found alive in a hospital. The police had earlier appealed for help in finding her.

title: Zeugenaufruf zu versuchtem Tötungsdelikt
summary: A 53-year-old man allegedly attacked a 40-year-old man with a knife-like object on a commercial site in Lichtenberg, seriously injuring him. The suspect later surrendered to police and was remanded in custody; the homicide unit appeals for witnesses.

title: 19-Jähriger von Unbekannten angegriffen
summary: A 19-year-old man was beaten and kicked by three unknown attackers in the early hours of Sunday and suffered a broken cheekbone. The suspects fled and the investigation is ongoing.

title: Seniorin um Bankkarte betrogen – Wer erkennt die Tatverdächtigen?
summary: A 66-year-old woman in Schöneberg was tricked by a caller posing as a bank employee into giving up her PIN and bank card, which were then used for unauthorised withdrawals. Police are searching for two unknown suspects.

title: Zwei gegen Einen
summary: Children aged 10, 12 and 7 were involved in a fight on a car park; a 10-year-old was kicked in the head and injured, and two women were hit or kicked when they detained the suspects.

title: Fahrer eines Leichtkraftrades bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A motorcycle rider and a car driver collided at a junction in Oberschöneweide after the car allegedly ran a red light. The motorcycle rider suffered leg fractures and a head laceration and was taken to hospital.

title: Stichverletzung im Oberkörper – lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: After a dispute, a 29-year-old man was repeatedly stabbed in the upper body by an unknown attacker in Neu-Hohenschönhausen; he was life-threateningly injured. A girl was also sprayed with pepper spray and suffered eye irritation.

title: Alkoholisierter Mann schlägt Nachbarn, greift Polizeibeamte an und leistet Widerstand bei Festnahme – DEIG-Einsatz
summary: A 44-year-old man struck his 40-year-old neighbour with a key ring in a residential building, then resisted arrest and was hit with a conducted energy device (DEIG) by police. Officers were unhurt; the couple were taken for blood tests and released.

title: Mann niedergeschlagen – lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: After a brief collision on the street, an 18-year-old punched a 49-year-old man in the face, knocking him unconscious; the man hit his head on the pavement and needed emergency surgery. The suspect was held by witnesses until police arrived.

title: Kind wird von Jugendgruppe bedroht und beraubt
summary: A group of four to six youths threatened a 13-year-old child with violence and robbed them of a small amount of cash and their jacket. The child was not physically injured.

title: Auseinandersetzung zwischen zwei Männergruppen
summary: Two groups of men fought outside a nightclub in Tiergarten, and about eight men beat and kicked a 29-year-old man lying on the ground until he lost consciousness. Five men were arrested and the victim was hospitalized.

title: Fahrradfahrerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 12-year-old girl on a bicycle was injured in a collision with a car at a junction on Tempelhofer Damm in the morning. She was taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Jugendlicher fährt gegen wartendes Auto und verletzt sich am Kopf
summary: A 17-year-old cyclist rode into the back of a waiting car at a junction in Alt-Hohenschönhausen and was injured in the head. The car's rear window was broken.

title: Mann durch Messerstiche verletzt
summary: An unknown man stabbed a 27-year-old man on Unionstraße in Moabit in the afternoon and fled. The victim was treated by witnesses and taken to hospital by rescue services.

title: Einsatzwagen der Polizei geriet ins Schlingern
summary: A police vehicle with emergency signals on, heading out of the city on the A111, lost control in the Flughafen Tegel tunnel, hit the left wall and was damaged beyond use. The crew was not injured.

title: Frau wird von Sattelzug angefahren und tödlich verletzt
summary: A 59-year-old woman was struck by a semi-trailer truck while crossing Holländerstraße in Wedding and died at the scene. The truck driver left the scene without stopping.

title: Aus mutmaßlich antisemitischen Gründen wiederholt beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: A 67-year-old shop owner in Kreuzberg was repeatedly insulted and attacked with pepper spray by several youths, apparently for anti-antisemitism posters in his shop window. The state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Schüsse auf Einfamilienhaus
summary: Shots were fired at a single-family house in Rudow in the early morning, and the perpetrator fled. Bullet holes were found in the glass front of the entrance door; nobody was hurt.

title: Seniorin betrogen – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?
summary: An 81-year-old woman was tricked by callers posing as bank and police officers; they entered her flat and took jewellery and coins, and cash was withdrawn with her stolen bank card at Hermannplatz. Police are seeking the unidentified suspects.

title: Autofahrer verursacht mehrere Verkehrsunfälle mit hohem Sachschaden
summary: A driver rear-ended a car, hit another and fled in Alt-Hohenschönhausen; minutes later he rear-ended a Renault in Weißensee, which caught fire and burned out, and crashed into parked cars. Two people were injured.

title: Bilanz zur Versammlungslage mit Bezug zum Nahostkonflikt vom 7. Oktober 2026
summary: Police summarized the policing of pro-Israeli and pro-Palestinian assemblies in Berlin on the third anniversary of the Hamas attack on Israel. A pro-Palestinian march was dissolved early after kicks at officers and antisemitic chants; 46 criminal investigations were opened.

title: Drei Fahrzeuge auf Parkplatz in Brand geraten
summary: Three vehicles caught fire on a public parking area in Alt-Hohenschönhausen overnight; two were completely burnt out. Nobody was hurt, and arson is suspected.

title: Radfahrer von Lkw-Fahrer angefahren
summary: A 79-year-old truck driver turned left on Franklinstraße and hit a cyclist, a 55-year-old, who was seriously injured. Police traffic investigators have taken over the case.

title: Versuchte schwere Brandstiftung
summary: Unknown attackers smashed a window of an apartment in Silbersteinstraße, threw in fireworks and set a mattress alight, and threw two liquid-filled bottles at the building. A 24-year-old in the room was hurt in the hand.

title: Einsatzkräfte mit Steinen und Pyrotechnik angegriffen
summary: Unknown people attacked police officers with stones and pyrotechnics after burning tyres and wood were set on Rigaer Straße overnight. One officer suffered an acoustic trauma and had to end their shift; the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Fußgänger verstorben
summary: An 85-year-old pedestrian struck by a reversing vehicle in Zehlendorf on 13 September has died in hospital. The driver, a 50-year-old, had reversed several metres to reach a passenger.

title: Nach Fund von Kameras in Damentoiletten – Durchsuchung bei Tatverdächtigem
summary: Police searched the flat of a 66-year-old man suspected of filming women in toilets at a university campus, after hidden cameras were found on 10 June 2026. The suspect was released after questioning and the investigation continues.

title: Kind fällt aus dem Fenster – Mann fängt es auf
summary: A six-year-old girl fell from a third-floor window of a shelter for homeless people in Neukölln and was caught by a resident. She suffered grazes and was taken to hospital for observation.

title: Seniorin angefahren und geflüchtet
summary: An unidentified e-scooter rider hit a 91-year-old woman waiting for a bus in Spandau and fled the scene. The woman was taken to hospital with a broken leg.

title: 18-Jähriger soll Reizgas in Schule versprüht haben
summary: A former pupil allegedly entered a school carrying a knife, a telescopic baton and pepper spray, and sprayed tear gas in the air. Nine pupils and four teachers were injured and taken to hospital or treated on site.

title: Durchsuchungen nach Messerangriff am Ottoplatz
summary: Three men were stabbed or cut in a fight between two groups at a park entrance in Moabit. Police later searched six residences and a café; several blank-firing guns and knives were seized.

title: Geldausgabeautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators blew up a freestanding cash machine inside a shopping centre in Biesdorf in the early morning. They took no money and fled without loot.

title: Mann durch Schuss ins Bein verletzt
summary: A 40-year-old man was shot in the leg at a café in Neukölln late at night. The attacker fled by car, and the investigation was taken over by a state police unit.

title: Senior vermisst – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: An 89-year-old man with dementia has been missing since 1 October 2026 after leaving a care home on a walk. Police are asking the public for information on his whereabouts.

title: Zwei Personen bei Auseinandersetzung zwischen Jugendgruppen verletzt
summary: Two young people were injured in a clash between youth groups in Altglienicke; one had multiple stab wounds. Police found a airsoft gun in a nearby cellar, and no real firearms.

title: Auseinandersetzungen nach Fußballspiel
summary: After a football match in Westend, about 30 away fans entered the home area and around 50 tried to reach home fans; police detained five men and used pepper spray when attacked. Two detained men were treated for eye irritation.

title: Schwere Brandstiftung
summary: Unknown perpetrators set objects on fire under power cables at a bridge in Boxberger Straße around 4 a.m. The cable sheathing was damaged and power supply briefly interrupted.

title: Kollision mit geparktem Pkw – E-Scooter-Fahrer verletzt
summary: An 18-year-old e-scooter rider collided with a parked car in Ruschestraße and was found injured on the ground. He was taken to hospital with suspected head injury.

title: Kind auf E-Scooter bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A car changed lanes on Geraer Ring in Marzahn and slowed down; a 12-year-old on an e-scooter collided with it and fell. The child was slightly injured and taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall erheblich verletzt
summary: A 24-year-old motorcyclist crashed into a curb in a hardware store car park on Landsberger Allee after speeding and braking hard, and was seriously injured. The motorcycle was overturned and no longer roadworthy.

title: Schussabgabe auf ein Restaurant
summary: Bullet holes were found in the window front of a restaurant in Moabit, and the owner alerted police. Nobody was inside during the shots, and the investigation into the background is ongoing.

title: Widerstand und tätlicher Angriff - Polizist bei Festnahme verletzt
summary: Police arrested a 20-year-old after he allegedly committed bodily injury; during the arrest and at the police station he resisted, kicking, headbutting and biting an officer who was injured and had to end his shift.

title: Reizstoff gesprüht – zwei Verletzte
summary: An unknown person sprayed irritant gas at an event outside in Hellersdorf, injuring a 17-year-old girl, and then at a 17-year-old boy who confronted him, who was also kicked. Both were treated as outpatients.

title: Auseinandersetzung im Hotel
summary: A group of about ten people attacked two men in a hotel stairwell, and one member threatened a 20-year-old with a weapon and a knife. Two 17-year-old guests were punched while the group fled, and three suspects were detained and later released.

title: Unbekannter Kradfahrer entzieht sich einer Verkehrskontrolle, fährt Einsatzwagen an und flüchtet
summary: An unknown motorcyclist fled a police traffic check at night, speeding through red lights and colliding with a police vehicle that had been positioned across the road. The rider escaped toward Henningsdorf, outside Berlin.

title: Einbruch in Einfamilienhaus – Ein Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: Three men were seen on the property of a single-family home in Lichterfelde and fled by car, crashing into three parked cars. One suspect, 31, was arrested after jewellery was reportedly stolen in a break-in.

title: Zwei fremdenfeindliche Angriffe
summary: Two incidents of xenophobic attacks were reported on the evening of 2 October: a woman wearing a headscarf was insulted and struck on the shoulder, and a 29-year-old man was racially insulted and punched in the face at a tram stop in Lichtenberg. The Staatsschutz took over both investigations.

title: DEIG-Einsatz – Festnahme nach Hausfriedensbruch, Sachbeschädigung und Widerstand gegen Vollstreckungsbeamte
summary: Police were called to a disturbed man on a residential roof in Zionskirchstraße, who entered an apartment under renovation, barricaded the door and resisted officers. He was arrested after a stun device was used, and faces charges of trespassing, property damage and resisting officers.

title: Gedenksteine mit Farbe besprüht – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 46-year-old man allegedly spray-painted several memorial stones laid in the pavement on Greifswalder Straße and was briefly detained. The Staatsschutz unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Messerangriff auf Jugendlichen
summary: After an argument, a man stabbed a 15-year-old boy several times with a knife in a park in Gesundbrunnen, then the group left the scene. The boy was taken to hospital with stab wounds to the buttocks.

title: Regenbogenbank im Großen Tiergarten beschmiert
summary: A rainbow memorial bench in the Großer Tiergarten was spray-painted black early in the morning, apparently in connection with an attack on the CSD. The state security unit took over the investigation.

title: Duo nach Diebstahl festgenommen
summary: Two men were arrested after a 20-year-old smashed a car window on Bernburger Straße and stole an item from the car, with a 44-year-old accomplice keeping watch. Police seized possible tools, phones, a knife and scissors.

title: Keine Straftat – Geplante Nachbeschriftungsarbeiten
summary: Graves in a cemetery were found smeared with black paint on 29 September. Police later determined the paint work was planned re-inscription by a stonemason firm, so no offence occurred.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit lebensbedrohlich verletztem E-Scooter-Fahrer
summary: An 18-year-old e-scooter rider was seriously injured after colliding with a car while crossing the road in Marzahn. The 73-year-old female driver was unhurt.

title: Unbekannte Person flüchtet nach Unfall mit vierjährigem Kind
summary: A four-year-old boy was hit by a van in Hellersdorf on the evening before publication, and the driver fled the scene. The boy was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: 20-Jährige bei E-Scooter-Unfall verletzt
summary: A 20-year-old on an e-scooter was seriously injured after colliding with a car driving in a bus lane near Tiergarten. The car driver, 27, was travelling towards Stülerstraße.

title: Rassistische Beleidigung und Körperverletzung – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 52-year-old woman allegedly punched a 24-year-old woman through a car window at a red light after a traffic dispute, insulting her racially, then followed her. The Staatsschutz is seeking witnesses and dashcam footage.

title: Glasflasche auf den Kopf geschlagen
summary: Shortly after midnight, a group of unknown men attacked three men aged 62 to 69 outside a snack bar, hitting one with a beer bottle and spraying them with pepper spray. Two of the victims needed hospital treatment for outpatient care.

title: Storno in Handfesseln – Räuberisch erpresste Fahrt endet mit vier Festnahmen
summary: A food delivery cyclist was robbed at knifepoint by a group of five youths and young adults, who took his phone and ordered a ride using his account. Four suspects were arrested after police stopped the ride, and the investigation was taken over by a specialist unit.

title: Rettungskräfte angegriffen und bespuckt
summary: An unknown man pushed, spat at and hit the emergency vehicle of a rescue team treating a 44-year-old man in Marzahn overnight. The emergency doctor was spat on and the attacker left the scene.

title: Senior nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus verstorben – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 78-year-old cyclist collided with a parked car on Kronprinzessinnenweg and fell, suffering serious head and upper-body injuries. He died in hospital the following night, and police are asking witnesses to come forward.

title: Auftaktveranstaltung der Präventionswoche „Taschendiebstahl“
summary: Joint police and federal police prevention week on pickpocketing kicks off with an event in Potsdam on 5 October 2026. The week runs until 9 October and gives practical protection tips.

title: Drei Tatverdächtige nach Wohnungseinbruch festgenommen
summary: Three men broke into an apartment in Lichtenrade, took jewelry and fled by car. Police arrested three suspects (aged 25, 27 and 37) nearby shortly after.

title: Fußgänger nach Zusammenstoß im Krankenhaus
summary: A 30-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car on Blumberger Damm shortly after midnight and suffered serious head injuries. He was taken to hospital and remained there.

title: Schüsse von Motorroller in Treptow-Köpenick
summary: Two unknown men on a motor scooter fired several shots at three men on a pavement in Baumschulenweg. Two of the men were hit in the legs and taken to hospital, and the third was unhurt.

title: 13-Jährige wieder da
summary: A 13-year-old girl who had been missing since 23 September 2026 has been found and is being cared for by youth services. The police had appealed for public help in the search.

title: Autofahrerin bei Verkehrsunfall lebensbedrohlich verletzt
summary: A 41-year-old woman driver crashed her car into a tree in Gatow after leaving the road and later died in hospital. Police traffic investigators are handling the case.

title: Leichnam aus Tegeler See geborgen – Mordkommission und Staatsanwaltschaft ermitteln
summary: A body was found floating in Lake Tegel and recovered by the fire brigade. An autopsy confirmed a homicide, and the Mordkommission is investigating.

title: Festnahme nach Einbruch in Bäckerei
summary: Two men broke into a bakery in Niederschönhausen overnight; one suspect (38) was arrested nearby and the second is at large. Burglary tools and a small amount of narcotics were seized.

title: Regenbogenbank erneut beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons damaged a rainbow memorial bench set up after the attack on the Berlin CSD, in the Großer Tiergarten. The bench had already been vandalised twice earlier in September; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Messerangriff verletzte Polizisten und Schussabgabe
summary: After a knife attack in a bar and an assault on police, three people released from custody were shot at from a passing vehicle on Perleberger Straße. One of them was hit in the leg.

title: 64-Jähriger wieder da
summary: A 64-year-old man missing since 10 September 2026 has been found safe at a petrol station in Brandenburg. The public search has ended.

title: Live-Einbruchversuch und Experten-Tipps: Polizei Berlin zeigt wirksame Sicherungstechnik am Tag des Einbruchschutzes am 25. Oktober 2026
summary: Police Berlin and the carpenters' guild invite the public to a burglary-prevention day on 25 October 2026, with a live break-in demonstration at 13:00. The event is held at the police headquarters foyer.

title: Mann mutmaßlich durch Messerstich verletzt
summary: A 30-year-old man was stabbed in the buttock with a knife after being pepper-sprayed by a group in a park in Britz. Two companions were also pepper-sprayed and suffered eye irritation.

title: Mann bei Auseinandersetzung verletzt - Zeugenaufruf
summary: A 28-year-old man was stabbed in the chest on the pavement outside a bar in Turmstraße late at night. The unknown attacker fled, and police are appealing for witnesses; the victim is not in mortal danger.

title: Flucht vor Polizeikontrolle endete mit Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 19-year-old driver fled a police check at high speed, ran red lights and crashed into a parked excavator and then a police vehicle. Nobody was injured; the driver had no valid licence and the license plates were stolen.

title: Auto vollständig ausgebrannt
summary: A BMW parked on Keplerstraße burned out in the early morning, damaging a Seat, a Toyota and a street tree. Arson is suspected, and no one was hurt.

title: Große Gruppe greift Trio an
summary: A group of 15 to 20 people attacked three young men in Zehlendorf, punching them and hitting one man's head against a parked car. Three victims were hurt, one of them stationary in hospital.

title: Heranwachsender mit Messer verletzt
summary: An 18-year-old was stabbed several times in a dispute with a group in a supermarket car park, and the group fled. A 13-year-old has been identified as a suspect.

title: Homophober Angriff
summary: A 31-year-old man and his 24-year-old companion were attacked by two unknown people on Viktoria-Luise-Platz in the early hours; one was punched in the face and suffered injuries to the jaw and teeth. The police Staatsschutz is investigating a possible homophobic motive.

title: Mann bei Raub mit Messer verletzt
summary: An unknown woman injured a 60-year-old man with a knife in Görlitzer Park around 0:30 and took his cash before fleeing. The man suffered a cut to the face and was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Bilanz zu einem Versammlungsgeschehen gegen die Wehrpflicht
summary: A demonstration of about 3,400 people against conscription in Mitte saw police-hostile chants, pyrotechnics from a library roof on Müllerstraße, and 16 temporary arrests. Eleven criminal complaints were filed, including for insult and property damage.

title: Späti ausgeraubt
summary: An unknown man threatened a convenience store employee with what was apparently a firearm and took cash from the register around 5:45 a.m. The 28-year-old employee was pushed to the ground and suffered a head injury.

title: 13-Jährige bei Unfall erheblich verletzt
summary: A car driver hit a 13-year-old girl who ran onto the road at a junction in Prenzlauer Berg overnight. The girl suffered multiple fractures and was taken to hospital.

title: Kinder auf Tretrollern angefahren
summary: Two ten-year-old boys on scooters were struck by a car while crossing Bergstraße in Steglitz. Both were injured and taken to hospital; the driver was unhurt.

title: Jugendlicher mit Schussverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: A 17-year-old was found with gunshot wounds on Düppelstraße in Steglitz after residents reported shots. The homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing; the teenager is out of mortal danger after emergency surgery.

title: Regenbogenbank im Großen Tiergarten erneut beschädigt
summary: A rainbow memorial bench in Großer Tiergarten, set up after the attack on the Berlin CSD, was damaged again, with a wooden slat removed. The State Security unit is investigating.

title: Allgemeinverfügung zur Kampfmittelbeseitigung am 30. September 2026
summary: Police issued a general order establishing a restricted zone from 30 September 2026 for explosive ordnance clearance in Brandenburg, extending into Berlin-Gatow. Entry to streets and buildings in the zone is prohibited and public transport is suspended.

title: Bauarbeiter bei Auseinandersetzungen verletzt
summary: Two construction workers were injured in attacks from a building during a multi-hour police operation at a construction site; a vigil crowd gathered and became agitated. The case was taken over by the state security unit.

title: Berlin startet mit KI-gestütztem Videoschutz
summary: Berlin police are launching a pilot project using AI-supported video surveillance at crime-burdened locations, starting at Kottbusser Tor with a configuration phase of about four weeks before test operation. Further sites planned include Warschauer Brücke, Alexanderplatz and Görlitzer Park/Wrangelkiez.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Feuer und Farbschmiererei
summary: Overnight, a 5 x 5 metre graffiti was found on a building facade and window front in Marktstraße, and a fire broke out inside the building, damaging office equipment. Nobody was hurt, and the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Versuchter Raub auf Motorrollerfahrerin – Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: Three young men attempted to rob a 43-year-old woman of her scooter key after spraying her with pepper spray in Neukölln. She fought back and called for help, and the suspects fled but were detained shortly after.

title: Mann kündigte Amoktat an – mehrere Waffen beschlagnahmt
summary: A 47-year-old man announced an "amok" attack at a bar in Marzahn and returned with a rifle. Police searched his flat afterwards and seized several replica guns and a revolver, but no live ammunition.

title: Überfall auf Hotel
summary: An armed man entered a hotel at night, sprayed the receptionist and a colleague with pepper spray and took money. The male employee was injured and treated in hospital.

title: Seniorin fährt Kind an
summary: An elderly driver hit a 13-year-old girl crossing Spandauer Damm in Westend, and the car ran over her. The girl suffered a leg fracture and the 92-year-old driver was treated and released.

title: BAO Ferrum und EG Telum: Stadtweite Durchsuchungsmaßnahmen zur Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität
summary: Police and prosecutors searched 14 properties and vehicles across six Berlin districts in an investigation into trafficking in semi-automatic firearms. Seven suspects were temporarily arrested and two live firearms with ammunition were seized.

title: Distanzelektroimpulsgerät eingesetzt
summary: Police used a Taser (DEIG) on a 20-year-old man in a psychiatric crisis at a hospital after he resisted treatment. He suffered minor facial injuries and was admitted to the psychiatric ward.

title: Festnahme nach Straßenraub
summary: A 29-year-old man allegedly punched two people on a park bench and took a backpack, then fled; one victim suffered minor injuries. He was arrested after police noticed him hiding a bag.

title: 14-jähriger E-Scooter-Fahrer flüchtet vor Verkehrskontrolle – Beamter setzt DEIG ein
summary: A 14-year-old e-scooter rider fled a speed check on Müggelheimer Damm, crashed, and was hit by a police taser (DEIG) during the foot pursuit. The boy was treated by paramedics as an outpatient and released to his father.

title: Nach Brand in Seniorenheim – Patient im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: A fire broke out in a Kreuzberg care home on 19 September, killing one 61-year-old resident. A 74-year-old resident who was seriously injured later died in hospital; police suspect negligent arson.

title: Frau bei Sturz in Linienbus lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: A bus departed from the Nikolaiviertel stop on Mühlendamm and an 84-year-old woman fell inside and hit her head on a handrail. She suffered life-threatening head injuries.

title: Unter Alkoholeinfluss – E-Scooter-Fahrerin fährt gegen wartendes Auto
summary: An e-scooter rider, about 1.3 per mille over the limit, crashed into a car waiting at a red light early in the morning. The 21-year-old rider was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 31-year-old driver speeding in a BMW lost control on the Bösebrücke in Prenzlauer Berg, went over the bridge railing onto the S-Bahn tracks below and died at the scene. Police are seeking witnesses and video material.

title: Ermittlungen nach Schussabgabe auf Wohnungsfenster
summary: A bullet hole was found in a double-glazed bedroom window of a flat in Britz, and a projectile was secured between the panes. Nobody was hurt; a specialist unit is investigating.

title: Allgemeinverfügung zum 52. Berlin-Marathon erlassen
summary: Police issued a temporary general order banning weapons and knives in a area of Mitte along the Berlin Marathon route on 26 and 27 September 2026, from 6am to 5pm each day. The ban also covers blank-firing, pepper and signal guns.

title: Überfall auf Geldtransporter – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Unknown suspects threatened a 38-year-old cash-transport driver with a weapon and took cash cassettes from the vehicle at the Virchow-Klinikum campus. The suspects fled in an anthracite Audi A3, and police are asking for witnesses.

title: Kind bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A four-year-old boy ran into the road between stationary cars and was hit by a car driven by a 19-year-old man. The child was seriously injured and taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall auf der Stadtautobahn verletzt
summary: A 32-year-old motorcyclist was injured after a collision with two cars while overtaking on the urban motorway (BAB 100) near the Alboinstraße exit. The motorway was closed in the northbound direction for about half an hour.

title: Raub mit Schusswaffe
summary: Five suspects robbed a 23-year-old man of cash and a phone after one of them held an apparent firearm to his head during a planned phone purchase. The suspects fled on foot in an unknown direction.

title: Koordinierte internationale Kontrollmaßnahmen in indischen Restaurants wegen des Verdachts des Menschenhandels zum Zwecke der Arbeitsausbeutung
summary: Coordinated international inspections of Indian restaurants in Berlin and other countries over suspected labour exploitation by a trafficking ring. Two main suspects were arrested in the Netherlands and 27 workers were checked at two Berlin restaurants.

title: Verdacht des bandenmäßigen Drogenhandels mit Waffen – vier Festnahmen
summary: Police observed a drug handover in Jessnerstraße on Friday evening and then searched several vehicles and homes, seizing about 2.7 kg of cocaine, around 900 g of ecstasy and other drugs, plus a firearm and 6,000 euros in cash. Four suspects were detained for identification and then released.

title: Mehrere Straftaten festgestellt – Polizeilicher Staatsschutz ermittelt
summary: Police removed graffiti including a swastika on a footpath in Blankenburg and found unconstitutional stickers on a car. A man and two imbiss workers were then threatened and insulted with xenophobic remarks; the Staatsschutz took over the investigation.

title: Festnahme nach Handel mit Arzneimitteln
summary: Police observed a bag handover for prescription medicines in Schöneberg and stopped the car afterwards, seizing the drugs, a loaded-magazine-less firearm with about 60 rounds of ammunition, and cash. The driver was arrested and both suspects were released after the measures.

title: Beraubt und durch Stiche verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old man was found with several stab wounds in Nogatstraße and said his phone and cap had been taken. He was taken to hospital; his life is not believed to be in danger.

title: Brand auf Schulgelände
summary: A fire broke out at a café building on a school grounds in Steglitz shortly before 6 p.m. and was extinguished by the fire brigade. A 49-year-old suspect was arrested on the site and handed over to arson investigators.

title: Raubüberfall auf Lokal
summary: Two youths entered a restaurant on Goebelstraße, one brandished a firearm and the other took a cash register. A 60-year-old customer was pushed and injured in the fall.

title: Unbekannter beschädigt Einsatzfahrzeug der Polizei
summary: During a street festival in Rosenthal, an unknown person threw a glass bottle at a parked police group vehicle, cracking the windscreen and damaging the interior mirror. Nobody was hurt.

title: Jugendliche nach mehreren mutmaßlichen Raubtaten im Mauerpark festgenommen
summary: Three youths threatened several teenagers with a baton and knuckle-duster in Mauerpark and took cash, a wallet and a bank card, forcing one to reveal his PIN. Two suspects aged 16 and 17 were arrested at the scene; the third is still being sought.

title: Mann nach schwerer Körperverletzung festgenommen
summary: After an argument, a 29-year-old man allegedly punched a 48-year-old man, who fell and was kicked in the head and lost consciousness. The suspect was arrested nearby and the victim was hospitalized with serious injuries.

title: Bedrohung mit Schusswaffe am U-Bahnhof Schönleinstraße
summary: A man allegedly loaded a firearm and held it to a passenger's head on a U8 train, without firing it. No one was hurt, and the suspect fled before police arrived.

title: Bedrohung mit Machete - Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: After an argument in an apartment, a 33-year-old man allegedly beat another man and threatened him with a machete before the victim fled. The suspect was later identified and arrested; both men were heavily intoxicated.

title: Polizeiliche Einsatzmaßnahmen an kriminalitätsbelasteten Orten
summary: Police carried out evening and night control and presence operations at crime-affected places in central Berlin, including Kottbusser Tor and Görlitzer Park. The most serious single case was a 25-year-old man who resisted arrest after suspected cannabis dealing near Görlitzer Bahnhof, slightly injuring an officer.

title: Polizisten mit Waffe bedroht - Wohnungsdurchsuchung
summary: Police called to a disturbance in an apartment building were threatened with a replica gun by a 38-year-old man, who resisted arrest. A search of his flat found further weapons, and the officers were unhurt.

title: Festnahme nach Brandstiftung an Wohnmobilen
summary: A motorhome caught fire on a car dealer's site and the flames spread to nine more motorhomes; a 21-year-old suspect was arrested nearby. Nobody was hurt.

title: Unbekannter schlägt Parteimitglied
summary: A man attacked a 36-year-old party member with punches to the face in an elevator of an apartment building where two party members were campaigning ahead of the Berlin state election. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Festnahmen nach Scheinankäufen
summary: Police carried out test purchases of illegal drugs in Köpenick, Friedrichsfelde and Alt-Hohenschönhausen and arrested three male sellers linked to a drug delivery service. Searches found cocaine, cannabis, ecstasy and amphetamine, and one suspect was remanded in custody.

title: Drogenerkennung im Straßenverkehr – Bilanz zu Schwerpunktkontrollen im Rahmen der 7. Berliner DiS-Tage
summary: Police report results of traffic checks on drug driving over 15-17 September 2026 at three Berlin locations, with 1,366 people checked and 68 blood tests ordered. Several drug and assault cases were recorded during the operation.

title: Aktionswoche zur Verkehrsunfallprävention von Seniorinnen und Senioren
summary: Berlin police announce a road safety prevention campaign for senior pedestrians on 21, 22, 23 and 25 September 2026 at four locations. The events include reaction tests, a traffic quiz and burglary prevention tips.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Beifahrerin im Krankenhaus
summary: A 29-year-old driver lost control after leaving the Grunertunnel, hit a curb, a bike rack and a tree, and the car rolled onto its roof. His 25-year-old passenger was taken to hospital for further checks.

title: Schussabgabe durch Polizeibeamten
summary: After a dispute, occupants of a car sprayed a police officer with irritant spray and the driver accelerated toward him. A police officer fired at a tyre of the car, which then drove off.

title: Körperverletzung und versuchter Raub – wer erkennt die Tatverdächtigen?
summary: Three unknown people surrounded a 30-year-old man on a U-Bahn station staircase, demanded money, and attacked him with a fist and a glass bottle when he refused; they fled without loot. Police are seeking public help with surveillance images.

title: Polizist bei Verkehrskontrolle angefahren
summary: During a traffic check in Reinickendorf, a driver accelerated and hit a police officer, who was lightly injured. The vehicle was later found abandoned and the 43-year-old owner was detained, with investigations ongoing.

title: Hotel überfallen
summary: Two young men armed with a firearm threatened a hotel receptionist and demanded money, then struck him and fled without taking anything. The 25-year-old was taken to hospital.

title: Homophober Angriff
summary: A 26-year-old man was attacked and robbed by several people at the S-Bahn station Landsberger Allee in Prenzlauer Berg after being asked about his sexual orientation. The Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Fußgängerin von Tram angefahren
summary: An 84-year-old woman was struck by a tram on Berliner Allee in Weißensee while crossing the tracks. She was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Farbschmierereien an Wahlkreisbüro
summary: Unknown perpetrators sprayed unconstitutional slogans and symbols on the windows of a party office. The state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Heranwachsende angegriffen - Polizei Berlin sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen
summary: Two unknown attackers assaulted a 19-year-old woman and a 19-year-old man in Jessnerstraße, causing bruises and cuts, while shouting far-right slogans. The State Security unit is seeking witnesses.

title: Attacke am Infostand
summary: A 32-year-old cyclist allegedly rode into a party information stand early in the morning, pushed a 61-year-old aside and threw campaign material on the ground. A 61-year-old volunteer was allegedly injured on the leg, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Overnight, two unidentified people knocked over a large election poster on Uhlandstraße and fled when police approached; the Staatsschutz is investigating. Several other election poster arsons in Berlin were reported in the same release.

title: Feuer in einem Fast-Food-Restaurant
summary: A fire broke out at a fast-food restaurant in Lichterfelde around 3 a.m. and caused property damage. No one was hurt, and the State Criminal Police Office's arson unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Kettenreaktion
summary: An 84-year-old woman lost control of her car in Marienfelde and hit several parked cars, causing a chain-reaction collision with an oncoming VW. The woman was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Polizeifahrzeug
summary: A civilian police vehicle with blue lights and siren collided at a junction in Tempelhof with a van driven by a 21-year-old. Two people were injured and treated as outpatients.

title: Frau an einem Informationsstand einer Partei angegriffen
summary: An unknown man threw two mobile phones at people at a party information stand in Schöneberg, hitting a 44-year-old woman in the leg, and then fled. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Abgeordneter an Partei-Infostand angegangen
summary: An unknown man verbally attacked a 40-year-old member of parliament at a party information stand, pushed him and shouted at him, then fled. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Angriff auf Geldtransporter – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe - Belohnung ausgelobt
summary: Unknown offenders attacked a cash-in-transit vehicle in a supermarket car park in Lankwitz and took cash and valuables. The van was later found abandoned near an S-Bahn underpass on Edenkobener Weg; police seek witnesses and offer a reward.

title: Schwerverletzte Radfahrerin durch Verkehrsunfall
