summary: A 39-year-old cyclist was seriously injured after colliding with a car door opened by a driver of a parked car on Lauenburger Straße. She fell to the ground and was taken to hospital.

title: Gegen einen Baum geprallt
summary: A 36-year-old driver veered off the road with a van in Buch around 3 a.m. and hit a tree. He was freed by rescue workers, suffered multiple fractures and internal injuries, and is not in mortal danger.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A truck pulled away from a junction and collided with a 42-year-old e-scooter rider crossing the road. The rider was taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: DEIG Einsatz nach Widerstand
summary: A 49-year-old woman carrying an axe in a weapons ban zone at Görlitzer Park attacked officers during a check and was subjected to a Taser (DEIG) use. She was released on site after identity checks; investigations are ongoing.

title: Vermisster Tourist wieder wohlbehalten bei Freunden
summary: A 31-year-old tourist reported missing on 14 September was found safe in Prenzlauer Berg. He had been taken to hospital in a helpless state on 13 September and was discharged the previous afternoon.

title: Großes Interesse am 45. Tag der offenen Tür der Polizei Berlin
summary: The Berlin police open day at the Polizeiakademie drew about 20,000 visitors. Two children aged eight and ten were hit in the legs by training ammunition fragments during a demonstration and taken to hospital as a precaution.

title: Vermisster Senior wieder im Kreise seiner Familie
summary: A 91-year-old man with advanced dementia, reported missing since 13 September 2026, was found safe by relatives in a green area near his home. Police had asked the public for help in the search.

title: Wahlplakat und E-Scooter angezündet
summary: An e-scooter and an election poster on it were set on fire on Berlichingenstraße in the evening. Nobody was hurt, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Mann durch Faustschlag verletzt
summary: A 42-year-old man was punched in the head after three people ran at him shortly after midnight in Schöneberg; police suspect a homophobic motive and the state security unit has taken over the case. The attackers fled and the victim was taken to hospital with an ear injury.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall mit BVG-Bus
summary: A BVG bus left the road and hit a tree in Britz at night, injuring 15 people. Seven of the injured were taken to hospital, and one passenger was freed by the fire brigade after being trapped.

title: Einsatzkräfte angegriffen
summary: Around 20 people set objects on fire and attacked police and fire crews with pyrotechnics at the Rigaer Straße/Liebigstraße crossing in Friedrichshain. One police officer suffered burns to the neck.

title: Autos in Flammen
summary: Several vehicles were set on fire in a car park on Nossener Straße in Hellersdorf overnight, with three cars burnt out and two more damaged. Nobody was hurt, and the LKA arson unit is investigating.

title: Antisemitischer Angriff
summary: A 43-year-old woman was insulted antisemitically and attacked with a broken glass bottle by two men on Torstraße in the early hours of 11 September 2026. The case was taken over by the state security unit.

title: Einbruch in Kunstauktionshaus
summary: Unknown perpetrators broke into an art auction house in Charlottenburg at about 2:30 a.m., smashing the entrance door and display cases and stealing antique cups and porcelain objects. The Landeskriminalamt art crime unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Schüsse auf Friseurgeschäft
summary: Shots were fired at a hairdressing shop on Tempelhofer Damm around 7 a.m., leaving bullet holes in shop windows. The unknown suspect fled in a vehicle, and nobody was reported injured.

title: Motorradfahrer nach Verkehrsunfall in stationärer Behandlung
summary: An elderly car driver allegedly ignored right of way at a junction in Rummelsburg, causing a collision with a motorcyclist who was injured and taken to hospital. The motorcyclist was found to lack a valid driving licence and the motorcycle was linked to a stolen plate and an embezzlement warrant.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 26-year-old driver turning left collided with a 61-year-old motorcyclist in Weißensee; the motorcyclist died later in hospital. The driver and his passenger were treated as outpatients.

title: Wahlplakate beschmiert - Festnahmen
summary: Four teenagers were detained after witnesses reported people defacing election posters with political slogans at a crossing in Pankow. The case is being handled by the State Security unit.

title: Abgeordneter bedroht
summary: A man allegedly threatened a 40-year-old politician at his information stand in the Hansaviertel and then ran off. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) is investigating.

title: Toter identifiziert
summary: A man died on 21 July 2026 in hospital after falling down stairs at S-Bahnhof Warschauer Straße on 19 July; he has now been identified and relatives have contacted police.

title: Polizei Berlin lädt zum 45. Tag der offenen Tür ein
summary: The Berlin police announce their 45th open day on Sunday, 13 September 2026, from 10 to 18 hours at their Spandau site. The event offers information stands, demonstrations, themed areas and recruitment information.

title: Klassenraum mit reizender Substanz besprüht
summary: An unknown person sprayed an irritant substance into a tenth-grade classroom at a secondary school, injuring 13 pupils and a teacher. The suspect fled and an animal repellent spray was found in the stairwell.

title: Waffe nach Verkehrsüberprüfung gefunden
summary: After a traffic check in Kreuzberg, police found suspected drugs on a 21-year-old e-scooter rider, who had fled and discarded a bag of suspected cannabis. A search of his apartment turned up suspected cocaine, cannabis and a firearm with a magazine and spare rounds, all seized.

title: Mann schießt auf mehrere geparkte Autos – Mehrere nicht scharfe Schusswaffen beschlagnahmt
summary: A man allegedly shot at several parked cars with an air-pressure weapon in Waidmannslust. Seven vehicles were damaged, and police later searched the suspect's flat and seized several replica and gas weapons.

title: Angriff auf Vollstreckungsbeamte – DEIG Einsatz
summary: A 45-year-old man in a forensic psychiatric hospital in Buch armed himself with a broken plate shard and threatened police, who used a distance electroshock device (DEIG) to subdue him. He was not injured.

title: 31 Verletzte nach Reizgaseinsatz in Jugendherberge
summary: Eight to ten unknown people stormed a youth hostel and an assailant sprayed pepper spray at a group of schoolchildren, leaving 31 people with eye and airway irritation. The attackers fled before police arrived.

title: Einsatzfahrt abgebrochen – Mann verletzt Mitarbeiter der Feuerwehr
summary: A car driver tailgated and obstructed an ambulance on an emergency run, then deliberately drove into a fire brigade paramedic who had stepped in front of the car. The paramedic was slightly injured in the knee.

title: Bronzeskulpturen entwendet – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: Three bronze sculptures were stolen from the garden of a clinic in Fuggerstraße between 25 and 26 August 2026. Police are asking for information on their whereabouts.

title: Baustellenbrand am Bundeskanzleramt
summary: Several small fires were set at a pedestrian protection tunnel at a construction site in front of the Federal Chancellery, and fire crews extinguished them. The Berlin LKA fire unit is investigating.

title: Queere Person angegriffen
summary: Two unknown suspects on an e-scooter allegedly approached and punched a 38-year-old queer person on Motzstraße in the evening. The victim suffered a facial injury and declined medical treatment; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Wahlplakate durch Feuer beschädigt
summary: Unknown people set election posters on several lampposts in Lichterfelde on fire in the early morning. Police and fire brigade extinguished them, and the state security unit is investigating.

title: Tötungsdelikt auf öffentlichem Straßenland – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 27-year-old man was fatally shot at the Planetenstraße/Sonnenallee crossing in Neukölln in the early hours of 7 September 2026. Police are seeking witnesses; the homicide unit is investigating.

title: Senior wieder da
summary: A 79-year-old man with dementia who had been missing since 4 September 2026 was found safe at a construction site on Hindenburgdamm and taken to a nearby emergency room. Police had earlier asked the public for help in finding him.

title: Rollerfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 53-year-old scooter rider was seriously injured after a collision with a van at a turning junction in Mariendorf, and the van driver left the scene. The rider is hospitalised but not in danger of his life.

title: Jugendlicher geschlagen und homophob beleidigt
summary: A 17-year-old was attacked from behind and knocked to the ground by an unknown person who insulted him in a homophobic way and fled. The teenager suffered head injuries and was taken to hospital; the state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Brand in einem Restaurant
summary: A fire was set in a restaurant on Schöneberger Straße in the early hours; the flames went out before police and fire crews arrived. Nobody was hurt, and the Landeskriminalamt fire unit is investigating suspected attempted aggravated arson.

title: Autofahrer fährt gegen Gebäudewand
summary: A 61-year-old driver of a transport service veered onto the pavement in Mitte and crashed into a museum wall. The driver and his 38-year-old passenger were seriously injured.

title: Vermisste 36-jährige Frau wieder da
summary: A 36-year-old woman reported missing after leaving a hospital in Mitte on 22 August 2026 has been found. She went to a hospital on her own and is receiving medical care.

title: Mann randaliert und verstirbt im Krankenhaus
summary: After his father called for help, police found a 36-year-old man in a mental crisis setting fire in a house in Marienfelde. He collapsed during restraint, died in hospital, and the homicide unit took over the investigation.

title: Schüsse auf Einfamilienhaus
summary: Shots were fired at a single-family house in Buckow in the early morning; bullet holes were found in the garden gate and damage to the glass facade and a shutter. Several people were inside, and no one was injured.

title: Vermisste 52-Jährige tot aufgefunden
summary: A 52-year-old woman reported missing since 30 August 2026 has been found dead. Police see no third-party involvement based on current knowledge.

title: Wahlplakate angezündet
summary: Two election posters attached to street lamps were set on fire overnight in Tegel. Nobody was hurt, and the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Transperson mit Schusswaffe bedroht
summary: An 18-year-old trans person was threatened with a gun by two unknown men at Mehringplatz after being asked about their gender identity. The case has been taken over by the State Security unit.

title: Mann durch Schuss verletzt – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 53-year-old man was found with a gunshot wound in a car parked on a pavement in Tempelhof and was taken to hospital, where he underwent emergency surgery. The homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing and seeking witnesses.

title: Zwölfjährige bei Unfall mit E-Scooter verletzt
summary: A car and an e-scooter collided at a crossing in Niederschönhausen, reportedly after the scooter rider crossed on red. A 12-year-old girl and her 38-year-old mother on the scooter were injured; the 73-year-old car driver was unhurt.

title: Gedenkbaum erheblich beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons badly damaged a memorial tree planted for the attack on the Berlin CSD, uprooting it and its protective grate overnight. The Staatsschutz is investigating the criminal damage.

title: Fünf Versammlungen vor dem Russischem Haus
summary: Five rival assemblies took place in front of the Russian House on Friday evening, largely without disruption. During the dispersal, a 63-year-old man and a 61-year-old woman were investigated for resisting officers and assaulting police; the woman and two officers were slightly injured.

title: Räuberische Erpressung
summary: Three masked people demanded a cash payment from a 24-year-old man, beat and kicked him when he could not pay, and demanded further money for the next day. The man had reportedly been forced to hand over money by the same people since 2023.

title: Versuchte räuberische Erpressung
summary: Two men allegedly demanded a mid-four-figure sum from a 23-year-old under threat of violence, and one grabbed his phone; the suspects were detained at a hair salon. The attempted extortion investigation is led by the criminal police.

title: Mann nach mutmaßlich homophober Beleidigung angegriffen
summary: A 20-year-old man was insulted in a suspected anti-gay attack and then beaten by an unknown man at Dorothea-Schlegel-Platz. The state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Mann mit Schreckschusswaffe beschossen
summary: Two unknown men in a car allegedly shot at a man with a blank-firing gun in Niederschönhausen around 1 a.m. The victim walked away before police arrived; the investigation is for dangerous bodily injury.

title: Schwerer Raub in Nachtklub
summary: A security employee of a nightclub allegedly forced a 22-year-old man and companion into an elevator, threatened him with what was apparently a firearm, and took a cigarette box from his jacket. No firearm was found during a police search of the club.

title: Autofahrer fährt Mann und Frau an
summary: A 43-year-old driver turned into Ostpreußendamm and hit two pedestrians at the junction with Müllerstraße. A 75-year-old woman died later in hospital and an 81-year-old man was slightly injured.

title: Mann verursacht mehrere Verkehrsunfälle und greift Polizeibeamten an
summary: A 47-year-old man caused several parked-car collisions in Buckow and fled the scene, suspected of being under the influence of alcohol. During his arrest he resisted officers and headbutted one, injuring the officer.

title: Beleidigung und Nötigung im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: A 38-year-old party member replacing election posters was insulted and then obstructed by an unknown man at the Schloßstraße/Grunewaldstraße crossing. The case is handled by the state security unit; she was unhurt.

title: Eierwürfe auf Informationsstand einer Partei
summary: A 23-year-old man threw raw eggs at a party's information stand in Heinersdorf, hitting a 74-year-old bystander on the leg without injuring him. The state security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Sicherstellung einer scharfen Schusswaffe in Spandau
summary: Police searched a flat in Wilhelmstadt in a drug-trafficking investigation and seized a live firearm with ammunition and prescription medicines. A 34-year-old suspect was arrested and remanded in custody.

title: Seniorin mit Bierflasche geschlagen
summary: An unknown woman struck an 87-year-old woman on the head with a full beer bottle on the U5 at Schillingstraße station. The victim suffered a bleeding head wound and was taken to hospital.

title: Fußgängerin bei Verkehrsunfall mit Lkw erheblich verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old pedestrian was seriously injured after being hit and run over by a truck on Blankenfelder Straße in Französisch Buchholz. The road was closed in both directions until about 11:30.

title: Mann droht während Fernsehinterview mit Einsatz einer Schusswaffe
summary: During a TV interview on Boxhagener Platz, a man on an e-scooter allegedly drew a firearm and pointed it at the interviewee, then fled. Nobody was reported injured.

title: Mann nach Wohnungsbrand leblos aufgefunden
summary: A fire broke out in a ground-floor flat in an apartment building in Wittenau overnight. A 55-year-old man was found unresponsive and died despite resuscitation attempts.

title: Raubüberfall vor Wohnhaus – Polizei sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen
summary: Three unknown men attacked a 40-year-old man with a knife in front of a residential building at night and stole his shoulder bag. The police are appealing for witnesses.

title: Neun scharfe Schusswaffen beschlagnahmt
summary: Police checked a 38-year-old man's van after suspected drug dealing and seized nine firearms from the vehicle and a garden plot in Baumschulenweg. The man resisted and faces weapons, drug and resisting-arrest investigations.

title: Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A nine-year-old girl ran from the pavement into the road and was hit by a car on Märkische Allee. She was taken to hospital with a head injury and abrasions, and is not believed to be in danger of her life.

title: Mann von unbekanntem Tatverdächtigen geschlagen und homophob beleidigt
summary: A 62-year-old man was insulted in a homophobic manner and punched in the face by an unknown suspect at Nollendorfplatz. He suffered a nose injury and was taken to hospital.

title: Mann beschädigt Wahlplakat, entblößt sich und leistet Widerstand bei Festnahme
summary: A 48-year-old man allegedly tore down an election poster, exposed himself to plainclothes federal criminal police officers and resisted arrest. He was taken to a detention facility on an existing arrest warrant.

title: Diebstahlserie aus Handwerkerfahrzeugen – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: Three men broke into parked vehicles and stole tools in a series of thefts from tradespeople's vans; two suspects were arrested after their getaway car was stopped. Police are seeking further affected vehicle owners.

title: Senior betrogen – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?
summary: An 87-year-old man was tricked by a caller posing as a hospital doctor into handing over jewelry and gold to a collector. Police are searching for the unidentified suspect via surveillance footage.

title: Verdacht des schweren Menschenhandels und des gewerbsmäßigen Einschleusens von Ausländern – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt
summary: Police and prosecutors executed 20 search warrants across eight Berlin districts in an investigation of suspected aggravated human trafficking and commercial smuggling of foreigners. Ten of 18 suspects were found; one officer was slightly injured when a suspect resisted.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin bei Kollision mit Lkw verletzt
summary: An e-scooter rider aged 27 was seriously injured in a collision with a truck at a junction in Kreuzberg, allegedly after entering on a red light. The Mehringbrücke was closed until about 15:30 for the accident investigation.

title: Mann von unbekannten Tätern mehrmals angeschossen und schwer verletzt
summary: A 26-year-old man was shot several times by unknown perpetrators from a group in Feurigstraße and was seriously injured. The homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing.

title: Junger Mann nach Gewalttat identifiziert
summary: A suspect who was identified after a 2025 subway assault punched a 48-year-old man in the face and head on a U8 train at Kottbusser Tor, causing a cut and abrasions. The suspect has now been identified by police.

title: Motorradfahrer nach Verkehrsunfall in intensivmedizinischer Behandlung
summary: A car driver turning left collided with a motorcyclist at the Köpenicker Landstraße junction with Baumschulenstraße. The 55-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured and treated in intensive care.

title: Seniorin bei Verkehrsunfall erheblich verletzt
summary: An 80-year-old pedestrian was seriously injured after being hit by a car on Mariendorfer Damm in Mariendorf. She was taken to hospital by ambulance.

title: Transperson verletzt und beleidigt
summary: An unknown man insulted and punched a transgender 18-year-old in front of a restaurant, then kicked her in the head while she lay on the ground; her 21-year-old companion was also insulted. The Staatsschutz took over the investigation.

title: Sicherstellung einer scharfen Schusswaffe und Sicherstellung von Vermögenswerten durch die BAO Ferrum im Zusammenhang mit Schussabgaben auf eine Wohnung
summary: Police and prosecutors seized a firearm, ammunition, cash and a high-value car in the investigation of shots fired at an apartment building in Ritterstraße in February 2026. Four suspects are in pre-trial detention.

title: Versuchtes Tötungsdelikt in einer Anwaltskanzlei
summary: A 51-year-old woman allegedly attacked a 46-year-old woman in a law office, leaving her with life-threatening injuries. The suspect was arrested and the case is being investigated as an attempted homicide.

title: Festnahme nach Einbruch in Auto
summary: A man broke into a car in Schönholzer Straße and took a backpack. A 29-year-old suspect was arrested nearby and is to be brought before a judge for an arrest warrant.

title: Regenbogenbank im Großen Tiergarten beschädigt
summary: A rainbow memorial bench set up after an attack on the Berlin CSD was badly damaged in the Großer Tiergarten. The Staatsschutz is investigating the property damage.

title: Sprengung auf dem Sprengplatz Grunewald
summary: Police will detonate a World War II bomb found and defused last week at the Grunewald demolition site on 3 September 2026, with a 500-metre safety zone during the blast window of 10:00 to 13:00. Residents inside the zone will be asked to leave, and the AVUS and rail traffic are not affected.

title: Autofahrer fährt Fußgängerin an
summary: A car turning left collided with an 86-year-old pedestrian crossing at a zebra crossing in Wilhelmsruh. The pedestrian fell, was injured in the head and taken to hospital.

title: Politiker antisemitisch beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: A 28-year-old election candidate was antisemitically insulted and an attempted punch was thrown at him outside a supermarket. The Staatsschutz took over the investigation; a 68-year-old man has been identified.

title: Ermittlungen der BAO Ferrum: Vollstreckung eines Haftbefehls in Nordrhein-Westfalen und Sicherstellung von Vermögenswerten
summary: Police arrested a 42-year-old suspect in Hamm (North Rhine-Westphalia) on a warrant from the BAO Ferrum investigation into a group suspected of shootings and extortion of businesses. Assets worth roughly several hundred thousand euros, including vehicles, cash and precious metals, have been secured.

title: DEIG-Einsatz nach Widerstand - Festnahme
summary: A 40-year-old man behaving aggressively at a garden colony event insulted officers and resisted arrest; officers used a taser (DEIG) to subdue him. He was unhurt and taken into custody.

title: Fußgänger bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A 25-year-old driver changed lanes into a bus lane and hit a 20-year-old pedestrian crossing the road at night. The pedestrian was thrown into the air and taken to hospital with head injuries.

title: Schüsse in Fußgängerzone
summary: Shots were fired in the pedestrian zone of Steinmetzstraße in Schöneberg before 5 a.m., and a small car was seen leaving at high speed. Two windows in separate flats were hit by bullets, and nobody was injured.

title: Unfall mit verletzter Person und fünf beschädigten Autos
summary: An 84-year-old woman driving at excessive speed crashed into parked cars on Segelfliegerdamm in Johannisthal and her car overturned onto its roof. She was taken to hospital with leg injuries and four parked cars were damaged.

title: Fremdenfeindlicher Angriff - Festnahme
summary: A 42-year-old man attacked passers-by at Ostkreuz station and then assaulted a 25-year-old on the road, shouting xenophobic remarks; Federal Police arrested him. The Staatsschutz took over the case.

title: Sachbeschädigungen durch Farbschmierereien
summary: Unknown perpetrators sprayed 18 politically themed graffiti on house facades and a supermarket in Tempelhof between 26 and 27 August 2026. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Verstoß gegen das Sprengstoffgesetz - Festnahme
summary: Police arrested a 37-year-old man at a street junction in Köpenick after finding an improvised explosive and incendiary device in his backpack. The device was neutralised and the state security unit took over the investigation.

title: Von Personengruppe geschlagen und beleidigt
summary: A group of seven attacked two women at Kaulsdorf U-Bahn station after they declined to talk, injuring one woman, and a 46-year-old passerby who intervened was hit in the face with a beer bottle. The group fled.

title: Mit Drogen vor der Polizei geflüchtet - Festnahme
summary: After a traffic stop attempt, police arrested a 37-year-old man who had fled on foot and discarded a bag. Around one kilogram of suspected cocaine and cash were found, and the man faces a custody hearing.

title: Unfallflucht nach Zusammenstoß mit zweijährigem Jungen
summary: A hit-and-run driver struck a two-year-old boy crossing the Geraer Ring in Marzahn, then reversed into a waiting truck and fled. The boy was taken to hospital with injuries to arms, legs and head.

title: Motorradfahrer erlag seinen Verletzungen und verstarb
summary: A 34-year-old motorcyclist crashed into a median barrier on the A 111 motorway after accelerating hard and losing control; he later died in hospital. The car driver was unhurt.

title: Einer Polizeikontrolle entzogen und Unfall verursacht
summary: A 17-year-old unhelmeted motorcyclist fled a police traffic check at high speed, crashed into a street lamp and was seriously injured in Mariendorf. The incident closed Britzer Straße for about five hours.

title: BAO Ferrum und EG Telum: Durchsuchungsmaßnahmen zur Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität
summary: Police searched four properties in Kreuzberg and Neukölln over a weapons law violation, seizing a loaded pistol, ammunition and an alarm/signal weapon. Four suspects aged 19 to 35 are being investigated.

title: Allgemeinverfügung erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Mitte
summary: General order (Allgemeinverfügung) with security measures and traffic closures in the government district around the Tiergarten on 1 September 2026, for a commemoration of the German invasion of Poland. Entry is limited to residents and authorised persons, and parking is banned in the area.

title: Trickdiebstahl in Wohnungen - Festnahmen und Durchsuchungen
summary: Two men posing as water-damage workers entered an 83-year-old woman's flat in Pankow and left without loot; three suspects were arrested and a gang of distraction thieves is under investigation.

title: Zehnjähriger geschlagen und homophob beleidigt
summary: A ten-year-old boy was insulted with homophobic remarks and kicked and choked by a classmate during a break at a school in Tiergarten. He was hurt on the neck, and the State Security unit was informed.

title: Schlägerei nach Streitigkeiten
summary: Several suspects beat and insulted a 26-year-old kiosk worker after he tried to close the snack bar, and a passerby was also drawn into the fight. Three suspects were arrested.

title: Wohnwagen und Pkw in Flammen
summary: Overnight, a caravan caught fire in Kiefholzstraße and the flames spread to two parked cars, which burned out completely. Four more vehicles, two trees and a street lamp were damaged, and nobody was injured; the LKA arson unit is investigating.

title: Mutmaßliche Einbrecher festgenommen
summary: Two masked men were caught in a residential building in Schöneberg after a resident alerted police to noises in the stairwell. Fresh break-in marks and suspected burglary tools were found at an apartment door; the two suspects, aged 19 and 20, were detained and later released.

title: Festnahmen nach Schockanruf
summary: Two suspects were arrested in Rudow while collecting cash and gold from a 91-year-old man after a fake accident call demanding bail. The caller had threatened the man's daughter.

title: Festnahmen nach Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten
summary: Overnight, several incidents of damage to election posters across Berlin were reported, with the state security unit investigating. Suspects were identified or arrested at several locations, and at least one was taken to a hospital.

title: Gemeinsam für mehr Sicherheit am Berliner Hauptbahnhof und Ostbahnhof
summary: Police, Bundespolizei, DB Sicherheit and district public order offices launched joint patrols at Berlin Hauptbahnhof and Ostbahnhof to increase presence and security. The announcement is a general information notice with no specific incident reported.

title: Parteibüro mit Fäkalien beschmiert
summary: Feces were smeared on the lock and handle of a political party office in Johannisthal. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Geschäftsstelle einer Partei beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons damaged the lock of a party office door in Johannisthal with adhesive, preventing it from being opened. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: „Sichtbar mobil zur Schule" – Verkehrssicherheits-Aktionstag zum Schulanfang in der STATION Berlin
summary: Berlin police and authorities held a road safety action day at STATION Berlin to mark the start of the school year, urging drivers to take care around schoolchildren. No incident occurred.

title: Zwei Personen bei Angriff verletzt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 17-year-old suspect allegedly sprayed a 28-year-old man and a 28-year-old woman with pepper spray, then injured the man with a pointed object. Two people were hurt and the suspect was arrested shortly afterwards.

title: Mann nach Stichverletzung im Krankenhaus
summary: A 53-year-old man was stabbed in the chest in Bülowstraße around midnight by an unknown assailant who then fled. The victim was taken to hospital in life-threatening condition and underwent emergency surgery.

title: 19-Jähriger leblos aufgefunden
summary: A 19-year-old man reported missing since 11 August 2026 was found dead. Police see no indication of third-party involvement.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin fährt Fußgängerin an
summary: A 15-year-old riding an e-scooter with a 16-year-old passenger collided with a 30-year-old pedestrian on Alexanderplatz. Three people were slightly or moderately hurt, and the scooter was seized over a suspected speed manipulation.

title: Zwei Männer bei körperlichem Angriff verletzt
summary: Two men were attacked by an unknown group after a verbal dispute in Schöneberg; one was pepper-sprayed and suffered head injuries and lost teeth. The group fled and the investigation was taken over by a specialist unit.

title: Radfahrerin bei Unfall erheblich verletzt
summary: A van driver allegedly ran a red light at Danziger Straße and hit a 74-year-old cyclist, who suffered serious head and face injuries. Traffic investigators have taken over the case.

title: Autofahrer fährt Motorradfahrer an
summary: A car turning left collided with a motorcyclist in Wilmersdorf who was allegedly speeding. The 24-year-old motorcyclist was injured and had no driving licence; the motorcycle was reported stolen and seized.

title: Wohnungsraub mit Schusswaffen
summary: Two masked men forced their way into a 73-year-old man's apartment, demanded valuables and searched the flat while armed with what were reportedly firearms. The victim was not hurt.

title: Schussabgaben auf Geschäft
summary: Shots were fired at a shop in Lichterfelde around 3:55 a.m., leaving bullet holes in the shop windows. An unexploded explosive device was also found and seized by police.

title: Mehrere Fahrzeuge durch Feuer beschädigt
summary: Five vehicles were damaged by fire in a car park in Falkenhagener Feld overnight; four burned out completely. Nobody was injured, and the Landeskriminalamt fire investigation unit has taken over the case.

title: Tote Frau gefunden – Polizei und Staatsanwaltschaft bitten um Mithilfe
summary: A 46-year-old woman was found dead in bushes near the Zeiss-Großplanetarium in Prenzlauer Berg; homicide investigators suspect a killing. Police and prosecutors are appealing to the public for information.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Radfahrer und Fußgängerin
summary: A 53-year-old cyclist collided with an 18-year-old pedestrian who entered the cycle lane on Schlesische Straße at night. Both fell to the ground; the cyclist was hospitalised with serious injuries.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Several election-poster vandalism incidents were reported across Berlin on the night before publication, handled by the State Security unit. In one case a man set fire to a campaign poster on a street lamp in Charlottenburg-Nord and kicked the lamp.

title: Mann geschlagen und rassistisch beleidigt
summary: A 57-year-old man allegedly punched a 36-year-old man several times in the face at Boxhagener Platz, then insulted him racially. The Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Mit Gullydeckel in Supermarkt eingebrochen
summary: Two unknown men broke into a supermarket on Königin-Luise-Straße in Dahlem using a manhole cover and stole large quantities of tobacco products. They fled before police arrived.

title: Mann mit Cuttermesser verletzt
summary: After a conversation on a U8 platform, a 39-year-old man allegedly injured a 37-year-old with a cutter knife after the latter said he was pro-Israel. The case was taken over by the state security unit.

title: Fremdenfeindlich beleidigt und geschlagen
summary: After a verbal dispute on a tram, a 42-year-old woman and her 17-year-old daughter allegedly insulted a 52-year-old woman in a xenophobic way and the daughter punched her in the head. The state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Wahlplakate in Brand gesetzt
summary: Two men aged 24 and 26 allegedly threw flammable objects at election posters on Falkenseer Damm and Falkenseer Platz, damaging both; the Staatsschutz is investigating. The suspects were arrested and released after identity checks.

title: Schutzscheibe in Linienbus eingeschlagen
summary: An unknown man boarded a bus on line 165 at S-Plänterwald after midnight and smashed the protective screen to the driver's area with a tool after being asked to leave. The driver was not hurt.

title: Rad- und Motorrollerfahrer kollidieren – beide im Krankenhaus
summary: A cyclist and a moped scooter rider collided on Köpenicker Chaussee while both were turning or travelling in the same direction, and both fell. Both men were taken to hospital with injuries.

title: Frau nach religionsfeindlicher Beleidigung mit Glasflasche angegriffen
summary: A 36-year-old woman wearing a headscarf was insulted on religious grounds on a tram and then struck on the head with a glass bottle by an unknown man at a pedestrian crossing. She was taken to hospital; the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Mann schießt vom Balkon – Festnahme durch SEK
summary: A 45-year-old man fired several shots from a balcony in Mariendorf and was arrested by a special unit after police forced entry to his flat. A starter pistol and ammunition were seized; nobody was hurt.

title: Gesuchter Vermisster wieder untergebracht
summary: A 20-year-old missing man, who had been reported as a potential danger to others, was found and taken into custody in Friedrichshain and returned to hospital care. The earlier appeal concerned a man who had gone missing from a psychiatric ward on Dieffenbachstraße.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Multiple incidents of damaged, removed and burned election posters across Berlin were reported in the day and night before the House of Representatives election. The Staatsschutz is investigating all cases; one 35-year-old man admitted setting a poster on fire.

title: Mann mit Messer angegriffen – Ermittlungen zu einem versuchten Tötungsdelikt
summary: A 33-year-old man was stabbed in the leg in a suspected attempted killing in Neukölln after a dispute escalated. Public order employees intervened, and the 38-year-old suspect was arrested the following day.

title: Brandstiftung an einem Späti
summary: An unknown masked person threw an incendiary device at a convenience store in Wedding overnight. The device bounced off the awning and set a parked car on fire, damaging it; nobody was hurt.

title: Mann von mehreren Personen beraubt
summary: A 40-year-old man was attacked and robbed of his wallet and smartphone by four unknown people in the early hours. He was punched in the face and suffered rib injuries that did not need medical treatment.

title: Aktionswoche zum Waffen- und Messerverbot im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr
summary: Police and Federal Police announce a citywide action week from 24 to 28 August 2026 enforcing the weapons and knife ban on public transport. Checks will be carried out with support from BVG staff.

title: BAO Ferrum und EG Telum: Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität – Festnahmen wegen versuchten Mordes, Erpressung und des Verstoßes gegen das Waffengesetz
summary: Police arrested a 21-year-old suspected of shooting at a café window in Neukölln in April 2026, linked to a protection-money demand, and seized two firearms during raids at seven addresses. The attempted murder suspect was brought before an investigating judge and remanded in custody.

title: Kind von Erwachsenen geschlagen
summary: A 13-year-old boy was pushed off his bicycle, dragged along the asphalt and hit with slippers by adults after an argument with a 10-year-old. He was treated at the scene for arm injuries.

title: Senior bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An 82-year-old scooter rider was seriously injured after colliding with a car while changing lanes on Gutschmidtstraße. The car driver was unhurt.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Several election posters were damaged in Berlin on the day before the publication, including one set on fire on a lamppost in Schöneberg. The Staatsschutz is investigating all cases linked to the House of Representatives election.

title: Festnahmen nach versuchtem Trickdiebstahl
summary: Two women, 19 and 28, allegedly gained entry to an 84-year-old woman's flat posing as care workers in an attempted distraction theft. They were arrested on the spot and later released after identification measures.

title: Regenbogenflagge beschädigt
summary: A rainbow flag and its lighting equipment were damaged in the Hansaviertel area. The state security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Radfahrer nach Unfall mit Autotür verletzt
summary: A passenger opening a car door in Herzbergstraße caused a collision with a passing cyclist, who was injured. The passenger fled the scene on foot and remains unidentified.

title: 18-Jähriger mit Schusswaffe bedroht und ausgeraubt
summary: After an argument, an 18-year-old was threatened with a gun, knife and pepper spray, tied up and forced to hand over a sum of cash in an apartment in Florastraße. He managed to flee and alert police.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Several incidents of damage to election posters across Berlin on the evening and night before the state parliament election were reported; the Staatsschutz is investigating. One suspect was arrested after a man struck posters with a pole, and a poster bearing a Nazi symbol was found in Weißensee.

title: Vermisster Demenzkranker wohlbehalten im Krankenhaus
summary: A 65-year-old man with dementia who went missing on 16 August 2026 was found safe in a hospital. Hospital staff recognised him after the fire service brought him in, and police were alerted.

title: Touristin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 72-year-old tourist stepped onto a bike lane in Prenzlauer Berg and collided with an e-scooter rider, both falling. The tourist suffered a foot injury and was taken to hospital; the rider was unhurt.

title: Festnahmen nach Trickdiebstahl in Wohnung
summary: Two suspects posing as telecom workers allegedly stole jewellery and cash from a 92-year-old woman's flat in Frankfurt Allee. Both were arrested in Charlottenburg, and the stolen goods were seized during a search.

title: Mahnmal beschmiert
summary: Unknown persons sprayed paint on the Deportation Memorial at Putlitzbrücke, damaging it. The state security unit (Staatsschutz) is investigating.

title: Autofahrerin bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A 21-year-old woman lost control of her car in Friedrichshagen, hit a tree and overturned. She was injured and taken to hospital; the car was seized.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an und Diebstahl von Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Election posters were torn down from a lamp post and damaged, with a sticker added to one. Police Staatsschutz is investigating; the case is linked to the Berlin state election. Separately, two teenagers were caught trying to steal election posters in Zehlendorf.

title: Erheblich verletzter Radfahrer
summary: A 47-year-old cyclist hit an opened car door on Albrechtstraße, fell and was seriously injured. He was taken to hospital by paramedics.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Schussabgabe
summary: Several gunshots were heard overnight on Johannisthaler Chaussee in Rudow, and a bullet hole was later found in a parked car. Nobody was reported injured; a specialist unit is investigating.

title: Mehrfach gegen den Kopf getreten
summary: A 37-year-old man repeatedly kicked a 43-year-old man lying on the ground at Europaplatz, causing a serious head injury. BVG staff held the suspect until federal police arrived.

title: Streitigkeiten mit Messer und Flaschenhieb ausgetragen
summary: An eight-person group of teenagers got into a fight at Rathausbrücke; one of them chased a 17-year-old and allegedly injured him in the shoulder with a box cutter. Police calmed the situation and took the minors to their guardians or homes.

title: Rassistische Beleidigung
summary: A 37-year-old man allegedly insulted three women in their twenties with racist remarks in Volkspark Hasenheide. He was arrested nearby and released later; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Autofahrer und Begleiter greifen Pedelecfahrer an
summary: A car driver and his passenger blocked a 21-year-old pedelec rider on Alexanderstraße and attacked him with punches and kicks, causing serious facial injuries. The attackers fled and the investigation continues.

title: Sachbeschädigungen und eine Beleidigung im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin
summary: Election-related incidents across Berlin on 15-16 August 2026 were handled by the Staatsschutz, including insults and torn campaign material at a party stand, damaged and burned election posters. Nobody was reported injured.

title: Mitarbeiter eines Spätkaufs mit Schusswaffe bedroht und Geld geraubt
summary: An unknown man threatened a 30-year-old shop employee with a firearm at a late-night shop and demanded cash and cigarettes, then fled by car. The employee was not injured.

title: Mann angefahren und anschließend geflüchtet
summary: An unknown driver struck a 52-year-old man sleeping between two car lifts of a commercial building and fled the scene. The man was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Mehrere Einbrüche in einem Einkaufszentrum
summary: Two masked people broke into a shopping centre in Marzahn early in the morning, smashing glass doors of 14 shops and taking cash drawers from some of them. The affected areas were closed until about 10 a.m. for investigation.

title: Mann auf dem Müggelsee durch Schiffsschraube schwer verletzt
summary: A man fell into the water from a rented raft on the Müggelsee and was injured by the propeller of the moving raft. He was taken to hospital; the water police are investigating.

title: Mehrere beschädigte Wahlplakate
summary: Several election posters of different parties were damaged in Reinickendorf and Schöneberg overnight. The Staatsschutz (state security unit) is investigating all cases.

title: Mann in U-Bahn antisemitisch beleidigt und bedroht
summary: A 30-year-old man was antisemitically insulted and threatened by a group on a U9 train in Wilmersdorf and followed when he left the train. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Zwei Männer durch Messerstiche verletzt
summary: After a misunderstanding at a park gathering in Baumschulenweg, a 45-year-old man stabbed a 48-year-old man and a 45-year-old friend who intervened. The suspect was arrested later in Niederschöneweide.

title: Rollerfahrer nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A van driver ignored a right-of-way sign at a junction in Pankow and collided with a scooter rider, aged 61, who later died in hospital. A 15-year-old passenger on the scooter was also injured.

title: Schüsse treffen Lokalscheibe
summary: Several shots struck the window of a venue in Wollankstraße in the night from Wednesday to Thursday. Witnesses heard noises in Pradelstraße and officers found cartridge casings and damage to the window.

title: Auseinandersetzung beim Anbringen von Wahlplakaten
summary: Three men putting up election posters in Moabit were verbally attacked, and one of them was punched in the face by an unknown person. The case was taken over by the State Security unit (Staatsschutz).

title: Brandstiftung in einer Bar
summary: An unknown masked man threw an incendiary device into a bar on Wiener Straße around 23:30. A 22-year-old employee put out the fire before the fire brigade arrived, and nobody was hurt.

title: Frau beschädigt Wahlplakate und greift Polizist an
summary: A 43-year-old woman tore down and damaged election posters in Brunnenstraße and elbowed a police officer, who was slightly hurt when blocking the blow. The Staatsschutz took over the investigation.

title: Lieferfahrer im Park überfallen
summary: Two unknown men attacked a 25-year-old food delivery rider on an e-bike, sprayed him with pepper spray, hit him and took his cash. He was treated for eye irritation at a hospital.

title: Festnahme einer mutmaßlichen Diebesbande auf frischer Tat
summary: Three suspects allegedly broke into two apartments in Gropiusstadt and stole jewellery, coins and cash, and were arrested with the loot and burglary tools. The suspects were brought before a duty court to request arrest warrants.

title: Spätkauf ausgeraubt – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: An unknown man posed as a customer in a late-night shop, then tried to take cash from the register. He struck and pushed the shop owner to the ground before fleeing with part of the till.

title: Wahlplakate von Laternen entfernt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: Election posters were cut from lampposts in Prenzlauer Berg overnight...

title: Dachgeschoss abgebrannt
summary: A fire broke out in a top-floor apartment of a residential building in Biesdorf, spreading to the roof structure and neighbouring flats. 28 people suffered smoke inhalation and all residents were evacuated.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin fährt Fußgänger an
summary: A 16-year-old e-scooter rider with an unauthorized 14-year-old passenger allegedly hit a 65-year-old pedestrian crossing a bike path. The pedestrian suffered head, shoulder and leg injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Kontrollen gegen Arbeitsausbeutung und Menschenhandel
summary: Police and customs inspected two nail studios in a commercial area on Herzbergstraße over suspected labour exploitation and human trafficking. More than 40 people were found to have violated residence law, and no victims of trafficking identified themselves.

title: Frau vermisst – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A 58-year-old woman who needs daily medication disappeared from her supported housing on the evening of 3 August 2026. Police are asking the public for help finding her.

title: Beleidigung und Volksverhetzung auf einem Spielplatz
summary: A 59-year-old man insulted an eleven-year-old girl in a playground in Rummelsburg in xenophobic terms and made inciting statements. The state security unit is investigating after he was located with witness help.

title: Schüsse auf einen Mann
summary: A 40-year-old man allegedly shot another 40-year-old man several times in a bar in Baumschulenweg and then fled. The victim was taken to hospital; the homicide unit is investigating a suspected attempted killing.

title: Fahrradfahrer verstorben
summary: A 73-year-old cyclist collapsed and fell in Streitstraße in Hakenfelde and died at the scene despite first aid and resuscitation attempts by bystanders. Police investigations are being handled by a specialist unit.

title: Durch Messerangriff erheblich verletzt
summary: After an argument between two groups of young men at the entrance of Park am Weißensee, a 22-year-old allegedly stabbed a 24-year-old in the back. The injured man was taken to hospital with serious injuries; police say his life is not in danger.

title: Gewerbsmäßiger Computerbetrug und Diebstahl – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?
summary: Police appeal for information about an unknown suspect who allegedly stole mailed bank cards and PINs and withdrew money between August and September 2024 in nine computer fraud cases and three thefts. The suspect used a cash machine at Leipziger Platz 12.

title: Geschwindigkeitskontrollen im Rahmen der zweiten ROADPOL-Aktionswoche „Speedweek“ 2026 – Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz
summary: Berlin police report results of the ROADPOL Speedweek speed-check campaign from 3 to 9 August 2026, with 12,413 speeding violations found at 247 checkpoints. Speed checks will continue year-round and a focus on school routes starts with the new school year.

title: Mann mit Messer verletzt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: After an argument in Rudow, a 52-year-old man allegedly stabbed a 38-year-old man in the upper body with a knife. The victim was taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries, and the suspect was arrested at the scene.

title: Verhaltensauffällige Person - DEIG-Einsatz
summary: Police were called to a flat where a 37-year-old man, acting erratically, claimed to have a firearm and threatened officers. He injured himself and an officer used a stun device; he was taken to hospital with minor injuries.

title: Schüsse auf 30-Jährigen – Zeugenaufruf
summary: After an argument among several people at Hardenbergplatz, one person fired shots at a 30-year-old man, who died at the scene. The shooter fled by vehicle and the homicide squad is appealing for witnesses.

title: Falscher Stromzählerableser – Auseinandersetzung nach versuchtem Trickdiebstahl
summary: A suspected distraction thief posing as a meter reader tried to rob an 86-year-old resident in his flat, then punched the 50-year-old son who confronted him and fled without stolen goods. The son suffered grazes and facial redness and declined medical treatment.

title: Wahlplakate beschädigt – Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: Two suspects, a 27-year-old woman and a 29-year-old man, were arrested after damaging several election posters in Schöneberg overnight. The Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Streit zwischen mehreren Personen eskaliert
summary: After a dispute, a group attacked two men, and a 47-year-old man struck them with a hammer and drove a car at one of them. Three suspects aged 39 to 47 were identified and were under the influence of alcohol.

title: DEIG-Einsatz im Hotel nach tätlichem Angriff und Widerstand
summary: A hotel guest set off a fire alarm without cause around 4 a.m. and then attacked officers and resisted arrest in a hotel lift. An officer used a stun device to end the resistance; the 31-year-old was taken to hospital with redness on his lower back.

title: Feuer in der Küche – Bewohnerin verstorben
summary: A fire broke out in the kitchen of a semi-detached house in Lichtenrade overnight. A 56-year-old woman died after firefighters found her unresponsive and resuscitation failed.

title: Autofahrerin fährt Radfahrer an
summary: A car driver turning left collided with a cyclist in Rummelsburg overnight. The 34-year-old cyclist was injured and taken to hospital, with no life-threatening injuries expected.

title: Wahlkampfhelfer beim Plakatieren angefahren
summary: A 47-year-old campaign helper putting up election posters was allegedly deliberately struck from behind by an unknown cyclist and injured. The state security unit is investigating.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer nach Sturz in Lebensgefahr
summary: A 52-year-old e-scooter rider fell alone in Marzahn on the evening of 7 August and was left in life-threatening condition. Traffic accident investigators are looking into the crash.

title: Unbekannter entwendet Regenbogenflaggen
summary: An unknown man tore down two rainbow flags from the window front of a bar in Prenzlauer Berg and fled toward the Eberswalder Straße U-Bahn station. Police investigations are ongoing.

title: Versuchter Totschlag – Mann vor Café angeschossen
summary: A man aged 22 was shot outside a café and taken to hospital with emergency surgery; he is no longer in danger of dying. The homicide unit is searching for the unknown shooter, who fled.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A motorcyclist rear-ended a car stopped at a red light on Streitstraße in Hakenfelde and was seriously injured. Police traffic investigators are looking into the cause of the crash.

title: DEIG-Einsatz nach Widerstand
summary: A 20-year-old man damaged furniture in a hotel room during a dispute and resisted a search by police, who used a stun device (DEIG) to arrest him. He was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Spezialkräfte durchsuchen Wohnung nach Schüssen
summary: A 37-year-old man allegedly fired shots into the air from a window of a flat in the Märkisches Viertel, prompting a police operation. Special forces searched the flat, arrested the man and seized several blank-firing guns and ammunition.

title: Imbiss mit Waffe ausgeraubt
summary: Two masked unknown suspects robbed a snack bar in Hakenfelde early in the morning, threatening an employee with a firearm and taking the cash register. The employee was not hurt; the suspects fled on a motorbike.

title: Raubüberfall auf Lebensmitteldiscounter
summary: Two masked men robbed a discount supermarket in Friedenau the previous evening, taking cash from the register while armed with a firearm. They fled toward Rheinstraße, and a search with a police helicopter found no one; nobody was hurt.

title: Zwei Polizeibeamte bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A police patrol car responding to a call collided with a car in the Friedenau tunnel on the A103 after a lane change. Two police officers were injured, one seriously enough to end his shift early.

title: Mann durch Messerstiche verletzt
summary: After an argument, a 19-year-old man allegedly stabbed a 22-year-old man in the torso outside Südkreuz station. The suspect was arrested at the scene; the victim was operated on and is not in life-threatening condition.

title: Zahlungsstreit endet mit Messerangriff
summary: A payment dispute at a snack bar escalated; a 28-year-old employee was punched, and a 36-year-old bystander who tried to intervene was stabbed several times by one of three unknown men. The attackers fled.

title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlichem Drogenhandel
summary: After an anonymous tip, police observed suspected drug sales in front of a residential building and later arrested a 49-year-old suspect in his flat. Amphetamine, cannabis, air guns and cash were seized.

title: Verbleib von gesuchter 16-Jähriger geklärt
summary: A 16-year-old girl who had been missing since 1 April 2026 has been located, and the public search has ended. She had left a youth welfare facility on Mindener Straße.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A 45-year-old motorcyclist lost control while overtaking on Grottkauer Straße in Kaulsdorf, hit a bollard and a tree, and was taken to hospital. He reportedly did not hold a valid driving licence.

title: Störung beim Anbringen von Wahlplakaten
summary: While members of a political party were putting up election posters on Gürtelstraße, several people confronted them and shook a ladder. A 41-year-old man then used animal repellent spray, injuring two men.

title: Fahrradfahrer umgefahren und geflüchtet
summary: A car driver hit an 80-year-old cyclist in Rudow and drove off without helping. The 38-year-old suspected driver, who had no driving licence, later reported to a police station.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Auseinandersetzung
summary: Several men fought outside a bar in Dominicusstraße, using baseball bats, glass bottles and a knife. One man was stabbed and two others suffered head injuries; three suspects were arrested and later released.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit mehreren Verletzten
summary: Two cars collided at a junction in Pankow on the evening before publication; a traffic light was knocked out. Four people were injured, two of them hospitalized.

title: Gefährliche Körperverletzung mit Messer
summary: After an argument on the Kronprinzenbrücke around midnight, a man struck another man with a bottle and a fist and then injured two men with a knife before fleeing. Police later searched the suspect's flat, seized several knives, and released him after identification measures.

title: Schüsse auf Wohnhaus
summary: Shots were fired at a residential building in Spandau on the evening before publication. Bullet holes were found in an apartment door; nobody was hurt and two suspects fled.

title: Bedrohung mit Messer – DEIG-Einsatz
summary: A 77-year-old man drew a knife at a resident in Britz after an exchange from a balcony, then fled. Police later entered his flat under a search warrant, used a stun device when he ran at officers, and found the knife was a replica; he was taken to a psychiatric ward.

title: Festnahme von mutmaßlichen Fahrraddieben - Mehrere verletzte Polizeikräfte
summary: Two suspects were seen breaking a bicycle lock and stealing two bikes; plainclothes officers arrested them after a chase in a park, and five officers were injured while resisting arrest.

title: Fahrzeuge durch Brand beschädigt
summary: Several parked cars were damaged by a fire in a parking lot at a sports facility in the Märkisches Viertel. Three vehicles are no longer roadworthy, and nobody was injured.

title: Schüsse auf Imbiss
summary: Several live rounds were fired at a snack bar from a moving vehicle at about 2:20 a.m. Two people were inside, but nobody was hurt.

title: Trickbetrug durch falsche Polizeibeamte – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?
summary: Fake police officers called a 76-year-old man, claimed his wife had caused a fatal accident and needed bail, and he handed over gold. Police publish a surveillance image and seek the suspect's identity.

title: Vermisster Senior ist wieder da
summary: A 66-year-old man reported missing from a care facility in Pankow has been found again and taken to hospital for medical care.

title: Öffentlichkeitsfahndung erfolgreich - Tatverdächtiger ermittelt
summary: On 10 October 2025 a 17-year-old was punched and kicked on the U8 platform at Alexanderplatz station, suffering facial injuries. A suspect has now been identified after a public appeal.

title: Senior angegriffen und erheblich verletzt
summary: An unknown man punched and pushed a 77-year-old man from behind on Kleiststraße in Schöneberg, causing serious shoulder and head injuries. The attacker fled toward Lietzenburger Straße.

title: Radfahrer von Lastwagen angefahren
summary: A truck turning right at a junction hit an 80-year-old cyclist, who fell and was pulled under the vehicle. The cyclist was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Umfangreiche Einsatzmaßnahmen zur Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität – BAO Ferrum und EG Telum vollstrecken Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse
summary: Police searched twelve properties in Berlin, Hamburg and Brandenburg in a multi-state operation against arms trafficking and firearms crime, seizing seven firearms and cash. Six suspects aged 40 and 66 were targeted, and the investigation continues.

title: Kind bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A car driver struck a seven-year-old boy crossing Werneuchener Straße in Alt-Hohenschönhausen on the evening before publication. The boy was injured in the head and leg and taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Polizei Berlin erlässt Allgemeinverfügung zum 2. August 2026
summary: The police issued a general order (Allgemeinverfügung) banning assemblies and events in the government district around the Memorial to the Sinti and Roma murdered under National Socialism on 2 August 2026, the day of commemoration. The order runs from 6:00 to 23:59.

title: Autofahrer bei Zusammenstoß mit Straßenbahn erheblich verletzt
summary: A 90-year-old driver collided with a tram at a junction in Marzahn and was trapped in his car. He was seriously injured and taken to hospital; police traffic investigators are looking into the crash.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Brand auf Schulgelände
summary: Unknown suspects entered a school grounds overnight, broke into an equipment shed and set sports equipment alight in a long jump pit. Police arson unit is investigating.

title: Sachbeschädigung in Parkanlage
summary: Unknown persons damaged a vase and set fire to a cardboard heart in a park area in Tiergarten. The case was taken over by the state security unit (Staatsschutz).

title: Denkmal mit Hakenkreuz beschmiert
summary: A swastika was sprayed on a monument to anti-fascist resistance fighters in a park in Weißensee and was made unrecognisable by police. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) took over the investigation.

title: Ermittlungen nach Schussabgaben führen zur Festnahme eines Tatverdächtigen
summary: Following an arrest in a case of shots fired in a dispute on Karl-Marx-Straße in March 2026, a 40-year-old suspect was taken into custody on 24 July 2026. An uninvolved 24-year-old was hit in the leg and injured.

title: Knallgeräusch löst Polizeieinsatz aus
summary: A loud bang in Falckensteinstraße was followed by a power outage affecting several buildings in the area. Police found a short circuit in a nearby transformer caused the outage, and nobody was hurt.

title: Brand an Gemeinschaftsunterkunft
summary: A burning object was thrown at the facade of a refugee shelter in Hellersdorf overnight. The security service extinguished the fire, and no one was hurt; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Mit Maschinenpistole bedroht – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 42-year-old man allegedly forced a 25-year-old into his flat, demanded his phone and laptop, and threatened him with a machete and a submachine gun. The suspect was arrested in the stairwell and the weapon was seized.

title: Mann durch Schuss aus mutmaßlicher Schreckschusswaffe und Reizgas verletzt
summary: A 23-year-old man was attacked on the U2 platform at Alexanderplatz station; one of three assailants allegedly fired a blank-firing gun into his face, then they sprayed him with pepper spray and fled. He was injured in the eyes and skin and taken to hospital.

title: Mit Luftdruckgewehr auf Passanten geschossen – Tatverdächtiger vorläufig festgenommen
summary: A 32-year-old man was hit in the stomach by an air rifle pellet on Falkenseer Damm in Spandau and suffered a superficial skin injury. A 28-year-old suspect was arrested in an apartment in Groenerstraße after a police search.

title: Mutmaßlicher Brandstifter greift Polizeikräfte an – Schusswaffengebrauch
summary: Police officers shot a 38-year-old suspected arson attacker who allegedly advanced on them with an axe after a fire in an apartment building. Twelve people were checked for smoke inhalation, two were hospitalised, and the building was evacuated.

title: Streit eskaliert – zwei Männer erleiden Stichverletzungen
summary: After a dispute over drug dealing, two men were stabbed by members of a group in Gesundbrunnen. Four suspects were arrested nearby, one knife was seized, and the stolen phone was recovered.

title: Auffahrunfall mit mehreren beteiligten Polizeifahrzeugen
summary: A convoy of eight police vehicles on emergency runs was involved in a multi-vehicle collision on the A115 motorway, after a car ahead pulled over and braked. Six emergency vehicles and one other car were involved, and no one was injured.

title: Anschlag im Umfeld des Christopher Street Day - Tatverdächtiger bei Polizeieinsatz erschossen
summary: Police shot dead a 21-year-old suspect in a garden colony after he allegedly attacked special forces with a bladed weapon. The man is the suspect in an attack near the Christopher Street Day event on 25 July 2026.

title: Flucht vor der Polizei endet in Sackgasse
summary: A 19-year-old fleeing plainclothes officers in a BMW at high speed, driving on pavements and through a red light, ended in a dead-end street and was arrested. He faces charges including illegal street racing and driving without a licence.

title: Körperliche Auseinandersetzung zwischen mehreren Personen
summary: Four men got into a physical fight in a park in Moabit, with knives, a bottle and a hammer involved and a dog biting several people. Several men were injured, and the dog was stabbed and taken to a vet clinic.

title: Mann bespuckt und beleidigt Passanten und Polizeikräfte
summary: A likely intoxicated 56-year-old man insulted two men with xenophobic remarks, spat at passers-by and police officers, and threw objects at people on Frankfurter Allee. He was taken into custody and the state security unit took over the investigation.

title: Senior nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben – Polizei sucht Ersthelfer und weitere Zeugen
summary: A 78-year-old man crashed his small motorcycle into a construction barrier on Waidmannsluster Damm and died two days later. Police are investigating whether the crash injuries caused the death and are seeking witnesses, especially a cyclist who helped him.

title: Gedenktafel beschmiert
summary: Unknown persons painted a swastika on a memorial plaque for victims of National Socialism on Witzlebenstraße. Police removed the symbol, and the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Transfrau ins Gesicht gespuckt
summary: A 33-year-old transgender woman was spat at and insulted in a transphobic manner by a cyclist at the corner of Triftstraße and Tegeler Straße. The case has been taken over by the State Security unit.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Farbschmiererei an Moschee
summary: Paint graffiti with a two-line slogan was sprayed on the outer facade of a mosque. The state security unit (Staatsschutz) is investigating.

title: Zwei Festnahmen nach mutmaßlichem Raub
summary: Two suspects, an 18-year-old woman and a 26-year-old man, were arrested after a 65-year-old woman was allegedly drugged and robbed of cash in her home. The arrests followed house searches in Spandau.

title: Mann rast durch die Stadt – vorläufige Festnahme
summary: A driver was seen speeding and changing lanes erratically through Gesundbrunnen, endangering other road users before police stopped him. The 18-year-old resisted identity checks and attacked officers, and three officers were slightly injured.

title: Mann schießt mit Schreckschusswaffe
summary: A man fired two shots in the air with a blank-firing gun in a park in Hellersdorf and threatened a witness who confronted him. Nobody was injured.

title: Mann bei Streit mit Messer verletzt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: After an argument, a 31-year-old man allegedly stabbed a 33-year-old man in the upper body in Lankwitz and fled. The suspect was arrested shortly afterwards and the victim is not in danger of his life.

title: Mann von mehreren Unbekannten angegriffen und verletzt
summary: A 27-year-old man was attacked by several unknown men on a green area in Kreuzberg in the night; one attacker struck him with a machete and others beat him with a baseball bat. He was taken to hospital with head and upper-body injuries.

title: Frau stirbt nach Messerangriff
summary: A 43-year-old man is suspected of fatally stabbing his 65-year-old mother on a balcony in Mariendorf; the 7th Homicide Commission is investigating. Police and emergency services attempted resuscitation, but she died in hospital.

title: Mann durch wegrollendes Auto verletzt
summary: A 68-year-old man was run over and seriously injured by his own car, which rolled backwards after he got out. The car also damaged two parked vehicles before stopping.

title: Mann und Hund von Autofahrer angefahren
summary: A car driver hit a 32-year-old man and his dog on Sonnenallee in the night, after the man stepped onto the road to catch his escaped dog. The man was taken to hospital with head and torso injuries; the dog died at the scene.

title: Mann mit Hammer angegriffen und ausgeraubt
summary: Two men aged 18 and 20 allegedly attacked a 49-year-old man on a sidewalk, beat him with an emergency hammer and stole his wallet and phone. The suspects were detained shortly after at Heidelberger Platz station and released after identification measures.

title: Frau mit Messer angegriffen und angezündet
summary: A man attacked his 33-year-old ex-partner and a 39-year-old neighbour with a knife in a homeless shelter, then allegedly set the woman on fire with petrol. The suspect fled and is still being sought.

title: Bei Auseinandersetzung mit Messer verletzt
summary: After a fight between two groups in Gesundbrunnen, one person from the smaller group allegedly stabbed two young men from the larger group. Both victims were treated as outpatients at a hospital.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Radfahrer verletzt
summary: A cyclist aged 55 was injured after a car driver turned off in front of him and then left the scene. The cyclist braked hard and fell over the handlebars.

title: Toter identifiziert
summary: A man found dead in the Havel near the Schwanenwerder island in December 2023 has now been identified. The follow-up report announces the identification of the previously unknown body.

title: Streit im Straßenverkehr eskaliert
summary: After a verbal dispute over speeding, a BMW driver allegedly struck a 28-year-old pedestrian with his car and drove off. The driver was later identified after a drink-driving test and a blood sample was taken.

title: Verfolgung auf der Müggelspree – Festnahme nach Bootsdiebstahl
summary: A 19-year-old took a moored sports boat in Köpenick and fled across the Müggelspree, where he was later arrested. He was then held overnight after resisting police and insulting officers.

title: Festnahmen nach Wohnungseinbruch
summary: Police arrested three suspected burglars, aged 19, 28 and 37, after a break-in through a ground-floor window of a flat at a rear building. Stolen goods were found in their car, which may also come from another burglary.

title: Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 56-year-old woman driving a car struck a five-year-old cyclist crossing a pedestrian crossing at the junction with Reiherallee in Heiligensee. The child suffered a shoulder fracture and was taken to hospital.

title: Brandstiftung an einer Arztpraxis
summary: A 60-year-old man set several waste containers on fire against the wall of a medical practice in Spandau, and the flames spread to the facade. He later turned himself in to federal police; nobody was hurt.

title: Einsatzkräfte mit Schusswaffe bedroht - Festnahmen
summary: Occupants of a car threatened plainclothes police officers and another person with a gun during a drive-by, and the car was stopped at an intersection. Three toy guns were seized and several occupants were detained.

title: Auseinandersetzung im Bus mit Pfefferspray
summary: Two unknown men fought on a BVG bus on Lindauer Allee; one sprayed the other with pepper spray, affecting the bus driver and two women passengers. Police are investigating for dangerous bodily harm.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall tödlich verletzt
summary: A car pulling out of a parking bay on Vorarlberger Damm in Schöneberg collided with a motorcyclist, who died at the scene. The car driver and her passenger were treated in hospital as outpatients.

title: Auf Fahrbahnen zugerannt und Widerstand geleistet – DEIG-Einsatz
summary: A 29-year-old man in a psychological crisis ran toward vehicles on Blumberger Damm and then resisted police and paramedics during transport to hospital. A police officer used a stun device (DEIG) on him after warning him; he was not injured and was admitted to psychiatric care.

title: Mann mit Messer angegriffen
summary: After an argument outside a barbershop, a 29-year-old man allegedly stabbed a 26-year-old man. The stabbing suspect was also struck on the head with a wooden pole by another man, and the injured man was arrested after fleeing into a building.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall erheblich verletzt
summary: An 84-year-old driver hit an 18-year-old pedestrian crossing at a pedestrian crossing while turning left in Spandau. The pedestrian was seriously injured and treated by an emergency transport crew before going to hospital.

title: Mit Messer und Baseballschläger lebensbedrohlich verletzt
summary: Four unknown men attacked a car at a petrol station in Mariendorf with a baseball bat and a knife, seriously injuring an 18-year-old. Two companions, aged 16 and 20, were hurt by shattered windows.

title: Zwei Männer nach Messerangriffen im Krankenhaus
summary: A 22-year-old man stabbed a 25-year-old man in Kreuzberg after a verbal dispute, then stabbed another 25-year-old man nearby. Both victims were taken to hospital, and the suspect was arrested with the knife.

title: Rassistisch beleidigt und geschlagen
summary: A 22-year-old woman was struck in the face and racially insulted by a 76-year-old man on a footpath. No injuries were found by paramedics, and the state security unit took over the investigation.

title: Festnahmen und Durchsuchungen in Berlin nach Schussabgaben
summary: Police and prosecutors executed six search warrants across Berlin against five suspects linked to shootings, burglaries and attempted extortion between April and June 2026. Three suspects were arrested and drugs and mobile phones were seized.

title: Mann bei Messerangriff am Auge verletzt
summary: A 36-year-old man was stabbed in the eye by one of three attackers outside a snack bar in Kreuzberg early in the morning. A passerby intervened and the three suspects fled.

title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlich homophober Beleidigung und Bedrohung
summary: A 38-year-old man was verbally abused for being gay and threatened with a knife in a park in Wilhelmstadt. The suspect, also 38, was arrested nearby and the knife was seized; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Radfahrer bei Ausweichmanöver gegen geparktes Auto geprallt
summary: A 24-year-old cyclist was injured after swerving to avoid a close-passing car and crashing into a parked car. The unidentified driver did not stop after the collision.

title: Senior in Wohnung beraubt und verletzt
summary: Several unknown perpetrators forced their way into a flat by knocking, attacked the 72-year-old tenant with a baseball bat and an iron bar, searched the flat and sprayed him with pepper spray. The man suffered head and torso injuries.

title: Pyrotechnik explodiert – Mehrere Verletzte
summary: Unknown people set off several pyrotechnic devices in Gropiusstadt on the evening of 16 July, injuring three children aged five to seven and a 33-year-old woman. Police are investigating explosion and bodily injury offences.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe sichergestellt
summary: A loaded real firearm was found under a parked car in Zimmerstraße after a witness saw an unknown man place it there. Police seized the weapon, and a specialist unit of the state criminal office is investigating.

title: Flucht vor der Polizei – Fahrer nach Verkehrsunfall festgenommen
summary: A 19-year-old driver fled a police traffic check at high speed, crashed into a parked van and was arrested. He had no valid driving licence, was allegedly under the influence of cannabis, and the rental car was seized.

title: Mann nach räuberischem Diebstahl im Juweliergeschäft gesucht – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A man took jewellery from a display case in a jewellery shop in the Eastgate shopping centre and fled when a saleswoman confronted him, injuring her. Police are seeking public help with identifying him from surveillance images.

title: Mann durch Schussabgaben verletzt
summary: A 33-year-old man was shot in the legs during an altercation with three unknown men on Gamsbartweg. He underwent surgery and is not in danger of his life.

title: Vom Unfallort geflüchtet und weiteren Unfall verursacht
summary: A 23-year-old man allegedly hit a traffic bollard and fled, then crashed into two parked cars at another junction while apparently under the influence of drugs. He suffered head injuries, was treated in hospital, and was released; police seized two weapons and a baton.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 50-year-old e-scooter rider died after a collision with a car at the Blücherstraße/Urbanstraße junction in Kreuzberg in the early hours. The 23-year-old car driver was involved; the traffic accident unit is investigating.

title: Alkoholisierter Kleintransporterfahrer ohne Fahrerlaubnis fährt gegen Motorrad
summary: A van driver without a valid driving licence and with about 1.8 per mille alcohol collided with a motorcyclist at the Brunnenstraße/Bernauer Straße junction. The 18-year-old motorcyclist was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Autofahrer fährt Radfahrer an
summary: An 86-year-old driver allegedly tried to overtake a cyclist on Elisabethstraße, and the cyclist, who was on an e-bike, collided with the car and fell. The cyclist was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Autofahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 40-year-old driver without a valid licence and with about 2.9 per mille blood alcohol caused a collision at a junction in Reinickendorf, injuring a 59-year-old driver. The driver was detained by an off-duty officer, and a blank-firing gun was seized from the van.

title: Überprüfung im Straßenverkehr führt zu Schusswaffenfund
summary: During a traffic check for drunk driving in Reinickendorf, police found a loaded pistol, nitrous oxide canisters, cannabis and cash in a car. Two men aged 26 were arrested on suspicion of illegal drug trading.

title: Ausschreitungen in der Rigaer Straße – Strafermittlungsverfahren eingeleitet
summary: During a demonstration weekend in Friedrichshain, people set fires and rubbish bins alight on Rigaer Straße, and police were attacked with fireworks and a glass bottle. Nobody was injured; four criminal proceedings were opened.

title: Zwei mutmaßliche Drogendealer festgenommen
summary: Two suspected drug dealers aged 25 were arrested in Kreuzberg after police searched a flat used as a drug stash in Yorckstraße. Large quantities of amphetamine, ketamine, MDMA and other drugs, cash and a Schreckschusswaffe were seized.

title: Motorradfahrer nach Unfall verletzt
summary: A motorcyclist rear-ended a car on Bernauer Straße in Tegel and fell, also knocking down a cyclist. The motorcyclist and the cyclist were injured, and the road was closed for about an hour.

title: Geldausgabeautomat aus Spätkauf entwendet
