summary: Masked suspects forced their way into a late-night shop in Neukölln and stole a cash machine, loading it into a waiting car before fleeing. The burglary is being investigated by the LKA break-in unit.

title: Verdacht des erpresserischen Menschenraubes im Supermarkt - Untersuchungshaft
summary: A 29-year-old man allegedly held a supermarket employee at knifepoint, using pepper spray and restraints, and demanded money; she was freed the next day and he was arrested and remanded in custody.

title: Verletzter nach Schussabgabe
summary: A 46-year-old man allegedly shot a 48-year-old man in the chest with an air rifle after a dispute at a site on An der Wuhlheide; the victim was operated on and is not in mortal danger. Police searched the suspect's home and seized the alleged weapon and two softair guns, but the suspect was not found.

title: Farbschmierereien an Fahrzeugen und Hausfassaden - Festnahme
summary: Multiple paint graffiti attacks on vehicles and building facades in Wedding early in the morning, some with political content. A 38-year-old man was arrested with spray cans and later released; the State Security unit took over the politically motivated cases.

title: Mit Schusswaffe bedroht - Festnahmen
summary: Men met on a street to discuss a money claim; one was threatened with a handgun to press the demand. Police arrested three suspects at Ringbahnstraße/Tempelhofer Damm and seized a live handgun.

title: Fahrradfahrerin nach Verkehrsunfall erheblich verletzt
summary: A 20-year-old cyclist crossed Hellersdorfer Straße and collided with a car driven by a 38-year-old woman. The cyclist suffered serious head injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe bei Personenüberprüfung im Hosenbund gefunden – Haftbefehl erlassen
summary: Police on a presence patrol in Körnerpark found a loaded handgun and cocaine on a 39-year-old man during a identity check and arrested him. He was later remanded in custody by a judge.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer und unerlaubt mitfahrende Sozia bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 16-year-old e-scooter rider and an unauthorized passenger aged 15 were injured after the scooter pulled out from a footpath and was hit by a car. The 15-year-old remained in hospital.

title: Kind bei Zusammenstoß mit Radfahrer verletzt
summary: An eight-year-old girl was injured when she collided with a cyclist at a crossing in Friedrichshagen and suffered a leg fracture. The cyclist was not hurt.

title: Senior in Kleingartenanlage überfallen
summary: Several unknown people demanded valuables from a 77-year-old man in a allotment garden area shortly after midnight; when he refused, he was beaten, bitten and injured with a pointed object. He was taken to hospital and treated as an outpatient.

title: Streit eskaliert – Angriff mit Schlagring auf jungen Mann
summary: A young man who tried to break up a dispute outside a bar in Rathausstraße was struck several times in the face with a knife-less knuckleduster (Schlagring). He suffered a cut to the face and was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Unbekannte greifen Parkbesucher an
summary: Around midnight, a 39-year-old man was attacked by several unknown people in James-Simon-Park, allegedly because of his sexual identity. Shortly after, a 19-year-old was chased, knocked down and assaulted with pepper spray by a group on the Spree embankment.

title: Radfahrerin nach Verkehrsunfall mit Sattelzugmaschine notoperiert
summary: A 58-year-old cyclist was run over by the front wheel of a truck tractor unit on Warschauer Straße and seriously injured in an arm. She was taken to hospital and underwent emergency surgery.

title: Ermittlungen wegen queerfeindlichen Angriffs und Beleidigung
summary: A 51-year-old non-binary person was insulted and attacked with a plastic bottle, sandals and fireworks by three unknown youths in Hakenfelde. The Staatsschutz is investigating a suspected queer-hostile attack.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Rettungswagen bei Sonder- und Wegerechtsfahrt im Kreuzungsbereich
summary: A car collided with an ambulance on a emergency run at a junction in Mahlsdorf, pushing the car into a waiting van. One van driver suffered neck pain; all three vehicles were undrivable afterwards.

title: Moscheemauer mit Farbschmierereien beschädigt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: Overnight, the outer wall of a mosque on Columbiadamm was sprayed with large black graffiti over about 150 metres. A 30-year-old suspect was arrested on site and later released after police measures.

title: Jugendliche E-Scooter-Fahrer verletzt
summary: A 14-year-old e-scooter rider and a 13-year-old passenger were injured after colliding with a car at a junction in Kladow. The 48-year-old driver was unhurt.

title: Toter Säugling aufgefunden – Tatverdächtige ermittelt
summary: A dead infant was found on a lawn in a residential complex in Lichterfelde, and a juvenile female suspect has been identified by the homicide unit. The investigation is ongoing.

title: Festnahme nach versuchtem Geschäftseinbruch – Haftbefehl vollstreckt
summary: An attempted break-in at a bakery was foiled when an off-duty police officer saw the broken window and caught a 20-year-old suspect. Police seized the suspect's torch and burglary tools, and a court issued an arrest warrant.

title: Verkehrsunfall auf Einsatzfahrt
summary: A police patrol car responding to an emergency call collided with a car at the Otto-Braun-Straße/Alexanderstraße crossing in Mitte. Both vehicles were no longer roadworthy, and one officer was injured.

title: Unter dem Einfluss von berauschenden Mitteln zwei Verkehrsunfälle verursacht
summary: A 36-year-old driver under the influence of alcohol and drugs crashed into a parked car and rolled his vehicle onto its roof in Tempelhof, then left the scene after an earlier hit-and-run involving two parked cars. He was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Autofahrerinnen ungebremst miteinander kollidiert
summary: Two cars collided at an intersection in Marzahn after one driver failed to yield, and a pedestrian was hit by flying vehicle parts. Three people were taken to hospital or treated on scene, and both cars are undrivable.

title: Vermisstes Mädchen wieder im Kreise der Familie
summary: A nine-year-old girl reported missing since 29 June 2026 after failing to arrive at school has been found safe and returned to her mother. The report was published on 8 July 2026.

title: Haftbefehl wegen Verstößen gegen das Waffengesetz vollstreckt
summary: A 35-year-old man was arrested in a courtroom on a warrant for a weapons law violation, and two firearms and ammunition were seized during a search of his residence. The investigation is ongoing.

title: 20-Jähriger nach Raubserie in Berlin festgenommen
summary: A 20-year-old suspect in a series of robberies of men lured through dating apps was arrested at Rudow U-Bahn station and remanded in custody. The co-accused was already sentenced to five years by the Berlin Regional Court I in June 2026.

title: Schleuser sollen Sprachzertifikate gefälscht haben – Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt
summary: Police and prosecutors searched five residences and a business premises in Berlin over alleged forged language certificates and fake housing confirmations used for residence permits and illegal registrations. Four suspects were found during the searches, and no arrests were made.

title: Mann bei Streit mit Messer verletzt – Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: During a dispute on Boxhagener Platz, a 43-year-old woman allegedly stabbed a 31-year-old man in the neck with a kitchen knife. She was arrested and the knife was secured; the victim was taken to hospital with no life-threatening injuries.

title: Unter Drogeneinfluss vor Polizei geflüchtet und Verkehrsunfall verursacht
summary: A moped rider under the influence of drugs fled a police check at speed, running red lights and endangering road users. He crashed into a car at a junction and was injured.

title: Mann bei Raubüberfall verletzt
summary: A 21-year-old man was attacked by four masked men on a hill near the Monbijou fountain; two attackers used cutter knives, and the group fled with cash and a bank card. The victim was taken to hospital.

title: Fahrradfahrer nach Unfall verletzt
summary: A car turning left collided with a 64-year-old cyclist in Hakenfelde, Spandau. The cyclist fell onto the road and was taken to hospital with back injuries.

title: Raub auf ein Pfandleihhaus – Tatverdächtige flüchten
summary: Several masked suspects forcibly entered a pawn shop, threatened staff with a firearm, and took jewellery from the safes before fleeing by car. Four employees suffered airway irritation from fire extinguisher powder.

title: Mehrere Fahrzeuge in Flammen
summary: Several cars and trucks were set on fire in Wilhelmstadt overnight, damaging six cars, three trucks and a trailer. Nobody was hurt, and the BAO Ferrum task force is investigating.

title: Autofahrer fährt mit Fahrzeug mehrfach gegen Tunnelwand und flüchtet
summary: A driver speeding on the A111 motorway in Tegel crashed repeatedly into a tunnel wall and fled on foot before police arrived. Occupants of the car were not injured, and police seized the car and executed an arrest warrant against a 42-year-old passenger.

title: Tötungsdelikt in Krankenhaus – Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: A 65-year-old man died after being fatally injured in a hospital in Buckow following an argument with a 26-year-old man, who was arrested at the scene. The homicide unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Raubüberfall auf Grillimbiss
summary: An unknown man reportedly used physical force to take cash from a 52-year-old employee of a grill snack bar. Police released camera images and are seeking witnesses.

title: Mit Schreckschusspistole auf Mann geschossen
summary: A 27-year-old man was shot at with a blank-firing gun that discharged tear gas after a dispute in Meinekestraße, allegedly by occupants of a passing car. He suffered injuries to the neck, back and eye area and was treated as an outpatient.

title: Zigarettenautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators blew up a cigarette vending machine in the Hansaviertel overnight and fled by vehicle. Nobody was injured.

title: Bewaffneter Überfall auf Schnellrestaurant
summary: A masked man threatened a fast-food restaurant employee with a pistol and demanded the cash register be opened, but fled without loot after the employee sprayed him with pepper spray. The employee was injured in the face and declined medical treatment.

title: Auseinandersetzung zweier Personengruppen
summary: Two politically opposed groups clashed in Hellersdorf over use of rooms in a building, with objects thrown, fire extinguishers emptied and baseball bats used. 29 people were detained and investigations for riot were opened.

title: Polizeibeamter bei Festnahme nach mutmaßlichem Drogenhandel verletzt
summary: Police arrested a 35-year-old driver after observing a suspected drug handover near Heidelberg Square in Schmargendorf. A 42-year-old resisted arrest, bit and struck an officer, and cannabis and cocaine were seized.

title: Frau bei Auseinandersetzung mit Messer verletzt
summary: A 41-year-old man allegedly stabbed and cut his 79-year-old mother with a knife in a residential flat in Moabit. He was arrested nearby, and the woman was taken to hospital and operated on.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe aus dem Verkehr gezogen
summary: Police observed a suspected drug handover in a Neukölln park and checked those involved. They seized a loaded firearm with ammunition and a small bag of suspected amphetamine nearby.

title: Dreizehnjährige wieder da
summary: A 13-year-old girl who had been missing since April 23, 2026 has been found safe in Duisburg. The police had appealed for help in finding her.

title: Schüsse auf Firmengebäude und geparktes Fahrzeug
summary: Bullet holes were found in a company building and a company vehicle parked in front of it in Wilmersdorf. Police secured several cartridge cases; nobody was hurt.

title: Mit Reizgas in Straßenbahn gesprüht
summary: An unknown man sprayed pepper spray inside a tram of line 67 in Oberschöneweide after a group confronted him with xenophobic insults. Eleven people were injured, and the suspect escaped; the case is being investigated as dangerous bodily harm and xenophobic insult.

title: Radfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: A 70-year-old cyclist was struck by a tram while crossing Rudower Chaussee in Adlershof and suffered life-threatening injuries. The tram driver was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Mutmaßlich mit Messer verletzt
summary: During a dispute between two groups of youths in Volkspark Mariendorf, one person drew a machete and attacked two 17-year-olds, who suffered cuts. The investigation is ongoing.

title: Frau bei Wohnungsbrand verstorben
summary: A 58-year-old woman died in a flat fire in an apartment building on Lechtaler Weg; a 77-year-old resident was treated for smoke inhalation. The LKA fire unit is investigating for suspected negligent arson.

title: Polizei warnt vor falschen Pflegedienstmitarbeitenden
summary: Police warn of a rise in distraction thefts in which two women posing as care service staff enter seniors' homes and steal money and valuables. No specific incident is described; residents are advised not to open doors to unknown visitors.

title: Versuchte gefährliche Körperverletzung nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: After a car hit a six-year-old girl's side mirror in Lichtenberg, a 44-year-old man ran at the driver with a box cutter, and a police officer drew his weapon and ordered him to drop it. The man was arrested and charged with attempted dangerous bodily harm and threatening with a weapon.

title: Durchsuchungen und Festnahme wegen Raubtat am S-Bahnhof Karlshorst
summary: Follow-up to a robbery and assault on a 31-year-old man at Karlshorst S-Bahn station on 9 May 2026: five suspects aged 14 to 21 were searched, and one 21-year-old was arrested. The investigation continues.

title: Schussabgabe in Spätkauf-Geschäft
summary: An unknown man entered a late-night shop in Charlottenburg, asked the 20-year-old employee if he worked there, and fired a shot into the floor after the employee confirmed it. The suspect then fled and the employee was unhurt.

title: Vermisste 18-Jährige tot aufgefunden
summary: An 18-year-old woman reported missing since 16 June 2026 from Wilmersdorf was found dead; police see no sign of a crime. The initial appeal had been published on 17 June 2026.

title: Festnahmen nach räuberischer Erpressung von Jugendlichen
summary: Two men, aged 15 and 20, allegedly threatened two 16-year-old school travellers near Alexanderplatz station, forced them to a nearby basketball court and took their wallets and phones. Both suspects were arrested shortly afterwards and part of the loot was recovered.

title: Raubüberfall auf Bordell
summary: An unknown man threatened six employees with a firearm at a brothel in Gesundbrunnen at about 3 a.m., forced a worker to open the cash register and took cash, phones and a backpack. The women were not injured.

title: Mann durch Flaschenwurf verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old man was hit on the back of the head by a thrown glass bottle in Nibelungenpark after an insult, reportedly linked to his party membership. The Staatsschutz is investigating for dangerous bodily injury.

title: Kind nach Unfall in Krankenhaus
summary: A 46-year-old driver hit a five-year-old cyclist while turning left in Mahlsdorf on the morning of the 30th. The child was pulled out from under the car and taken to hospital.

title: Schwerer Landfriedensbruch nach Fußball-WM-Aus
summary: After a World Cup public viewing at Uber Platz ended with Germany's elimination, scuffles and bottle throwing broke out and police made seven arrests. Two officers were slightly injured and pepper spray was used against a crowd.

title: Explosion auf Betriebsgelände – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: An explosion occurred on the premises of a car dealer in Zehlendorf, with an unknown person reportedly throwing an object over the fence. Several vehicles and a building were damaged, and nobody was hurt; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Gemeinsame Präventionsaktion im ÖPNV im Juli 2026
summary: Joint police and Bundespolizei prevention campaign on public transport security, with information stands at several S-Bahn and train stations in July 2026. Topics include civil courage, pickpocketing protection and victim support.

title: Tätlicher Angriff und Widerstand - mehrere verletzte Einsatzkräfte
summary: A 38-year-old man resisted police in Prenzlauer Berg, punching an officer in the face and climbing onto a patrol car roof before being arrested. Twelve officers were treated for irritation to the airways and eyes, and two police cars were damaged.

title: Polizeibeamtin bei Einsatz angegriffen und verletzt
summary: After a dispute involving a taxi driver, a 43-year-old woman allegedly insulted the driver in a xenophobic manner and then punched a police officer in the face at a hotel. The officer was injured and treated at a hospital; the woman was arrested.

title: Festnahmen nach räuberischer Erpressung und Schussabgabe – BAO Ferrum ermittelt
summary: Masked men threatened a bistro employee with a gun and demanded money; a shot was fired during a scuffle before they fled. Four suspects aged 23 to 28 were arrested.

title: Mann nach wechselseitiger gefährlicher Körperverletzung notoperiert
summary: A 42-year-old man was attacked by a group in a street fight, kicked and punched to the ground, and taken to hospital where he underwent emergency surgery. One suspect was arrested and released after identity checks.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe beschlagnahmt
summary: Police arrested a 32-year-old man carrying a loaded real handgun after witnesses reported him holding a firearm near Paul-Lincke-Ufer. The weapon and a folding knife were seized, and no further weapons were found in a search of his apartment.

title: Sicherheitskooperation (SiKoop) der Länder führt gemeinsame Aktionswoche gegen Straftaten zum Nachteil von älteren Menschen (SÄM) durch
summary: Berlin and four other German states launch a joint action week from 29 June to 5 July 2026 against crimes targeting older people, including fraud and distraction theft. Police Berlin are offering more than 40 prevention events citywide.

title: Busfahrer verletzt und mit Reizstoff besprüht
summary: Three unknown people boarded a replacement S9 bus near Adlershof station and refused to leave when asked by the driver. One of them punched the 67-year-old driver in the head and sprayed irritant spray in his face.

title: Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An eleven-year-old on an e-scooter collided with a car on Daumstraße in Haselhorst and was injured. The driver was not hurt.

title: Vermisste 16-Jährige wieder da
summary: A 16-year-old girl who had left a shelter in Pankow on 24 June 2026 has been found safe and is back with her family. The police had earlier appealed for public help in the search.

title: Mann erleidet Stichverletzung und Augenreizung – mutmaßlicher Täter flüchtet
summary: A 33-year-old man was pepper-sprayed and stabbed in the upper body during an argument outside a supermarket in Prenzlauer Berg. The suspect fled with a female companion.

title: Aus Hochzeitskorso heraus mit Waffe bedroht
summary: During a wedding convoy in Kaulsdorf in the early morning, a driver allegedly threatened a passenger in another car with a blank-firing gun, which he loaded before driving on. Police arrested the 20-year-old driver and seized an unloaded starter pistol and ammunition.

title: Versammlungsgeschehen zu einem angezeigten Aufzug anlässlich des 10. Muharram
summary: A registered procession ("Aschura-Marsch") with up to about 600 participants ran from the Berliner Dom to Gendarmenmarkt. Police banned a re-enactment involving children, several people needed medical care for heat-related illness, and the event remained peaceful.

title: Gefährliche Körperverletzung nach Streit – Mann mit Stichverletzung im Krankenhaus
summary: After an argument at a refugee accommodation in Alt-Hohenschönhausen, a 39-year-old man was stabbed and taken to hospital by rescue services. The two unknown attackers fled.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Polizeibeteiligung
summary: A police vehicle using emergency rights collided with a car at a junction in Kreuzberg shortly after noon. Two police officers were taken to hospital for outpatient treatment; the driver of the car was unhurt.

title: Angeschossener Jugendlicher im Krankenhaus
summary: A 17-year-old was shot on the pavement in Holsteinische Straße in Steglitz and is in critical condition; the unknown shooter fled. Homicide investigators are handling the case as an attempted killing.

title: Streit eskaliert – Mann mit Stichverletzung im Krankenhaus
summary: After an argument between a man and two unknown people, one of them stabbed a 25-year-old in the groin. The victim was taken to hospital and underwent emergency surgery.

title: Angriff auf Passanten endet mit DEIG-Einsatz
summary: Early in the morning a 37-year-old man allegedly attacked passers-by with stones and sticks in Charlottenburg, and resisted arrest, after which police used a DEIG. No one was reported injured.

title: Queerfeindlicher Angriff
summary: Two unknown men attacked two people, aged 30 and 31, at a junction in Kreuzberg after insulting one of them, causing head and scrape injuries. The Staatsschutz is investigating the queer-hostile attack.

title: Gegenseitig beleidigt und geschlagen
summary: Two groups insulted each other with xenophobic remarks and then fought at a snack bar in Hellersdorf overnight. Four people were treated at the scene for minor injuries, and a specialist unit took over the investigation.

title: Fußgängerin unter Straßenbahn eingeklemmt
summary: A 16-year-old pedestrian was trapped under a tram after a collision at a crossing in Adlershof. She was seriously injured, taken to hospital, and is no longer in life-threatening danger; the tram driver was treated for shock.

title: Geparktes Fahrzeug in Brand geraten – zwei weitere beschädigt
summary: A parked car caught fire in Rudow overnight and two other parked cars nearby were damaged. Nobody was injured; a fire investigation unit is examining the cause.

title: Radfahrer bei Sturz verletzt
summary: A 62-year-old cyclist fell after missing a curb while overtaking other cyclists on the bike lane of Frankfurter Allee. He was taken to hospital with upper-body and head injuries.

title: Fahrradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 22-year-old cyclist fell from his bicycle on the Dudenstraße cycle path in Kreuzberg for unknown reasons and suffered serious head injuries. He was treated by an emergency doctor and taken to hospital.

title: Mutmaßlichen Einbrecher festgenommen
summary: A 29-year-old rental car business owner found an intruder in the business premises at night, and the intruder fled through a window. A 43-year-old suspect was arrested nearby shortly afterwards.

title: Mann nach Gewalttat gesucht – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: Police are seeking an unidentified suspect over a dispute on 29 April 2025 near the Alexanderplatz S-Bahn station in which a 36-year-old was stabbed in the thigh by a group. The suspect is described by police and images from a surveillance camera were released.

title: Fußgänger nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: A 35-year-old pedestrian was hit by a car at a crossing in Moabit on 16 June 2026 and later died in hospital from his injuries. The car driver and his passenger were not hurt.

title: Fußgängerin nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A motorcyclist collided with two pedestrians crossing Alt-Friedrichsfelde at a pedestrian crossing late at night. One pedestrian, a man, died at the scene and an 85-year-old woman later died in hospital; the motorcyclist was also seriously injured.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: A BVG bus swerved onto the pavement while turning and hit a lamppost, which fell onto passers-by. Several people were injured, two of them seriously enough to be taken to hospital.

title: Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A six-year-old girl stepped out between parked cars on Alt-Moabit and was hit by a passing car. She was taken to hospital with pelvic and head injuries.

title: Tötungsdelikt in Bäckerei – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 61-year-old man was fatally stabbed at a bakery in Wedding on the evening of 10 June 2026. A 28-year-old suspect was arrested on 19 June and remains in custody on suspicion of manslaughter.

title: Auf Tauben geschossen – mehrere Druckluftwaffen beschlagnahmt
summary: A man is suspected of shooting pigeons in his residential building in Charlottenburg. Police searched his flat and seized more than ten air guns, magazines and ammunition.

title: Nach Auseinandersetzung und Widerstand – DEIG eingesetzt
summary: A 25-year-old man threatened a café employee, then was beaten by three men who came to the scene. During the police operation, officers were attacked and a stun device was used against one suspect.

title: Sprengstoffexplosion – BAO Ferrum ermittelt
summary: Unknown perpetrators detonated an explosive device in front of an apartment building in Malplaquetstraße shortly after 2 a.m., damaging the facade, a shop window and several parked cars. No one was injured; the BAO Ferrum task force is investigating.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Fahrzeug der Berliner Feuerwehr - Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A car collided with a Berlin fire brigade fire engine responding to an emergency at the Fehrbelliner Platz junction on 20 June 2026. Two civilians and several firefighters were treated, and police are seeking witnesses and video footage.

title: Tankstelle überfallen
summary: Two unknown men entered a petrol station in Lankwitz shortly before 2 a.m., threatened a 26-year-old cashier with a knife and took money from the till. They sprayed him with pepper spray before fleeing on a scooter.

title: Sechs Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall – Säugling in Lebensgefahr
summary: A rental car turning on Roedernallee collided with another car in the evening; six people were hurt, including a one-month-old baby with life-threatening head injuries. The road was closed for about five hours.

title: Ermittlungen nach rassistischen und antisemitischen Vorfällen beim Deutschlandspiel
summary: During a World Cup match broadcast outside a convenience store in Prenzlauer Berg, a man made racist and antisemitic remarks and showed a far-right gesture, and was reported for incitement. Police are continuing their investigation.

title: Politiker an Informationsstand mit Eiern beworfen
summary: A member of the Berlin House of Representatives was hit by an egg thrown from an e-scooter at a party information stand. He declined medical treatment, and the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Antisemitischer Angriff – Geschlagen und bespuckt
summary: A 31-year-old man allegedly insulted, spat at and attacked several people in an antisemitic incident in Charlottenburg in the afternoon. No one required medical treatment, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Mann bei Raub verletzt
summary: Two unknown men knocked a 37-year-old man to the ground and took his bag, then kicked him in the head when he tried to get it back. He was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Auto in Gegenverkehr geschleudert – drei Verletzte
summary: A car collided with another at a junction with traffic lights switched off and was thrown into oncoming traffic, hitting a waiting VW. Three people were treated in hospital for injuries.

title: Frau geschlagen, getreten und fremdenfeindlich beleidigt
summary: A 23-year-old woman was grabbed by the hair, punched and kicked by two unknown men and insulted in a xenophobic manner, and became unconscious at home. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Bei schwerem Raub verletzt
summary: An 18-year-old man was attacked by four men in Lindauer Allee, one of them carrying pepper spray, and robbed of cash and his mobile phone. He was injured badly enough to need hospital treatment.

title: Polizeikontrolle entzogen und Verkehrsunfälle verursacht
summary: A 19-year-old driver without a licence evaded a police traffic check on the A100 in Wilmersdorf and caused several collisions while fleeing. He was briefly detained and released after his identity was established.

title: Angegriffen, randaliert und Einsatzfahrzeug beschädigt
summary: Two men aged 44 and 47 allegedly rioted at a youth facility, attacked a carer and a passer-by, and resisted arrest, damaging two police vehicles. Police officers were not injured.

title: Mann in hilflosem Zustand noch nicht identifiziert - Polizei bittet erneut um Mithilfe
summary: Police renewed their appeal for help identifying a man, estimated 50 to 65 years old, found in a helpless state in March 2025 in Steglitz and still unidentified. The man was using a wheelchair.

title: Drei Verletzte Personen nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: A car collision at the Danziger Straße/Prenzlauer Allee junction injured three people, including a 52-year-old cyclist who was thrown onto the road and briefly lost consciousness. The driver of a car struck by the impact lost control and hit the cyclist.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach mutmaßlichem Driftmanöver
summary: A 22-year-old driver allegedly attempted a drift on the A100, lost control, and crashed into parked cars. Two other people were injured, one of them trapped between vehicles.

title: Bekämpfung der Schusswaffenkriminalität – BAO Ferrum und EG Telum stellen bei Durchsuchungen fünf scharfe Schusswaffen sicher
summary: Police and prosecutors executed eleven search warrants against 13 suspects over illegal arms trading and extortion, seizing five firearms, drugs and cash. Three suspects were arrested.

title: Schüsse auf eine Gaststätte in Tempelhof
summary: Bullet holes were found in the facade of a restaurant in Tempelhof after a witness heard gunshots around 2:40 a.m. No one was inside and no one was hurt. A special investigation unit has taken over the case.

title: Reizstoff in Linienbus versprüht – Mehrere Fahrgäste verletzt
summary: During a dispute on a BVG bus in Gropiusstadt, a 33-year-old man sprayed irritant spray, injuring nine passengers, two of them children. The injured were treated at the scene and released.

title: Gebissen und Widerstand geleistet – zwei Polizeibeamte verletzt
summary: Police were called to a threat in an apartment on Schillerstraße and a 30-year-old man resisted officers, biting one officer. Two police officers were injured, one requiring hospital treatment.

title: Allgemeinverfügung anlässlich des zweiten nationalen Veteranentages – Einschränkungen im Berliner Regierungsviertel
summary: Police issued a general order with security measures and road closures in the government district in Mitte for the second national Veterans Day on 21 June 2026, from 8 to 20 hours. Parking and public assemblies are prohibited in the marked areas.

title: Seniorin bei Bremsmanöver in Linienbus verletzt
summary: A bus driver braked suddenly in Lichtenrade and an 85-year-old woman fell inside the bus, suffering serious head injuries. She was taken to hospital.

title: Einbrecher mithilfe des DEIG festgenommen
summary: A 29-year-old suspected burglar forced entry into an apartment and armed himself with a kitchen knife. Officers used a stun device (DEIG) to arrest him, and he was taken to hospital.

title: Randalierer im Kaufhaus festgenommen
summary: A 43-year-old intoxicated man became aggressive in a department store restaurant, throwing items and challenging staff. He resisted police, biting and headbutting officers, who suffered light injuries.

title: Flasche auf Einsatzwagen geworfen
summary: A glass bottle thrown from an elevated railway platform struck a police vehicle in Kreuzberg, causing scratches but no injuries. A 19-year-old suspect was detained and found to have 1.8 per mille alcohol.

title: Israelfeindliche Farbschmiererei
summary: Two anti-Israel graffiti were found on the forecourt of Wittenbergplatz U-Bahn station in the evening and were made illegible by police. The state security unit took over the investigation.

title: Festnahme nach bewaffnetem Raubüberfall
summary: A 22-year-old man was arrested in Adlershof for allegedly robbing a fast-food restaurant at gunpoint, taking a cash box. He also allegedly forced a driver at gunpoint to take him away.

title: Durchsuchungen und Haftbefehle wegen bandenmäßiger Urkundenfälschung
summary: Police and prosecutors searched 14 residences across Berlin and arrested five suspects in a gang-related investigation into forged language certificates. Cash, certificates, printers and data devices were seized.

title: Mann leistet nach Verkehrsunfallflucht Widerstand gegen Einsatzkräfte
summary: After a hit-and-run traffic accident in Britz, a 54-year-old driver resisted police officers who detained him in a parking lot. A police officer was slightly injured and no one else was hurt in the collision.

title: Mit Schreckschusswaffe vom Balkon geschossen
summary: Several shots were fired from a balcony with a blank-firing gun (Schreckschusswaffe) in Niederschöneweide. Police seized the weapon, magazine and cartridges from the flat's residents, who are being investigated under weapons law.

title: Polizei Berlin erlässt Allgemeinverfügung zum 17. Juni 2026
summary: Police issued a general order restricting assemblies and events at the memorial for Polish victims of Nazi rule in Berlin-Mitte on 17 June 2026, to protect the commemoration. The order runs from 6:00 to 22:00 that day.

title: Mehrere Fahrzeuge in Brand gesetzt
summary: Six company vehicles were set on fire on the fenced premises of a telecommunications company in Alt-Hohenschönhausen overnight. A fire brigade unit extinguished them, and arson is being investigated by a LKA fire unit.

title: Mit einem Einsatzwagen zusammengestoßen und verletzt
summary: A motorcyclist fleeing police at high speed ran red lights and crashed into a police vehicle that had blocked the road. The 22-year-old suffered a leg graze and was treated at the scene.

title: Festnahme nach Verdacht des unerlaubten Handels mit Betäubungsmitteln
summary: Police arrested a 36-year-old suspected drug dealer who barricaded himself in his flat in Oberschöneweide after a cannabis plantation was found. More than 5 kg of cannabis was seized in the flat.

title: Mann erlitt Stichverletzungen
summary: A 60-year-old man was stabbed several times at a used car dealership after a brief sales conversation with an unknown person, who then fled toward Schöneberg S-Bahn station. The victim was taken to hospital and admitted.

title: Frau mit Kopftuch fremdenfeindlich beleidigt und mit Messer bedroht
summary: A 59-year-old woman allegedly insulted a 53-year-old woman in a xenophobic way in a supermarket car park and made stabbing movements with a knife. The suspect was arrested, the knife was seized, and the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Mann bei Auseinandersetzung verletzt – drei Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: A 28-year-old man was attacked by a group in a snack bar in Wedding after an argument and suffered a stab wound to the thigh. Three suspects were arrested nearby; the snack bar owner was pepper-sprayed.

title: Bewaffneter Überfall auf Schnellrestaurant
summary: A masked man entered a fast-food restaurant at night, demanded the cash register be opened at gunpoint, and fled with the cash drawer contents. The gun did not fire and nobody was hurt.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse wegen Erpressung vollstreckt
summary: Police executed several search warrants in Tempelhof, Hellersdorf and Kreuzberg in a case of attempted aggravated extortion, seizing two firearms, ammunition, drugs and phones. Three suspects aged 23 and 44 were arrested.

title: Vorläufige Festnahme nach Schussabgabe
summary: Multiple gunshots were reported at a traffic island in Gesundbrunnen on Wednesday evening; police found cartridge cases and live rounds and arrested a 17-year-old nearby. The teenager was later released after identification procedures.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: A twelve-year-old boy was hit by two cars on Forckenbeckstraße in Schmargendorf in the late afternoon. He was seriously injured and taken to hospital; the investigation continues.

title: Notoperation nach Angriff mit Messer
summary: A 43-year-old man allegedly stabbed a 39-year-old man in an apartment in Marzahn overnight; the victim was seriously injured and underwent emergency surgery. The suspect was arrested.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 45-year-old driver rear-ended a stopped Land Rover at a red light in Wilmersdorf while apparently under the influence of alcohol and drugs. Four people were injured, and the driver's blood sample was taken.

title: Mit Stichwunden zurückgelassen
summary: A 19-year-old was attacked by a group of people at Cottbusser Platz in Hellersdorf and left with several stab wounds. He was taken to hospital and underwent emergency surgery.

title: Netzwerk aufgedeckt - Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse gegen den illegalen Handel mit Betäubungsmitteln vollstreckt
summary: Police and prosecutors searched 16 properties in Berlin, Saxony and Brandenburg over a drug-dealing network supplying cocaine and cannabis. Four people were arrested and about 1.3 kg of cocaine, 20 kg of cannabis and other drugs were seized.

title: Widerstand geleistet – Distanz-Elektroimpulsgerät (DEIG) eingesetzt
summary: After a report of a bill-evasion, trespass and threats at a bar, police arrested three men; two resisted handcuffing and were subdued with a conducted energy device. Several officers and both arrested men were lightly injured.

title: Not-OP nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: A moped rider was seriously injured in a collision with a car at a junction in Schöneberg. He was taken to hospital for emergency surgery.

title: Festnahme nach Taschendiebstahl
summary: An 18-year-old was arrested after being seen pickpocketing an 89-year-old man's wallet at Frankfurter Tor subway station. The wallet was returned to the victim, and pepper spray was found on the suspect.

title: Ein Tatverdächtiger nach räuberischem Diebstahl identifiziert
summary: Police identified one suspect in a December 2025 robbery at Grenzallee subway station, where a 53-year-old man was pickpocketed and knocked to the ground after he held one suspect. The search for the second suspect continues.

title: Verstorbene Person nach Wohnungsbrand
summary: A fire broke out in a ground-floor flat in an apartment building in Wittenau in the night; firefighters found one man dead inside. The building is uninhabitable, residents were evacuated and several people were injured.

title: Trickbetrug durch falsche Polizeibeamte – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?
summary: Police are seeking the public's help to identify a suspect in a fake-police-officer fraud committed on 18 September 2025 in Biesdorf. One of two men shown in the appeal has been ruled out; the other is still being sought.

title: Kind angefahren – Fahrzeugführer flüchtet vom Unfallort
summary: A car driver struck a seven-year-old girl crossing Willdenowstraße and then left the scene before emergency services arrived. The child suffered a head wound and knee pain and was taken to hospital.

title: Fahrradfahrerin fährt Kind an
summary: A 29-year-old cyclist hit a five-year-old girl who had run between parked cars into the road in Grunewald in the evening. The child suffered a broken leg and the cyclist was also injured.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Fahrradfahrer und Motorradfahrer
summary: A motorcyclist and a cyclist collided at a pedestrian crossing on Leipziger Straße in the afternoon, and the motorcycle then hit a car. The cyclist was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Diebstahl und Kartenbetrug
summary: Police seek an unknown man who allegedly used a debit card stolen in Berlin in November 2024 for fraudulent payments in several German cities. The card was used in Aurich on 18 November 2024.

title: Fahrzeuge in Flammen
summary: Overnight, a car and a motorhome were burned out and a third car was damaged by fire on Paul-Lincke-Ufer in Kreuzberg. Nobody was injured, and the state criminal police fire unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Vermisster Senior wieder da
summary: An 87-year-old man with dementia who went missing after leaving a hospital in Neukölln on 21 May 2026 has been found safe. The police had appealed for public help in the search.

title: Nach gewalttätigen Ausschreitungen im Olympiastadion - Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: During a football match at the Olympiastadion, a group attacked police officers with thrown objects, injuring several officers. Police are seeking public help to identify the unknown suspects shown in images.

title: Fahrradfahrer und E-Scooter-Fahrer verunfallt
summary: A cyclist overtaking an e-scooter rider on a bike path collided with them, and both fell. The 48-year-old cyclist was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Festnahme nach Räderdiebstahl
summary: Two men were seen removing wheels from a parked car in Mitte and fled in a rental vehicle. A 19-year-old suspect was later arrested at his Neukölln flat after a search.

title: Feuer in Sporthalle
summary: A fire broke out in a school sports hall in the Märkisches Viertel on Saturday evening, causing heavy damage. Nobody was hurt; the Landeskriminalamt fire investigation unit has taken over the case.

title: Steine von Autobahnbrücke getreten
summary: A 73-year-old person was arrested after allegedly dropping paving stones from a bridge onto the A100 motorway and threatening a witness with a stone. No vehicles were hit.

title: Mehrere Einsatzkräfte angegriffen und verletzt
summary: After a man ran into the road and forced an emergency vehicle to brake hard, several people attacked and injured police officers during his arrest. Five officers were hurt but remained on duty; four people were detained.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A motorcyclist was injured at about 11 a.m. after overtaking in a bus and tram lane and colliding with a waiting car in Pankow. The 60-year-old was flown to hospital by rescue helicopter, and the other driver, aged 24, was also hurt.

title: Bei Verkehrsunfall lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: A 33-year-old pedestrian was seriously injured after being hit by a BVG bus on Goerzallee in Lichterfelde. She had crossed the road at a construction site without watching the traffic.

title: Besonders schwerer Landfriedensbruch
summary: Overnight, a dispute between two men escalated on Reichenberger Straße into a brawl involving about 30 people, with bottles and stones thrown. Police used pepper spray, lightly injuring two bystanders, and arrested three men.

title: Einsatzwagen der Polizei verunglückt – acht Verletzte
summary: A police patrol car ran a red light at an intersection with Wilhelmstraße and collided with a taxi, overturning. Eight people, seven of them police officers, were injured, most treated as outpatients.

title: Mann flüchtet im Auto vor Polizeikontrolle - Festnahme
summary: A 34-year-old man fled a traffic stop by car at high speed across several districts, running red lights, driving on a pavement and crashing into objects before being arrested. Police found a blank-firing gun, stolen-suspected scooters and suspected burglary tools in the car.

title: Mann geschlagen und getreten - Festnahme
summary: A 28-year-old man allegedly punched and kicked a 38-year-old man in the head on Müggelheimer Straße, causing a jaw fracture and other injuries. The suspect was arrested nearby and released after identification measures.

title: Sachbeschädigung an Zugangstor zum Görlitzer Park
summary: Unknown persons smeared a substance into the lock cylinder of an entrance gate to Görlitzer Park, preventing it from closing. The state security unit has taken over the investigation for property damage.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 56-year-old driver turned left and hit an 85-year-old pedestrian at a crossing in Niederschönhausen. The pedestrian died of her head injuries in hospital the following night.

title: Stichverletzung erlitten
summary: After an argument in an apartment in Haselhorst, a 28-year-old allegedly stabbed a 24-year-old in the leg. The injured man was taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries; the suspect was arrested and later released.

title: Ermittlungen gegen eine Dienstkraft der Polizei Berlin wegen des Verdachts eines Gewaltdelikts
summary: The LKA is investigating an off-duty Berlin police officer over suspected involvement in a violent altercation in Westend at the start of the year. Investigations into the exact circumstances are ongoing.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach medizinischem Notfall
summary: A 67-year-old driver suffered a medical emergency at the wheel and crashed into two vehicles on Mariendorfer Damm; he died at the scene despite resuscitation attempts. Three other people were slightly injured or unhurt.

title: Schussabgaben auf Personen – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Several shots were fired at a man near a playground in Kreuzberg on the evening of 25 May 2026, and further shots were reportedly fired in Graefestraße. The man was not injured; police are investigating with the homicide unit and appealing for witnesses.

title: Schwangere Beifahrerin nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus
summary: A 25-year-old driver crossed into oncoming traffic on Osdorfer Straße in Lichterfelde and collided with an electric car. Three people were hurt, including a pregnant passenger who was taken to hospital.

title: Festnahme nach Schüssen mit einer Schreckschusswaffe
summary: A man was arrested after firing two shots, apparently with a blank-firing gun, outside a restaurant in Wannsee. Nobody was hurt, and the 26-year-old was released at the scene pending a weapons law investigation.

title: Nach Fahrstreifenwechsel mitgeschleift – Kradfahrer im Krankenhaus
summary: A truck changing lanes on Seestraße struck and dragged a motorcyclist, who suffered serious leg fractures. The motorcyclist was taken to hospital and the road was closed until about 15:30.

title: Polizeibeamtin angegriffen und verletzt
summary: A 16-year-old driver of a rented car was stopped by police, fled on foot and punched a police officer in the face several times during his arrest. The officer was injured and unable to continue her duty.

title: Mann mit Messer verletzt – Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: A 21-year-old man was stabbed and cut with a knife and attacked with a bicycle lock on Mehringdamm shortly after midnight. Police intervened, arrested two suspects, and the victim underwent surgery but is not in mortal danger.

title: Spezialeinsatzkräfte nehmen bewaffneten Mann fest
summary: Special forces arrested a 37-year-old man who had allegedly gone door to door in an apartment block with a weapon. A search of his flat found replica guns, machetes, fireworks and suspected narcotics.

title: Durchsuchungen wegen Verdachts des Menschenhandels und der Arbeitsausbeutung
summary: Police, prosecutors and customs searched three addresses in Mitte, Friedrichshain and Kreuzberg over suspected human trafficking for labour exploitation of Indian specialty cooks. Four workers were found at a kitchen and accommodation site, which was closed due to hygiene and fire safety defects.

title: Frauen sexuell belästigt und Dienstwagen beschädigt – Festnahme
summary: A 45-year-old man tampered with a police vehicle in Bismarckstraße, then sexually harassed women, including near a police station, and injured an officer during re-arrest. He was taken to a psychiatric unit.

title: Auseinandersetzung im Volkspark – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: During an argument in Volkspark Hasenheide, a man was stabbed several times with a knife, and a 48-year-old who came to help was also stabbed. The 60-year-old is in life-threatening condition, and the 48-year-old in critical condition, and the 7th Homicide Commission is investigating.

title: Motorradfahrer lebensbedrohlich verletzt
summary: A car driver collided with a motorcyclist at the Markgrafenstraße/Französische Straße crossing in Mitte. The 60-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured, with life-threatening injuries initially assumed.

title: Fahrzeuge mit Steinen beworfen – Mann festgenommen
summary: A heavily intoxicated man allegedly threw paving stones at passing vehicles, damaging a car driven by a 36-year-old woman. He was arrested after being found to be wanted for unlawful residence.

title: Verdächtige Männer festgenommen
summary: Police arrested two men aged 18 and 19 near a bank branch in Marzahn after a resident reported them as suspicious, masked and on bicycles. A blank-firing gun, a kitchen knife and balaclavas were seized; the investigation for attempted aggravated robbery continues.

title: Zwei Männer durch Schüsse verletzt – Zielfahndung nimmt einen Tatverdächtigen fest
summary: A suspect in a March 2026 shooting in Kreuzberg that injured two men was arrested in Schöneberg and placed in custody. The investigation continues.

title: Mit Auto der Mutter vor Polizei geflüchtet
summary: A 17-year-old drove his mother's car at high speed and ran red lights to evade police, then fled on foot from the scene. He was found shortly after and faces charges of illegal street racing and traffic offences.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 39-year-old pedestrian crossing Gürtelstraße was hit by a car and suffered serious internal injuries. He was taken to hospital, and the road was closed to traffic for about 1.5 hours.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: An 80-year-old driver hit an eight-year-old boy on a pedestrian crossing on Teltower Damm in Zehlendorf. The child was taken to hospital with back, hip and face injuries and suspected internal injuries.

title: Vermisstes Kind dank Zeugenhinweis angetroffen und Ex-Lebensgefährten der Mutter festgenommen
summary: A two-year-old boy reported missing since 29 May 2026 was found on the U3 subway line at Schlesisches Tor after a witness recognized him. A former partner of the mother was arrested and will be brought before an investigating judge.

title: Frau getreten und rassistisch beleidigt
summary: A 32-year-old woman was involved in an argument that turned physical in the early morning. A 41-year-old man then kicked her while she lay on the ground, and a second man made racist insults; the suspects are investigated for a possible hate crime.

title: Mutmaßliches Gewaltverbrechen – Zweiter Tatverdächtiger in Untersuchungshaft
summary: A second suspect, aged 32, was remanded in custody over the abduction of a man in Waidmannslust on 23 April 2026. The police now investigate a homicide after a male body was found in a wooded area near Potsdam on 22 May.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Radfahrern – Beteiligter entfernt sich vom Unfallort
summary: A cyclist was injured in a collision with an unknown cyclist who came off the pavement onto the road and then fled the scene. The injured 43-year-old underwent emergency surgery.

title: Motorradfahrer und Sozia bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car and a motorcycle collided at a junction in Hermsdorf. A motorcyclist and his pillion passenger were injured and taken to hospital, one of them remaining there.

title: Beleidigung mit rassistischem Hintergrund und tätlicher Angriff auf Polizeivollzugsbeamte
summary: A 35-year-old man was arrested in Wedding after repeatedly making racist insults against two women and then resisting officers. A police officer was hurt, and the Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Diebstahl und Computerbetrug
summary: Two unknown suspects allegedly stole two bank cards with PINs sent by post and made transfers and cash withdrawals, including at a cash machine on Hasenheide. The offences ran from 24 January to 3 February 2025.

title: Supermarkt-Mitarbeiter mit Schreckschusswaffe bedroht
summary: A 39-year-old man allegedly pointed a blank-firing gun at a 33-year-old supermarket employee in Rosenthal and was arrested. Police also found further weapons, suspected drugs and cannabis plants during a search of his flat.

title: Festnahmen nach Schüssen in die Luft
summary: Shots were fired into the air on Reinickendorfer Straße around 2:30 a.m. Police later found a firearm in a nearby venue on Luxemburger Straße and arrested three men aged 30, 32 and 34.

title: In Auseinandersetzung lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: During a brawl between groups of young men in Wilmersdorf, one 18-year-old was stabbed and seriously injured; a 19-year-old suspect surrendered later. Police investigations are ongoing.

title: Radfahrerinnen zusammengestoßen
summary: Two cyclists, aged 35 and 61, collided head-on on the Tempelhofer Feld and fell. The 61-year-old had serious head injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Tätlicher Angriff auf Einsatzkräfte – DEIG-Einsatz
summary: After a drug-dealing observation, police arrested two 21-year-old men in Friedrichshain; one allegedly threw an e-scooter at an officer, who was lightly injured. A taser was used to overcome resistance.

title: Polizist von flüchtendem Auto angefahren – Schussabgabe
summary: During a police pursuit of a stolen-plate car, a fleeing driver struck an officer with the car's rear, and the officer's service weapon discharged. The officer was treated as an outpatient and the driver fled.

title: Verkehrsunfall während einer Eilfahrt
summary: A Berlin fire engine responding with emergency lights ran a red light at a junction in Wittenau and collided with a motorcyclist. The 30-year-old motorcyclist was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Schüsse auf 23-Jährigen - Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: Four suspects aged 16 to 18 were identified and raided over an attempted killing in which a 23-year-old man was shot in the street on 19 March 2026. Replica guns were seized during the searches, and the homicide unit's investigation continues.

title: Lkw-Fahrer kollidiert mit mehreren geparkten Fahrzeugen
summary: A 49-year-old truck driver allegedly ran a red light on Bismarckstraße and crashed into several parked vehicles, including police vehicles. The driver was injured and taken to hospital; investigators point to a possible medical emergency.

title: Jugendliche bei Verkehrsunfall mit E-Scooter verletzt
summary: A 14-year-old e-scooter rider crashed into a traffic light pole on Roedernallee and was injured. A 13-year-old passenger was unhurt; police also found an insurance violation involving the scooter.

title: Vermisstes Kind wieder da
summary: A 12-year-old girl who left a psychiatric outpatient appointment on 28 May 2026 was reported missing; police later reported her whereabouts known again. She was in a psychological crisis.

title: Festnahmen nach Körperverletzung und Widerstand
summary: A 44-year-old man allegedly punched another 44-year-old man at Alexanderplatz, causing a facial injury. During the arrest, companions resisted police, and a police officer was lightly injured before five people were taken into custody.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit drei Verletzten
summary: A car collision at a junction in Marzahn injured three people on Wednesday morning. One car was thrown into a light pole, and the light pole had to be removed by the fire brigade.

title: Mann bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An ambulance driving with emergency lights and siren collided at an intersection in Schmargendorf with a 79-year-old cyclist, who was injured. The ambulance driver was unhurt; the cause is under investigation.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car driver allegedly ran a red light in Lichtenrade and hit an e-scooter rider on the crossing, who was thrown several metres and injured. The rider was taken to hospital; his life is not in danger.

title: Gefährlicher Eingriff in den Straßenverkehr - Festnahme
summary: A 29-year-old man was arrested after throwing a shoe at a moving car in Köpenick, causing the driver to stop. The suspect resisted arrest, was subjected to a stun device, and had 1.3 per mille alcohol.

title: Bedrohung im Straßenverkehr
summary: After a traffic dispute, a 45-year-old van driver allegedly threatened a 25-year-old motorcyclist with a blank-firing pistol in Karlshorst. Police seized the replica weapon and the driver faces charges for threatening with weapons.

title: Mann nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: An 85-year-old man drove a car through a garden fence and a wall at a T-junction in Köpenick and crashed into a house facade. He died in hospital after the accident; the cause is still under investigation.

title: Mit Schere bedroht – DEIG Einsatz
summary: Police were called to an apartment building where a 33-year-old woman in a mental crisis threatened officers with scissors. Officers used a conducted energy device (Taser) on her, and she was arrested and taken to hospital.

title: Schüsse vor Lokal
summary: After an argument between two groups in Quickborner Straße in Lübars, several shots were fired near a restaurant on the evening before publication. Those involved fled, and police secured several cartridge cases; no injuries have been reported.

title: Antisemitischer Angriff – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Five young men allegedly attacked a 40-year-old man and his 45-year-old companion near Schlesisches Tor, with antisemitic insults and a bag snatch. Police Staatsschutz are seeking witnesses.

title: Mann mit Waffe bedroht
summary: A 45-year-old man allegedly pointed a blank-firing gun at a 41-year-old man in Zehlendorf and insulted him with a homophobic remark, without firing. The Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Fensterscheiben eines Anti-Gewalt-Projekts beschädigt und beschmiert
summary: Windows of an anti-violence project facility in Schöneberg were damaged by a thrown stone and smeared with paint. The Staatsschutz (state security unit) has taken over the investigation.

title: Raub in Lieferdienstfiliale
summary: Two masked men threatened an employee of a fast-food delivery branch with knives shortly after midnight and took cash from the till. The employee was unharmed.

title: Mann erleidet lebensbedrohliche Verletzungen
summary: A 38-year-old man with life-threatening cut and stab wounds arrived at a hospital in Reinickendorf. Police identified a residential home flat in Conradstraße as the suspected scene, and a 37-year-old woman was temporarily detained and later released.

title: DEIG-Einsatz nach gefährlicher Körperverletzung
summary: A 24-year-old man allegedly attacked his 27-year-old brother with a steak knife during a dispute at a house in Falkenhagener Feld, injuring his knee. Police used a taser to arrest the suspect, who was later released.

title: Frau tot in Wohnung aufgefunden – Ehemann festgenommen
summary: A 69-year-old woman was found dead with a gunshot wound in her apartment in Lichtenrade. Her 84-year-old husband was temporarily arrested, and the homicide unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Zeugenaufruf zum Fall der seit 2000 vermissten Sandra Wißmann
summary: A 12-year-old girl disappeared on 28 November 2000 after leaving her home in Kreuzberg; the 5th Homicide Unit treats the case as a probable capital crime and appeals for witnesses. Police are offering a reward of up to 5,000 euros.

title: Verbotenes Kraftfahrzeugrennen – Fahrzeuge beschlagnahmt
summary: Two motorcyclists allegedly raced at high speed on the BAB 113 near Johannisthal and were stopped by police. Both vehicles and driving licences were seized, and two charges for illegal street racing were filed.

title: Schussabgabe auf Bäckerei
summary: Several shots were fired at the front windows of a bakery on Kottbusser Damm early in the morning. Cartridge cases were secured at the scene and nobody was hurt.

title: Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: A car and a motorcycle collided at a junction in Schöneberg shortly after midnight. The 28-year-old motorcyclist suffered life-threatening injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Kinder mit Waffe bedroht – SEK-Einsatz
summary: A 35-year-old man allegedly threatened playing children with a long gun from a balcony after complaining about noise; a special forces unit later entered the flat and seized a rifle without ammunition, knives and cigarettes.

title: Homophob beleidigt und Reizstoff ins Gesicht gesprüht
summary: Three people aged 23, 24 and 29 were insulted in a homophobic way and sprayed in the face with irritant spray by two unknown suspects, who then fled. The Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Reizstoff in Straßenbahn versprüht
summary: Two unknown youths sprayed irritant spray inside a M5 tram in Alt-Hohenschönhausen, injuring about five passengers. The suspects fled at the Gehrenseestraße stop.

title: Hauswand beschmiert – Festnahme
summary: A 34-year-old man was arrested at about 3:20 a.m. while spraying graffiti on a building facade at Genter Straße corner Ostender Straße in Wedding. He was released after a blood test and identification measures, and the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Auf Mann geschossen – Verletzter im Krankenhaus
summary: After an argument on a street in Kreuzberg, a man shot a 25-year-old in the legs and fled. The victim was taken to hospital for treatment.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit anschließendem Fahrzeugbrand
summary: A 21-year-old driver crashed into trees and a road sign in Schmargendorf at around 3 a.m., and the car caught fire after he got out. He was taken to hospital with head injuries; a preliminary breath test showed about 0.8 per mille.

title: Handwerker von Bewohnerin beleidigt, eingesperrt und bedroht
summary: A 63-year-old woman racially insulted a 28-year-old craftsman, blocked his exit and threatened him with a pepper spray device during a repair job. The Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Schüsse auf fahrendes Auto
summary: Shots were fired from a motor scooter at a moving car on Urbanstraße. The occupants were not injured, and the 7th homicide unit is investigating attempted murder.

title: Autodiebe auf frischer Tat festgenommen
summary: Two men aged 33 and 34 were arrested while tampering with a car on Ringbahnstraße in the night; tools and license plates were found in their vehicle. The investigation into attempted vehicle theft continues.

title: Parkbänke mit Farbe beschmiert
summary: Four park benches in Dahlem were found with six Middle East conflict-related slogans sprayed in silver paint. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Tötungsdelikt am Humboldt Forum – letzter Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 20-year-old man died after a group fight at the Humboldt Forum on 12 September 2025, which the 6th Homicide Unit is investigating. The last suspect, a 16-year-old, was arrested in Gesundbrunnen on 21 May 2026 and placed in youth detention.

title: Verdacht des Drogenhandels und illegaler Waffenbesitz
summary: Police arrested two men in Rummelsburg suspected of drug dealing after observing a residential building and a car. Large quantities of cocaine, amphetamine, MDMA, ketamine and other drugs, plus a loaded firearm, ammunition and a knife, were seized from an apartment.

title: Durchsuchungen und Festnahmen nach unerlaubten Handel mit Betäubungsmitteln
summary: Police and prosecutors searched homes, warehouses and an illegal gambling venue in Berlin, Brandenburg, Saxony and Saxony-Anhalt over suspected illegal drug trafficking. Eight suspects were searched and three were arrested.

title: Mann homophob beleidigt und geschlagen
summary: After a verbal dispute on a night bus, a 23-year-old allegedly insulted a 35-year-old man for being gay and punched him in the head. The victim suffered a head wound; the state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Angriff am Alexanderplatz mit transphobem Hintergrund
summary: Two trans people aged 17 and 19 were allegedly insulted and attacked with spit and bottles at Alexanderplatz by three suspects aged 16, 19 and 21. The State Security unit is investigating a transphobic motive.

title: Frau nach schwerem Raub gesucht - Öffentlichkeitsfahndung erledigt
summary: A man was lured into a residential building and robbed by several men; the public appeal for a female suspect has been closed while investigations continue. The incident took place on 26 November 2025.

title: Mahnmal beschmiert
summary: Unknown persons defaced a memorial for the destroyed synagogue and the Holocaust victims of Spandau with wax crayon over recent days. The Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Mit Messer angegriffen und beraubt
summary: A masked attacker cut a 19-year-old convenience store employee in the thigh with a knife as he closed the shop, then demanded cash and fled with the money. The victim was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Schüsse auf Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: Shots were fired at an apartment building in Gesundbrunnen overnight. A bullet hole was found in a living room window the next day; nobody was in the room.

title: Tatverdächtiger nach Messerangriff festgenommen
summary: A 32-year-old suspect was arrested in a shared accommodation in Spandau over a knife attack on a 15-year-old resident during the night of 18 to 19 May. The victim was stabbed in the back, underwent emergency surgery and is not in mortal danger.

title: Mann nach Auseinandersetzung in Wohnung verstorben – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 43-year-old man died after a dispute with a 51-year-old man in an apartment. A suspect was arrested and the homicide unit is investigating.

title: Überfall auf Wechselstube – Tatverdächtiger erkannt
summary: A man attacked an employee at a currency exchange office in S-Bahnhof Alexanderplatz, pinning and choking her while trying to steal cash from a drawer. He fled without the money; the suspect has since been identified.

title: Mutmaßliche Kabeldiebe gefasst
summary: Three men aged 29, 32 and 35 were arrested after being seen carrying cable from a wooded area; police found copper cable and tools in a parked car. The suspected cable thieves were released after identification measures.

title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenhändler nach Flucht vorläufig festgenommen
summary: After fleeing a police traffic check in Köpenick at night, a 30-year-old driver was arrested. Officers seized cocaine, ecstasy and cannabis from his car and a further quantity of drugs from his flat.

title: Kinder bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 78-year-old driver hit two nine-year-old children on scooters who rolled out of a driveway onto the road in Wannsee. Both children were taken to hospital with injuries.

title: Brandstiftung im Gewerbegebiet
summary: Arson at a commercial area in Heinersdorf spread from a warehouse to nearby storage containers and vehicles, producing a large smoke plume. The building owner suffered a minor burn while trying to extinguish the fire.

title: Schüsse auf Unternehmen
summary: Several bullet holes were found in the shop window of a company branch in Turiner Straße overnight. An employee alerted police around 4:30 a.m., and the state police unit BAO Ferrum has taken over the investigation.

title: Wohnung nach mutmaßlichem Betäubungsmittelhandel durchsucht
summary: Police searched an apartment after a man was found with suspected methamphetamine on Wröhmännerstraße, leading to the seizure of suspected narcotics, packaging material, cash and a blank-firing pistol. Four children aged five to nine were present and youth services were informed.

title: Vermisster 53-Jähriger wieder da
summary: A 53-year-old man reported missing after leaving his residential facility on 12 May 2026 has returned safely. He is back at his residence in Schöneberg.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: An 85-year-old driver hit a 6-year-old child who ran between parked cars into the road on Regattastraße in Grünau despite emergency braking. The child suffered a head wound and back injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Erfolgreiche Ortung nach Wohnungseinbruch - Festnahmen
summary: Stolen headphones from a burglary in a flat in Kreuzberg were located via tracking at a hotel in Kaulsdorf, leading to four arrests and the recovery of further suspected stolen goods. Nobody was hurt.

title: Blitzeinbruch in Modegeschäft
summary: Unknown offender rammed a car backwards through the locked entrance of a fashion shop on Kurfürstendamm at night and stole several luxury handbags before fleeing. The police break-in unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Versuchtes Tötungsdelikt – Mordkommission und Staatsanwaltschaft ermitteln
summary: A 61-year-old man was stabbed in the upper body at a shared accommodation in Lichterfelde; a 69-year-old suspect was arrested and the homicide unit is investigating a suspected attempted killing.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Fahrerflucht
summary: A car driver hit a 15-year-old pedestrian on Sonnenallee and drove off without stopping. The girl was taken to hospital with injuries to her arm, leg and head.

title: Durch Messerstich verletzt
summary: After a physical altercation between two men in Danziger Straße, one man was stabbed in the upper body and taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. The other man fled by car.

title: Frau beschädigt Wahlplakat und bedroht Personen mit Holzlatte
summary: A woman damaged an election poster at a party information stand with a wooden batten and threatened a party worker with it. She was arrested after repeatedly stepping onto the roadway, forcing cars to brake or swerve.

title: Mann rassistisch beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: A 39-year-old man was attacked by an unknown woman on Frankfurter Allee and struck in the face with a glass bottle, in an incident the police treat as racially motivated. The suspect fled.

title: Maßnahmen der BAO Ferrum und EG Telum - Schusswaffe bei Wohnungsdurchsuchung gefunden
summary: Police executed a search warrant at an apartment in Kreuzberg suspected of storing firearms, ammunition and narcotics, finding a gun, cocaine and gold bars. A 71-year-old suspect was arrested.

title: Schüsse auf ein Wohnhaus
summary: Several shots were fired at a residential building in Wittenau around 3:25 a.m. The perpetrator or perpetrators fled, and nobody was injured.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall
summary: Two cars collided at the Hasenheide/Jahnstraße crossing in Kreuzberg late at night, injuring four people. One driver was allegedly speeding; all four injured were taken to hospital.

title: Feier unter Bewohnern eskaliert - Mann mit Stichverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: After a party among residents of a shelter, a 38-year-old man was found with multiple stab wounds in his room. Two other men, aged 54 and 59, were detained; they are suspected of dangerous bodily injury.

title: Schwere Körperverletzung und versuchte räuberische Erpressung – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 33-year-old man was stabbed in the neck at a bus stop in Neukölln in the early morning. A 36-year-old suspect later threatened a woman with a knife on a bus in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg and demanded money; he was arrested.

title: Hitlergruß gezeigt – Heranwachsender vorläufig festgenommen
summary: A 19-year-old was temporarily detained in Grünau after allegedly giving the Hitler salute in a group, witnessed by a bystander who alerted police. The state security unit is investigating.

title: DEIG-Einsatz gegen verhaltensauffälligen Mann mit Baseballschläger
summary: A 33-year-old man allegedly threatened a 50-year-old visitor with a baseball bat and locked him in the flat; he was then taken down with a conducted energy device when he advanced on officers. Police also found a bag of suspected narcotics.

title: Festnahme nach mehreren Straftaten und Angriff auf Polizeibeamten
summary: A 20-year-old man was arrested in Rudow after a series of offences, including threats, theft and kicking a police officer during the arrest. The officer was injured and had to end his shift.

title: Durchsuchungen und Haftbefehle wegen bandenmäßigen Drogenhandels
summary: Police and prosecutors raided 17 addresses in Spandau and Neukölln and arrested two suspects in a case of gang-related drug trafficking centred on Münsinger Park. Eleven suspects aged 18 to 29 are under investigation.

title: Radfahrer flüchtet vor Kontrolle und verletzt Polizeikräfte
summary: A cyclist fleeing a traffic check rammed a police officer on the pavement and then kicked and struck officers during his arrest. Two officers were hurt and went off duty after outpatient treatment.

title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlichem Diebstahl aus Fahrzeug
summary: A man damaged several parked cars and broke into one in Britz overnight; he was arrested on a platform at a nearby U-Bahn station with items believed to be stolen. The investigation continues.

title: Seniorin fährt gegen geparkte Autos
summary: An 86-year-old driver crashed into two parked cars while turning left at a junction in Mariendorf. The driver and her 89-year-old passenger were injured and taken to hospital.

title: Sachbeschädigung - Mahnmal beschmiert
summary: Several inscriptions were sprayed on the deportation memorial at Putlitzbrücke in Moabit. The state security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Mit Messer angegriffen und verletzt
summary: After an argument on benches, a 20-year-old was stabbed in the right thigh by a three-person group in Moabit. A 21-year-old passerby who came to help was also injured in the thigh; both were taken to hospital.

title: Radfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 91-year-old cyclist crossing the road was hit by a car driver and suffered serious head injuries. The cyclist was taken to hospital.

title: 56-Jähriger konnte identifiziert werden
summary: An unidentified man who died in March 2026 in a Weißensee clinic has been identified after public tips; a sister confirmed he was 56. Police had earlier appealed for help identifying him.

title: Gestohlener Rucksack führt zu mutmaßlichem Drogenhändler
summary: Police searched a flat after a stolen backpack and tablet were traced there and arrested a 56-year-old man. Over a kilogram of cocaine, hundreds of ecstasy tablets, cannabis, counterfeit money and other items were seized.

title: Frau mit Waffe bedroht – SEK-Einsatz
summary: A 35-year-old woman was threatened with a firearm and insulted from a window in a courtyard. Police later searched the man's flat with a SWAT team and seized a gas pistol and an air-pressure revolver.

title: An Tankstelle Personen angegriffen und Brand verursacht
summary: A 49-year-old woman allegedly attacked customers and staff at a petrol station with a bottle, burned a man with a cigarette, and set fire to spilled petrol at a pump. Firefighters secured the fuel trail; nobody was seriously hurt and no damage occurred.

title: Sachbeschädigung an Synagoge
summary: Police found paint graffiti of about two by eight metres on the roof of a synagogue and damage to its perimeter fence. No political motive has been identified so far.

title: Stein- und Flaschenwürfe auf Einsatzkräfte
summary: A group attacked police officers with stones and bottles at Kottbusser Tor after a suspect was arrested for punching an officer. One officer was injured in the leg and another in the head, hand and knee area.

title: Busfahrer bedroht – Reizgas eingesetzt
summary: An unknown man banged on a BVG bus and threatened the 43-year-old driver, who then used pepper spray against him. The man fled toward Hackescher Markt station.

title: Wahlplakate beschädigt
summary: Overnight, 42 election posters of a party were damaged with an unknown substance in Baumschulenweg. The state security unit (Staatsschutz) is investigating.

title: Achtjähriger bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An eight-year-old boy ran after a ball onto the road in Ruschestraße and was hit by a car driven by a 57-year-old woman. He was taken to hospital with suspected head injury.

title: Fußgängerin beim Rangieren angefahren und verletzt
summary: A 59-year-old driver hit an 86-year-old pedestrian while reversing at a driveway in Rudow. The pedestrian suffered a suspected leg fracture and was taken to hospital.

title: Überfall auf Tankstelle
summary: Three unknown men attacked a 19-year-old employee at a petrol station and stole a safe after she was seized at the back door. The employee was unharmed.

title: Randalierer leistet Widerstand und bespuckt Polizisten
summary: A 27-year-old man who was causing a disturbance was arrested, then kicked at officers, insulted them and spat in an officer's face during transport. One police officer was injured and went off duty.

title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlichem Diebstahl von Autorädern
summary: Two men aged 24 and 29 were arrested at a car park after plainclothes officers saw them tampering with the wheels of an Audi. Tools used for break-ins were seized.

title: Auto angezündet
summary: Unknown perpetrators set fire to a parked Mercedes in Lichtenberg overnight, destroying it and damaging two neighbouring cars. Nobody was hurt; the LKA arson unit is investigating.

title: Tätlicher Angriff auf Polizeibeamte – Distanzelektroimpulsgerät eingesetzt
summary: After a man repeatedly attacked a hostel receptionist and police officers, he was arrested following the use of pepper spray and an electroshock weapon. Several people were slightly injured, including two officers.

title: Paar homophob beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: Two men aged 61 and 57 were insulted in a homophobic manner and attacked in a park in Charlottenburg, suffering injuries. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Wohnungsbrand – Frau tot aufgefunden
summary: A fire broke out in a second-floor apartment in an apartment block in Weißensee. A woman was found dead after the fire was extinguished; no one else was hurt.

title: Vermisste Seniorin nach Hubschraubereinsatz gefunden
summary: A 91-year-old woman missing since 5 May 2026 was found alive in a vehicle in Brandenburg after a helicopter search. She was taken to hospital for examination.

title: Mutmaßlicher Raser beschädigt Polizeifahrzeug und verletzt Polizeibeamten
summary: A 21-year-old allegedly drove a rental car at excessive speed and nearly hit a pedestrian. The unattended car rolled into a parked police vehicle, and an officer was lightly injured during the subsequent arrest.

title: Polizei Berlin erlässt Allgemeinverfügung zum 8. und 9. Mai 2026
summary: Police issued a general order restricting certain symbols, uniforms and songs around Soviet war memorials in Treptow-Köpenick, Mitte and Pankow for 8 and 9 May 2026. The order covers the commemoration days and is not a specific incident.

title: Junge Frau bedroht
summary: A 19-year-old man allegedly threatened a 22-year-old woman after an argument, firing blank cartridges into the ground near her and hitting her in the face. Witnesses alerted police; the woman declined medical treatment.

title: Festnahmen nach Wohnungseinbruch
summary: Police arrested two suspected burglars, aged 27 and 28, inside an apartment in Reichnerweg after a resident reported noises from a neighboring flat. A third suspect fled.
