title: Fußgängerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 42-year-old driver hit a 70-year-old pedestrian turning right onto Hohenzollerndamm in Wilmersdorf. The woman suffered a leg fracture and was taken to hospital.

title: Mann leistet Widerstand bei Festnahme nach Bedrohung
summary: A 30-year-old man who had escaped from a hospital was arrested at a cemetery in Adlershof after resisting, injuring a police officer's arm. He was taken back to the hospital.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Tram – Kind im Krankenhaus
summary: A ten-year-old boy was hit by a tram on Berliner Allee in Weißensee while crossing the tram tracks. He was seriously injured and taken to hospital; the tram driver was also treated.

title: Festnahme nach Schüssen in Neukölln
summary: Police and prosecutors report the arrest of a 20-year-old suspected of shooting two men, aged 27 and 29, in Anita-Berber-Park on 23 April 2026. He was taken into custody on 4 May 2026 and is in pre-trial detention; a second shooting in the park on 2 May is also being examined.

title: Tatverdächtiger identifiziert
summary: A 21-year-old man was punched in the face by a member of a four-person group in Friedrichshain, apparently for homophobic reasons. The suspect has now been identified following a tip, and investigations continue.

title: Bedrohung im öffentlichen Nahverkehr – Tatverdächtiger ermittelt
summary: A suspect is said to have threatened several passengers on the U2 subway line on 17 July 2025 by pointing a weapon-like object at them. A 42-year-old suspect has now been identified after a citizen tip and further investigation; inquiries continue.

title: Geschäftsmann überfallen, Mitarbeiter erleidet Stichverletzung
summary: Two men robbed a businessman of his day's takings in a backpack at gunpoint in Buckow; one assistant was stabbed in the thigh. The assistant was treated and discharged himself from hospital.

title: Rotlicht missachtet – Schweren Verkehrsunfall verursacht
summary: A 36-year-old driver ran a red light at high speed while fleeing the scene of an earlier crash and collided with another car, seriously injuring its 50-year-old driver. The driver was detained and later released.

title: Denkmal beschmiert
summary: Antisemitic graffiti with inflammatory content was found on a stele of the Holocaust memorial and was removed by a security firm. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Streit eskaliert – Distanzelektroimpulsgerät eingesetzt
summary: A 43-year-old man hit a 32-year-old man on the head with a glass bottle in Görlitzer Park, then threatened police with broken bottles and was subdued with a taser. Police took him to hospital for psychiatric care.

title: Seniorin bei Raub verletzt – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 25-year-old man snatched an 83-year-old woman's handbag in Friedenau, injuring her shoulder when she fell. He was later arrested after a witness recognised him.

title: Sachbeschädigung durch Schüsse auf Friseursalon
summary: Shots were fired at a hair salon in Lichtenrade, leaving several bullet holes in the shop front. No one was inside at the time, and the investigation was taken over by a special police unit (BAO Ferrum).

title: Schüsse auf 44-Jährigen – Staatsanwaltschaft Berlin und 6. Mordkommission ermitteln
summary: A 44-year-old man was shot by an unknown gunman in Yorckstraße in Schöneberg around 1:05 a.m. He suffered life-threatening injuries, and the homicide unit is investigating an attempted killing.

title: Fünfköpfige Personengruppe angegriffen
summary: Two unknown attackers sprayed a group of five men with tear gas near Klausenerplatz and stabbed one 27-year-old, then fled by car. One man was hospitalised, two others had eye irritation.

title: Körperliche Auseinandersetzung mit Verletzten
summary: Two men got into a physical fight in a residential building on Eichborndamm, leaving both injured. Police found blood-stained objects, including a knife blade, at the scene.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 59-year-old e-scooter rider was hit by a car at a junction in Mitte on 4 May 2026 and later died of her injuries. The police traffic unit is investigating.

title: Alkoholisierter Mann nach wiederholten Straftaten im Unterbindungsgewahrsam
summary: A 41-year-old man was taken into custody after repeated offences in Tempelhof, including insulting and spitting at a woman, resisting arrest and an antisemitic remark, investigated by the state security unit. He had about 2.5 and later about 2 per mille blood alcohol after an e-bike fall.

title: Auto überschlägt sich – Autofahrerin verletzt
summary: After traffic lights failed at an intersection in Westend, two cars collided and one overturned. The 31-year-old woman driver was taken to hospital, and her dog was also injured.

title: Nach Streit um Grillverbot – Mann verletzt
summary: After a dispute over a barbecue ban in a courtyard, a 36-year-old man was attacked with pepper spray and punched by two men, suffering facial injuries. The suspects fled before police arrived.

title: Unbekannte attackieren Mann und verletzen ihn
summary: A 37-year-old man was attacked by a group of unknown people in Prenzlauer Berg, knocked to the ground and kicked, and his shirt was taken. He lost consciousness briefly and was taken to hospital.

title: Schüsse auf ein Café
summary: An unknown person fired shots at a café in Schöneberg early in the morning and fled. Police found damage to the building façade; nobody was hurt.

title: Radfahrerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car turning left collided with an oncoming cyclist on Nalepastraße in Oberschöneweide. The 63-year-old cyclist was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Homophober und fremdenfeindlicher Angriff in der U-Bahn
summary: A 34-year-old man allegedly harassed a young woman on a U2 train, then slapped and insulted a man with homophobic and xenophobic remarks and kicked a woman. The suspect was arrested and the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Tram – Fußgängerin verletzt
summary: A 55-year-old pedestrian was hit by an M4 tram at the Buschallee stop in Weißensee and taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. The tram driver was treated for shock.

title: Jugendlicher und Mann nach erlittenen Schussverletzungen in Krankenhäusern
summary: Shots were fired in Hermannstraße in Neukölln, leaving a 17-year-old and a 25-year-old with leg gunshot wounds. Both were taken to hospital; the unknown shooter fled and a special investigation unit has taken over.

title: Polizeibeamter von Personengruppe angegriffen und verletzt
summary: A group of about ten people at Volkspark Friedrichshain, illegally grilling, attacked a police officer who had asked them to extinguish the grill, injuring him. Three suspects were detained, and the officer could not continue his duty.

title: Mit Pfefferspray in Moschee gesprüht - Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: Two men entered a mosque in Gesundbrunnen and sprayed animal repellent spray in the hallway and prayer room while about 100 people were present. The suspects were held until police arrived, and one was taken into custody.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit mehreren Verletzten und Schaulustigen
summary: An 81-year-old driver turning at a junction collided with an oncoming car, pushing it into four parked cars and injuring three people. Onlookers later filmed the injured; police opened criminal proceedings for violating personal privacy.

title: Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz zur Versammlungslage am 1. Mai 2026
summary: Police report on the 1 May 2026 assembly situation in Berlin, with over 90 assemblies and more than 70,000 participants, largely peaceful. Police recorded 87 restraint or detention measures, 121 criminal investigations and 15 injured officers.

title: Mann bei Auseinandersetzung verletzt
summary: A 28-year-old man was attacked by a group after an argument outside a bar and suffered stab and cut wounds. He was taken to hospital and underwent emergency surgery; his life is not in danger.

title: Tödlicher Unfall im U-Bahnhof
summary: A 69-year-old man was fatally dragged by a departing U-Bahn train at Gleisdreieck station after trying to hold the doors open with his walking aid. U1 and U3 services were suspended until 7 a.m.

title: Brennende Pkw
summary: Two cars burned out in Niemegker Straße in Marzahn early in the morning, and a third car was damaged by the heat. Nobody was hurt, and a fire investigation unit is investigating.

title: Schüsse auf Haus und Fahrschule
summary: A masked man fired several shots at a house on Magistratsweg around 1:40 a.m. and fled on foot. Nobody was injured; bullet holes were found.

title: Parkscheinautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators blew up a parking ticket machine in Tempelhof overnight. A witness found it damaged around 0:30 and alerted police; a nearby parked car was slightly damaged by flying debris.

title: Fahrradfahrer nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 41-year-old cyclist was killed after a truck turning right ran into him in Rudow. Police traffic investigators took over the case.

title: Vermisster Jugendlicher wieder im Kreis seiner Familie
summary: A 16-year-old boy reported missing since 29 April 2026 was found safe and returned to his mother. He was located after a citizen tip at S-Bahnhof Grünau.

title: Festnahmen und Durchsuchungen nach Drogenhandel
summary: Two alleged drug dealers were arrested in Hellersdorf after an apparent cannabis and cocaine handover, and police seized drugs, cash, a blank-firing gun, knives and about 3,000 prescription tablets in searches. Both suspects were released after identity processing.

title: Festnahme nach Fahrzeugdiebstahl, verbotenem Kraftfahrzeugrennen und mehreren Verkehrsdelikten
summary: A 35-year-old man stole a running delivery van in Köpenick and fled at high speed, causing several crashes and injuring a cyclist. Police fired two shots at the vehicle during his arrest at the stadium car park, and an officer was hurt.

title: Sachbeschädigungen an Zaunanlage des Görlitzer Parks
summary: Police found damage to the fence system at Görlitzer Park overnight, including manipulated locks on two gates. One gate could be secured again with a chain lock; property damage investigation is ongoing.

title: Gefährliche Körperverletzung mit Teppichmesser - Festnahme
summary: After a dispute in a bar, a 33-year-old man allegedly pulled a box cutter on guests who tried to restrain him, cutting two men. He was arrested and faces charges including dangerous bodily injury.

title: Zwölfjähriger Radfahrer bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A twelve-year-old cyclist was injured in a collision with a car at a junction in Lankwitz. The car driver, 41, was not hurt, and police are investigating the traffic light signals.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Fußgänger und Straßenbahn
summary: A 37-year-old pedestrian was hit by a tram on Schönhauser Allee in Prenzlauer Berg after climbing over a pedestrian barrier and stepping onto the road. He was taken to hospital with injuries.

title: Autofahrerin fährt Fußgänger an
summary: An 81-year-old woman driving a Mercedes hit a 32-year-old pedestrian who allegedly crossed on red at the Buschallee / Sulzfelder Straße junction in the evening. The pedestrian was seriously injured and taken to hospital; the driver was unhurt.

title: Tätergruppen schlugen und traten auf Mann ein
summary: Several men attacked a 19-year-old on Scheelestraße and at a nearby playground, beating and kicking him and spraying pepper spray in his face. A witness intervened and the attackers fled.

title: Sachbeschädigungen mit antisemitischem Hintergrund – Wer hat etwas gesehen?
summary: Unknown perpetrators sprayed antisemitic slogans and swastikas on house walls in Ueckermünder Straße over the weekend and on the night of 11 April. The Staatsschutz asks witnesses to come forward.

title: Schüsse auf Autoteilehandel
summary: Several bullet holes were found in the entrance door of an auto parts business in Neukölln in the early morning. Employees alerted police, and officers secured several cartridge casings.

title: Nationalsozialistische Parole gerufen - Festnahmen
summary: Three men allegedly threw glass bottles and shouted a Nazi slogan at Wilmersdorfer Straße; two men aged 68 and 75 were arrested. The State Security unit is investigating the use of banned symbols/slogans.

title: Schüsse auf Fahrschule
summary: An unknown masked man fired several shots at the shop windows of a driving school on Scharnweberstraße at about 2:50 a.m. and fled. Investigators are treating the case as criminal damage.

title: Vielzahl an Straftaten bei Flucht vor Polizei
summary: Men loaded building material from a construction site into a car at night and fled from plainclothes officers, causing several traffic collisions and spraying a fire extinguisher. One 22-year-old driver was arrested after jumping from the moving car; the others escaped.

title: Vormals Gesuchter gilt nicht mehr als vermisst
summary: A 45-year-old man last believed to be in Berlin was reported missing in July 2025; he is no longer considered missing as of the update, with no sign of distress or crime.

title: Ermittlungen wegen des Verdachts des versuchten Mordes - Mordkommission sucht Zeugen
summary: Unknown persons threw an e-scooter from the Hermann-Ganswindt-Brücke onto the BAB 100 motorway, narrowly missing a driver. Homicide investigators are treating it as an attempted killing and seeking witnesses.

title: Handyortung überführt mutmaßlichen Räuber
summary: Two men allegedly robbed a 42-year-old man at gunpoint of his smartphone. One suspect, 26, was arrested after the phone was located, and a starter pistol was seized; the second suspect is still sought.

title: E-Roller-Unfall mit zwei verletzten Kindern
summary: Two 13-year-olds were injured when the e-scooter they were riding crashed on Olympischer Platz after the driver apparently lost control while braking. The scooter had no insurance plate, and a criminal complaint was filed.

title: Fahrzeug geraubt und Unfall verursacht
summary: A 38-year-old man jumped from a moving taxi on the A113 and then grabbed a woman's handbag, knocking her to the ground, before stealing her car and crashing it into bollards. The man was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Unbekannte Person fährt mit Auto Fußgänger an und flüchtet
summary: An unknown driver struck an 83-year-old pedestrian with a car in Moabit around 1 a.m. and fled the scene. The injured man was taken to hospital.

title: Zaunelement am Görlitzer Park beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons damaged a fence section at Görlitzer Park overnight. A security guard alerted police after finding a roughly 2.5 by 3.5 metre damaged area.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Auseinandersetzung mit Machete
summary: After a dispute in Gesundbrunnen involving pepper spray and a machete, three men were seriously injured, one of them with life-threatening head wounds. A 31-year-old was stabbed several times nearby, and all three are being treated in hospital.

title: Radfahrer nach medizinischem Notfall verstorben
summary: A 76-year-old cyclist suffered a medical emergency, fell and later died in hospital. Witnesses gave first aid and attempted resuscitation.

title: Kind von Autofahrer angefahren
summary: A 63-year-old driver hit a 13-year-old girl who ran onto Gardeschützenweg in Lichterfelde. The girl suffered head injuries and abrasions and was taken to hospital; her life is not believed to be in danger.

title: Reizgas in Jugendclub versprüht
summary: Several youths sprayed pepper spray in a youth club in Marzahn, injuring 15 children and teenagers aged 8 to 15, then fled. Police youth unit is investigating the background.

title: Gegen Baum gefahren
summary: A 27-year-old man crashed his car into a tree on Tempelhofer Damm and was seriously injured. Police took a blood sample on suspicion of drug influence and seized the vehicle.

title: Polizist nach Steinwürfen verletzt
summary: Unknown people threw several stones at a police patrol car in Rigaer Straße while officers protected firefighters at a burning lamp post overnight. One officer was injured in the face by shattered windscreen glass.

title: Mann mit Böller beworfen und verletzt
summary: An unknown masked man threw a firecracker at a 21-year-old supermarket security guard in Frankfurter Allee, where it exploded at his feet, injuring him. The man then verbally threatened him and fled.

title: Junge Frau wieder da
summary: A 25-year-old woman with a cognitive impairment, reported missing since 21 April 2026, has been found safe and returned home. The public search has been called off.

title: Unbekannter schießt auf 27-Jährigen – BAO Ferrum und Ermittlungsgruppe Telum ermitteln
summary: A 27-year-old man was grazed in the leg by shots fired by an unknown man in Anita-Berber-Park after a group confronted two men, one of whom drew a pistol. Police are investigating an attempted homicide.

title: Geld geraubt und mehrere Personen mit Pfefferspray verletzt
summary: A 25-year-old allegedly took money from a 22-year-old at Kottbusser Tor subway station after punching him, then pepper-sprayed him and BVG staff when they pursued him. He was arrested inside the station.

title: Festnahmen nach Raubüberfällen auf Spätverkaufsstellen
summary: Two suspects, aged 27 and 29, were arrested in a raid on an apartment in Wedding linked to six armed robberies of late-night shops in Mitte between February and April 2026. Both were remanded in custody.

title: Allgemeinverfügung zum 1. Mai 2026 – Einschränkungen im Bereich Treptower Park
summary: Police issued a general order restricting assemblies in Treptower Park from 1 May 2026, 6 a.m., to 2 May 2026, 6 a.m. The order protects the green space and listed garden monument.

title: Seniorin nach Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An 76-year-old driver leaving a car park collided with an 88-year-old pedestrian on Goltzstraße in Lichtenrade. The pedestrian fell, suffered a head wound and was taken to hospital.

title: Drei verletzte Beamte – Polizeihubschrauber im Einsatz
summary: Up to 20 people gathered around a burning barrel on Rigaer Straße and sprayed fire extinguishers at police officers, injuring three. The Staatsschutz took over the investigation for dangerous bodily harm.

title: Mutmaßlicher Wohnungseinbrecher festgenommen
summary: Police arrested a 22-year-old suspected of breaking into two apartments in a residential building in Alt Hohenschönhausen. Computer accessories linked to one burglary were found in the suspect's car, which was seized.

title: Autofahrer fährt gegen geparkten Pkw
summary: An 87-year-old driver pulled out of a driveway and hit a parked car in Lichterfelde, injuring its 69-year-old user who was unloading items and was pinned between the open door and the car. She suffered a rib fracture and was taken to hospital.

title: Mutter und Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 47-year-old driver allegedly ran a red light at a pedestrian crossing and hit a 28-year-old woman carrying her three-year-old daughter. Both were injured and taken to hospital, the child for inpatient treatment.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse wegen Raubtaten vollstreckt
summary: Police and prosecutors searched homes of six suspects in Berlin over alleged robberies and assaults on people lured through fake chat profiles. A stun gun, a knife and a knuckleduster were seized, and the suspects were released after identification measures.

title: Geschwindigkeitskontrollen im Rahmen der ROADPOL-Aktionswoche „Speedweek“ – Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz
summary: Berlin police report results of a speed control week (13–19 April 2026) at 203 locations, recording 6,732 speeding violations, 58 of them over 31 km/h above the limit. Police also reported 341 other traffic offences and 49 criminal offences.

title: Frau bei Wohnungsbrand verletzt
summary: A fire broke out in a ground-floor flat in an apartment building on Buckower Damm in Britz overnight. A 71-year-old woman was found unconscious in the hallway, resuscitated and taken to hospital with burns.

title: Nach Verkehrsunfall – Fahrradfahrer verstorben
summary: A 65-year-old cyclist who collided with a 14-year-old cyclist at a red light on Mühlenstraße later died in hospital. The 14-year-old was not injured.

title: Auseinandersetzung nach Fußballspiel
summary: After a football match in Hellersdorf, about 20 people attacked two players and a spectator from the visiting team; one attacker tried to hit a player with a fire extinguisher in the changing room, but witnesses stopped it. The injured were 20, 21 and 23 years old and declined medical treatment.

title: Fußballspiel nach mutmaßlich antisemitischer Volksverhetzung abgebrochen
summary: During a football match in Hakenfelde, a spectator allegedly made antisemitic remarks to a player, and the visiting team withdrew, so the referee abandoned the game. The state security unit is investigating.

title: Mit dem Auto überschlagen – Fahrer verletzt
summary: A 61-year-old man lost control of his car on Wilhelmsruher Damm overnight and it overturned, injuring him. Two parked cars were also damaged.

title: Auseinandersetzung mit Reizgas, Messer und Machete
summary: Around 20 people were involved in a brawl in a car park in Genter Straße overnight, with pepper spray and knives used. Three men were injured, one of them with stab wounds to an arm, and one man was arrested.

title: In den Rücken gestochen und ausgeraubt
summary: A 39-year-old man was attacked by several unknown assailants near Mehringbrücke in the night, stabbed in the back and robbed of several hundred euros. Police investigate with the robbery unit.

title: Scharfe Schusswaffe gefunden
summary: Police arrested four suspects after drug sales were observed and searches of a car and two flats found a firearm, cocaine, LSD, ecstasy and cash. The suspects are to be brought before a judge for a custody decision on 20 April.

title: Anwohner beraubt
summary: Two men posing as police officers searched a 20-year-old and a 21-year-old near a garden plot in Marzahn, and one of them pointed a handgun at the 21-year-old and took his wallet. The pair then drove off.

title: Info-Stand einer Partei attackiert
summary: A man took a party flag from an information stand in Köpenick and fled; when party members followed to reclaim it, he pushed two of them, injuring one in the knee. The Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach körperlicher Auseinandersetzung
summary: After a boxing match, relatives of the losing fighter stormed the ring and a physical fight broke out, with pepper spray reportedly used. Nine people aged 11 to 58 reported eye irritation.

title: Verdacht der versuchten gefährlichen Körperverletzung vor einem Parteibüro
summary: A 19-year-old woman reported that a stone was thrown near a party office, narrowly missing her. The state security unit is investigating; nobody was hurt.

title: Streit eskaliert – rassistische Beleidigung und wechselseitige Körperverletzungen
summary: After an argument in Prenzlauer Berg, a 49-year-old woman allegedly insulted another woman on racist grounds and several people were involved in assaults. Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation, and one of the suspects allegedly drove into a man blocking her car.

title: Seniorin nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: A car hit an 81-year-old pedestrian pushing a shopping trolley in Wannsee on 4 April 2026. She was taken to hospital, later died there, and the cause of death is under investigation.

title: Autofahrerin fährt Kind auf Fahrrad an
summary: A car driver hit a four-year-old girl on a bicycle who had ridden onto the road from a footpath. The girl suffered leg abrasions and was taken to hospital for treatment.

title: Schussabgaben von Unbekannten
summary: Shots were fired on Kapaunenstraße in Rudow around 1:20 a.m., and police found cartridges and casings. Nobody was injured and no damage to buildings was found.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall
summary: A car collided with an E-scooter at a junction on Buckower Damm in Britz, killing a 14-year-old scooter rider and seriously injuring her 14-year-old passenger. The 42-year-old car driver was found to be under the influence of alcohol.

title: Tödliche Auseinandersetzung – Mordkommission und Staatsanwaltschaft ermitteln
summary: A 25-year-old company manager was fatally stabbed during an argument at company premises in Gesundbrunnen. Police and prosecutors have taken over the investigation, and two suspects were arrested nearby.

title: Mutmaßlicher Brandstifter festgenommen
summary: A 36-year-old man suspected of setting six fires, including two cars, a motorhome and bins, was arrested in Britz overnight. No one was injured.

title: Nach EC-Karten-Betrug - Festnahme
summary: Police were alerted to unauthorised use of a 25-year-old cardholder's credit card in Kreuzberg overnight. A 30-year-old suspect was arrested in a convenience store and cards were seized.

title: Mehrere Brandstiftungen in einer Schule
summary: Arson fires were set in a school building on Olbersstraße, including in a first-floor room and two toilets, the evening before publication. Earlier arson attempts in the school on 14 April were also reported; no one was hurt.

title: Alkoholisiert mit E-Scooter Unfall gebaut – Vater und Tochter verletzt
summary: A 38-year-old man riding an e-scooter with his nine-year-old daughter fell at a crossing in Staaken. The man, who had about 1.1 per mille alcohol, and the child were injured.

title: Nach Streit im Straßenverkehr – Radfahrer verletzt
summary: After a traffic dispute, a car driver allegedly drew a knife and injured a 35-year-old cyclist on the chin. The cyclist was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Feuer vor Supermarkt gelegt
summary: Three unknown persons set wooden chairs and two e-scooters on fire in front of a supermarket entrance in Spandau at night. When two teenagers confronted them, one of the suspects threatened an older boy with a knife and the group fled.

title: Steinwürfe auf U-Bahn
summary: Unknown persons threw two stones at the windows of a moving U-Bahn train, destroying both panes. Nobody was hurt.

title: Geraubte Wertgegenstände zum Kauf angeboten - Festnahme
summary: A 35-year-old suspect and an accomplice robbed a 46-year-old man at knifepoint on 9 April 2026 in a residential building. The suspect was arrested on 15 April after returning to offer to sell back the stolen items.

title: Schwerer Raub auf ein Pfandleihhaus – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Three men robbed a pawnshop on Karl-Marx-Straße and fled in a silver Audi with a foreign plate, which had been stolen earlier from a parking spot. Police are asking for witnesses.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach Fahrerflucht
summary: A driver fleeing a traffic check at high speed hit a pedestrian waiting at a red light on a traffic island and then left the scene. He was arrested shortly afterwards.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit mehreren beschädigten Fahrzeugen – Fahrer verletzt
summary: A 57-year-old driver veered off the road and hit four parked cars, then overturned; he was taken to hospital and a blood test was ordered over suspected alcohol use. His driving licence was seized.

title: Flucht endete mit Unfall
summary: A 22-year-old driver without a valid licence fled a traffic check at high speed, hit a pedestrian's side and crashed into a tree. A passenger was hospitalised, and the car was seized along with drugs and a replica gun.

title: Mann überfallen und verschleppt
summary: Masked attackers overpowered a 52-year-old man on the street, forced him into a van, and left him bound in a garden colony after taking cash and personal items. He freed himself after about two hours and was hospitalized with injuries.

title: Zwei Männer festgenommen und Falschgeld beschlagnahmt
summary: Two men were arrested in a car in Lichtenberg while allegedly handing over counterfeit money; the driver rammed a police vehicle and injured an officer's foot. Over 20,000 euros in counterfeit money was seized.

title: In der Straßenbahn sexuell belästigt – Helfer verletzt
summary: Three suspects sexually harassed a woman on a tram in Hellersdorf and then attacked a 36-year-old man and his companion who intervened. The 36-year-old was injured.

title: Angriff auf Fan-Bus
summary: Masked attackers hit a bus carrying ice hockey fans with flagpoles, fists and bottles, stole fan items and injured a passenger. Police stopped and checked 92 people, and investigations for aggravated riot are ongoing.

title: Fahrradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A car driver lost control on Hochstraße in Gesundbrunnen and struck a 54-year-old cyclist, dragging him about 30 meters. The cyclist was hospitalized, and police are seeking witnesses and video footage.

title: Brandstiftung in Friseursalon
summary: Unknown persons smashed the window of a hair salon in Lichtenrade and set a couch on fire with an unknown liquid. Firefighters extinguished the blaze and prevented it from spreading to a neighbouring hotel.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer nach Zusammenstoß verletzt
summary: During a cycling race on the Tempelhofer Feld, a 13-year-old e-scooter rider entered the track and collided with a 31-year-old cyclist, and both fell. Both were injured, the 13-year-old seriously enough to require inpatient treatment.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrer nach Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An e-scooter rider, 21, crashed head-on into a car on Puschkinallee early in the morning and was injured. Police found signs of alcohol, about 1.6 per mille, and took a blood sample.

title: Polizist mit Pfefferspray angegriffen
summary: A 15-year-old sprayed pepper spray into a police officer's face after officers tried to stop people suspected of S-Bahn surfing at Tegel station. The officer was hurt, treated in hospital as an outpatient and ended his shift.

title: Schüsse im Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: Residents reported apparent gunshots and an argument from a flat in an apartment building on Wollankstraße at dawn. Police found a blank-firing starter pistol and blank cartridges during a voluntary search; no one was hurt.

title: Nach Widerstand – DEIG eingesetzt
summary: After a domestic violence call, a 45-year-old man resisted officers in his flat and was subdued with a stun device (DEIG). Five officers were hurt, and the man was taken to hospital.

title: Mann mit Glasflasche angegriffen
summary: Early in the morning, a 31-year-old allegedly struck a 30-year-old man on the head with a glass bottle during an argument at a refugee shelter. The injured man was taken to hospital.

title: Mann ausgeraubt und Polizei angegriffen
summary: A 34-year-old man robbed a 76-year-old man at a bus stop in Altglienicke, choking him until he briefly lost consciousness. When plainclothes officers intervened, the suspect resisted arrest and injured an officer's hand.

title: Diebstahl und Beschädigung einer Staatsflagge
summary: A man's Israeli flag was taken and damaged at the Weltzeituhr on Alexanderplatz after a verbal dispute. The case is handled by the state security unit (Staatsschutz).

title: Schusswaffe abgefeuert
summary: An unknown man fired a gun at least once on Mainzer Straße in Neukölln after stepping out of a car around 8 p.m. No injuries were reported.

title: Allgemeinverfügungen erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf
summary: Police issued a temporary general order banning carrying weapons and knives in a defined area around the Olympiastadion on 19 April 2026, 7:00 to 16:30, for the "S25 Berlin" running event.

title: Durchsuchungen wegen illegaler Autovermietungen – Vermögenswerte sichergestellt
summary: Around 80 officers searched 16 properties in Berlin and Brandenburg over alleged insurance premium fraud linked to illegal car rentals. Six suspects aged 33 to 46 are investigated, with a damage of at least about 111,400 euros; jewellery and four luxury vehicles were seized.

title: Schüsse im Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: A witness heard several gunshots from an apartment in an apartment building in Friedenau and alerted police. Police searched the flat of a 30-year-old man, found several firearms and drugs, and he was released after identity checks.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: An 82-year-old pedestrian stepped onto Hohenzollerndamm and was struck by a car, suffering fractures and a head wound. The 58-year-old driver was unhurt; the traffic unit is investigating the exact sequence of events.

title: Zwei Verletzte nach körperlicher Auseinandersetzung
summary: After a dispute at a venue on Britzer Damm escalated, two men aged 20 were found injured in the street overnight. One suffered knife wounds to the thigh and the other head injuries from blunt force; both were taken to hospital.

title: Verkehrsunfallflucht – Radfahrerin verletzt im Krankenhaus
summary: A 65-year-old cyclist was injured after an unknown driver pulled out from a parking area and fled the scene. The cyclist fell while trying to avoid a collision and was taken to hospital.

title: Kind im Bus angegriffen und beleidigt – Öffentlichkeitsfahndung erfolgreich
summary: A man insulted and punched a 13-year-old boy on a bus of line M 21 in Berlin. Police identified the suspect after a public appeal.

title: Bundeskanzleramt beschmiert
summary: A 76-year-old man spray-painted red paint over about six square metres of the Federal Chancellery facade and held up a political banner. The case was taken over by the state security unit.

title: Mann mit Stichverletzungen aufgefunden
summary: A 31-year-old man was found on a pavement with several stab wounds in Neukölln in the early hours. He was taken to hospital and is not in life-threatening danger.

title: Verdacht der Körperverletzung und Bedrohung - Polizeilicher Staatsschutz ermittelt
summary: A 61-year-old man allegedly threatened and injured a politician running an information stand in Steglitz, and was arrested and released after identity checks. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Mann nach Auseinandersetzung im Krankenhaus – Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: After a dispute at a bar in Alt-Moabit, a 25-year-old allegedly stabbed a 30-year-old man who had tried to mediate. The victim is in emergency surgery; the suspect was arrested and the homicide unit is investigating.

title: Mit Reizgas und Machete angegriffen
summary: Several unknown attackers injured three men in Neukölln using pepper spray and a machete, then fled. Two of the men suffered cut wounds and were taken to hospital.

title: Versuchter Geldautomateneinbruch
summary: Unknown suspects tried to break into an ATM inside a food store on Gutschmidtstraße in Britz at about 1:40 a.m. They fled without loot when an alarm went off.

title: Mann nach Auseinandersetzung im Krankenhaus
summary: After a bar brawl in Friedrichshain, a 49-year-old man suffered cut and stab wounds to his thigh. A 30-year-old suspect was arrested after discarding a knife while fleeing.

title: Beschädigung eines Oberlichtes
summary: Damage was found in the transom window of a shop on Namslaustraße, with a projectile found inside. An unknown man reportedly took the projectile and left a stone before fleeing.

title: Einschussloch im Fenster eines Imbisses
summary: A bullet hole was found in the serving window of a snack bar at Nollendorfplatz, and two cartridge casings were secured nearby. Nobody was injured.

title: Griff zur Dienstwaffe durch DEIG-Einsatz verhindert
summary: After a dispute and threat at a snack bar in Grünau, police arrested a 20-year-old man who attacked officers and tried to grab a service weapon. Two officers were injured and had to stop duty.

title: Nach DEIG-Einsatz festgenommen
summary: A 27-year-old man took two bottles of brandy from a petrol station shop in Lichtenrade without paying and left. He was arrested nearby after resisting police, who used the DEIG unit to end his resistance.

title: Rollerfahrerin nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 50-year-old woman riding a scooter crashed on Frankfurter Allee in Lichtenberg and died at the scene after colliding with a car. Traffic investigators are looking into the cause.

title: Politiker an Informationsstand angegriffen
summary: A man attacked a politician at a party information stand in Charlottenburg, striking him in the face before fleeing. The state security unit took over the investigation for bodily harm.

title: Wohnung ausgebrannt – 17 Menschen verletzt
summary: An apartment in a residential building in Pannierstraße burned out early in the morning, and residents were rescued by fire crews. Seventeen people were treated for smoke inhalation, and police are investigating suspected arson.

title: Unbekannte attackieren zwei Männer
summary: Two 32-year-old men were attacked and racially insulted after leaving a bar in Schöneberg by two unknown men, who kicked and punched at them. The State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Brand auf Diakoniegelände
summary: Several wheelie bins were set on fire at a waste area on a church-run social service site in Hakenfelde overnight. The fire spread to a nearby building and burned its canopy entirely.

title: Krankenhaus-Patientin nach Brand verstorben
summary: A fire broke out in a hospital bed at a clinic in Zehlendorf, and a 64-year-old patient later died of her burn injuries. The cause is under investigation by a fire unit of the state criminal office.

title: Mehrere Schusswaffen nach Bedrohung aufgefunden
summary: After a threat and assault in Charlottenburg, police found and seized several firearms and over 650 rounds of ammunition in a 20-year-old man's apartment in Friedenau. Some of the weapons are believed to come from a burglary.

title: Raubüberfall– Tatverdächtige festgenommen
summary: Two men attacked a 22-year-old walking home overnight, hitting him on the head with a beer bottle and demanding valuables. Two suspects, aged 17 and 20, were arrested nearby and the stolen items were recovered.

title: Schwerer Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 75-year-old woman lost control of her car on Potsdamer Chaussee and hit two parked vehicles, overturning her car. She was seriously injured in the head and taken to hospital.

title: Einbruch mit Auto
summary: An unknown man drove a car into the entrance door of a shop on Münzstraße early in the morning, then took goods and fled with the loot. Nobody was reported injured.

title: Auf Lokal geschossen
summary: Two masked men fired shots at the front window of a bar in Neukölln early in the morning while up to six people were inside. No injuries have been reported so far.

title: Geschäftseinbruch mit Auto
summary: Overnight break-in at a shop in Schöneberg, where a door was forced open with a vehicle and a fireplace was stolen. Police patrol discovered the damage at around 3:15 a.m.

title: Mann festgenommen - Schusswaffe und Bargeld beschlagnahmt
summary: A 28-year-old man was arrested in Charlottenburg after police found a firearm, ammunition and a large amount of cash in his car. His car was seized and two addresses in Lichtenberg and Brandenburg were searched.

title: Schüsse vor Lokal – zwei Verletzte
summary: After an argument in a bar in Moabit, shots were fired outside and two men with gunshot wounds were taken to hospital. Both men were provisionally arrested, and the LKA's BAO Ferrum has taken over the investigation.

title: Mehrere Schüsse auf Lokal
summary: Several bullet holes were found in a bar on Buschkrugallee in Neukölln, and police secured several cartridge casings. Nobody was reported injured.

title: Festnahme nach mutmaßlichem Bandendiebstahl
summary: Two men were arrested while allegedly removing wheels from a parked Mercedes in Steglitz at night. Both were released after identification measures; investigations are ongoing.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit verletztem Autofahrer
summary: A garbage truck veered into the opposite lane and hit a stationary car that was turning on Schnellerstraße in Niederschöneweide. The car driver suffered an ankle fracture and was hospitalized.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit verletztem Fußgänger
summary: A van collided with a car at a crossing in Reinickendorf and was then driven into a pedestrian, who was pinned against a parked car and seriously injured. Three people were hurt in total.

title: Brand in Mehrfamilienhaus – Haus vorsorglich evakuiert
summary: A fire broke out in a top-floor flat of a residential building on Potsdamer Straße in Schöneberg after a loud bang was heard. The fire was extinguished, the wings of the building were evacuated, and nobody was injured.

title: Sprayer auf frischer Tat festgenommen
summary: Four men aged 22 to 30 were arrested after spraying walls in an underpass in Schöneberg during the night. Spray cans and mobile phones were seized, and the State Criminal Police Office took over the investigation.

title: Ausschreitungen bei einem Fußballspiel
summary: Football fans of BFC Dynamo lit pyrotechnics outside a stadium in Rummelsburg and attacked police with bottles, firecrackers and punches, with several injuries and criminal complaints including for Nazi salutes. Later, eleven people in a Weitlingstraße bar were reported chanting unconstitutional slogans.

title: Polizeibeamte bei Festnahme verletzt
summary: After a theft from a clothing container near Karow station, a 37-year-old man struck a police officer in the face and resisted arrest, injuring two officers. He was held briefly and released.

title: Kiosk überfallen
summary: Three men robbed a kiosk in Mehrower Allee, attacking the 44-year-old employee with blunt objects and a pointed object while demanding money. They took tobacco products and fled, and the employee was treated for injuries on scene.

title: Bedrohung mit Schusswaffe
summary: A 49-year-old man allegedly threatened a pizza delivery worker with a handgun in a residential building in Hellersdorf. A special forces unit later arrested him in his flat and seized a live firearm and ammunition.

title: Schussabgaben auf Lokal
summary: Several shots were fired from a car at the front windows of a bar in Hermannstraße while people were inside. Nobody was injured, and the car drove off toward Hermannplatz.

title: Bewaffneter Mann in Kreuzberg festgenommen
summary: Police arrested a 24-year-old man who allegedly drew and loaded a live firearm during a confrontation between two groups of men in Kreuzberg. The weapon, ammunition, a pepper spray, knives and suspected narcotics were seized.

title: Fahrer nach illegalem Kraftfahrzeugrennen geflüchtet
summary: A driver fled from a police traffic check at high speed, running red lights and ramming a police car, which was left undrivable. Two police officers were injured in the collision.

title: Senior bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car hit a 76-year-old pedestrian on Oranienstraße at about noon. The pedestrian was injured and taken to hospital; the driver was unhurt.

title: Mutmaßliche Wohnungseinbrecher festgenommen
summary: Two men were caught trying to force open an apartment door in a residential building in Lichtenberg and fled before entering. Police arrested both nearby, seized burglary tools and released them after identity checks.

title: Seniorin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 66-year-old pedestrian stepped onto the road and was hit by a car on Schönefelder Chaussee in Altglienicke, then trapped under a parked vehicle. She was taken to hospital and underwent emergency surgery.

title: Mitarbeiter bei Raubüberfall verletzt
summary: After losing money at a slot machine, a man threatened two kebab shop workers with a fork, took cash from the till and fled. During a struggle he stabbed one employee with a kebab knife, injuring him, and the other employee was hurt in a fall.

title: Allgemeinverfügungen erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Mitte
summary: Police issued temporary general orders in Mitte restricting assemblies and carrying weapons and knives around the Ritz Carlton, Schloss Bellevue and the Chancellery during a state visit, from 29 to 30 March 2026. The restrictions apply in fixed zones and at set times.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt – Schusswaffe, Geld und Drogen beschlagnahmt
summary: Police and prosecutors executed ten search warrants across Berlin against five suspects accused of trafficking cocaine via "cocaine taxis". A real pistol, about 50 kg of cannabis, 500 g of cocaine and around 100,000 euros in cash were seized, and one 24-year-old suspect was remanded in custody.

title: Toter Mann in Laube – kein Verdacht einer Straftat
summary: A 36-year-old man was found dead in a garden allotment hut in Oderstraße, initially treated as possible third-party involvement. The autopsy found the injuries consistent with a fall and no evidence of a crime, so no investigation was opened.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Polizei stoppt Lkw-Fahrer
summary: A truck driver allegedly sideswiped a 17-year-old e-scooter rider in Weißensee, causing her to fall. She was seriously injured and taken to hospital; police stopped the truck shortly afterwards.

title: Nach medizinischem Notfall reanimiert
summary: A 49-year-old man collapsed from a medical emergency in Biesdorf and was resuscitated by police until paramedics arrived. He regained consciousness and was taken to hospital.

title: Zwei Männer bei Auseinandersetzung verletzt
summary: Two men aged 39 and 46 were injured in a fight with a larger group in Volkspark Humboldthain, Gesundbrunnen, when attackers used a knife and pepper spray. The suspects fled toward Gesundbrunnen U-Bahn station.

title: Verdacht der Brandstiftung – drei Fahrzeuge beschädigt
summary: A vehicle caught fire in an underground car park on Iburger Ufer early in the morning, spreading to two more cars and parts of the building. No one was hurt; police are investigating suspected arson.

title: Mann und Frau nach Machetenangriff verletzt
summary: Two unknown men allegedly attacked a 19-year-old man and a 19-year-old woman with a machete after insulting them near a bar in Friedrichshain. The attackers allegedly shouted unconstitutional slogans while fleeing, and the Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Tramunfall - Kind verletzt
summary: An 11-year-old boy was hit and injured by a tram at a stop in Neu-Hohenschönhausen after tripping on the platform. The tram driver and a companion were treated for minor injuries.

title: Reifen in Brand gesetzt - zwei Autos beschädigt
summary: Unknown persons set several tyres on fire in Rigaer Straße at night, damaging two parked cars. Pyrotechnics were thrown at responding firefighters, who were not hurt; the State Security unit has taken over the case.

title: Geldautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators broke into a shopping centre in Biesdorf around 3:40 a.m. and blew up a cash machine using explosives. They fled without being caught.

title: Antisemitisch beleidigt und geschlagen
summary: A 37-year-old woman was arrested after allegedly insulting a 39-year-old man antisemitically and hitting him on the head in Prenzlauer Berg. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Durchsuchungen nach Brandanschlag im September 2025 auf Berliner Stromnetz
summary: Police searched about 10 flats and premises in Berlin, Hamburg, North Rhine-Westfalia and Brandenburg in connection with a September 2025 arson attack on electricity pylons that caused a large blackout. Four suspects aged 28 to 36 are investigated for constitutionally hostile sabotage.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Einsatzfahrzeug
summary: A police vehicle chasing a motorcyclist crashed into a wall in Kleinziethen (Brandenburg) after leaving the road. Both officers inside were injured and taken to hospital, and the motorcyclist escaped.

title: Blitzeinbruch mit Auto in Einkaufszentrum
summary: Three unknown suspects drove a car through the locked entrance of a retail store in a shopping centre in Steglitz, smashed display cases and stole jewellery and watches. They fled in another vehicle parked nearby.

title: Kind bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 35-year-old driver hit an 11-year-old cyclist crossing Alt-Moabit in the afternoon. The child suffered head injuries and was treated as an outpatient.

title: Mann in Wohnung gelockt, gefesselt und geschlagen
summary: A 26-year-old man was lured into an apartment in Gesundbrunnen, beaten, pepper-sprayed, tied up with tape and choked by two suspects. Police arrested both suspects, one of whom injured an officer with an iron bar.

title: Auto überrollt Frau
summary: A 54-year-old driver collided with a 61-year-old pedestrian in Wilmersdorf, then the unsecured car rolled over the injured woman and into a tree. The 61-year-old suffered broken bones and was taken to hospital.

title: Schläfer krankenhausreif getreten
summary: A 28-year-old man allegedly kicked two sleeping homeless men in the head and upper body overnight in Mitte. The older victim suffered serious facial injuries and the suspect was arrested and taken into custody.

title: Brandstifter festgenommen
summary: A 38-year-old man entered an apartment building and set fire to rubbish in the ground-floor hallway, according to police. Residents extinguished the flames and police arrested him nearby.

title: Hochwertige Armbanduhr brutal geraubt
summary: Two unknown men attacked a 69-year-old man in the ground floor of an apartment building, took his wristwatch and tried to steal his wallet. The victim was treated by paramedics at the scene for injuries to a hand and torso.

title: Von mehreren Männern angegriffen und niedergestochen worden
summary: A 28-year-old man was attacked by several men at Grünau S-Bahn station and stabbed in the back with a knife. He is not in life-threatening danger.

title: Mann mit Schussverletzungen – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: A 23-year-old man was found with gunshot wounds and a 22-year-old man with facial injuries in Brandenburgische Straße in Wilmersdorf. The homicide unit is seeking witnesses.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall lebensgefährlich verletzt
summary: A 60-year-old driver turning left collided with a 61-year-old pedestrian who crossed against a red light at Stendaler Straße. The pedestrian was seriously injured and remains in intensive care.

title: Mann leistet Widerstand – Distanzelektroimpulsgerät (DEIG) eingesetzt
summary: A 34-year-old man resisted police officers who were investigating an earlier assault; he struck one officer and another was injured during his arrest, which involved a taser. The suspect was taken to hospital.

title: Abi-Mottowochen lösen Polizeieinsätze aus
summary: Up to 1,000 young people gathered in parks in Pankow and Tempelhof-Schöneberg during graduation-themed events, leading to police clearances, bottle throwing and five temporary arrests. Police opened 15 criminal investigations and a few police vehicles were damaged.

title: Mann nach Überfall mit Stichverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: A 38-year-old man was attacked by several unknown people in Österreichpark in Charlottenburg around 1:30 a.m., using pepper spray and a pointed object. He suffered stab wounds to the legs and was taken to hospital; no property was taken.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse wegen des Verdachts des Handeltreibens mit Betäubungsmitteln vollstreckt
summary: Police and prosecutors searched six residences in Berlin and Brandenburg over suspected cocaine trafficking using rental cars as "cocaine taxis". One suspect was arrested, and a rifle, shotguns, pistols and cash were seized.

title: Farbschmiererei – Staatsschutz ermittelt
summary: A 21-year-old man was arrested in the early hours after spraying an antisemitic slogan on a clothing shop facade in Residenzstraße. The Staatsschutz took over the investigation.

title: Mann angegriffen und verletzt
summary: Two unknown men demanded a 21-year-old's belongings on a riverside path in Rudow and stabbed him in the leg during a scuffle before fleeing. He was taken to hospital with his injuries.

title: Mit Drogen im Auto geflüchtet - Unfall
summary: A 24-year-old fleeing police at high speed through red lights crashed into a wall and a traffic light at Invalidenstraße/Gartenstraße. His 22-year-old passenger was slightly injured; around 100 suspected drug units and cash were found.

title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenhändler festgenommen – umfangreiche Beweismittel beschlagnahmt
summary: Plainclothes officers stopped a car in Charlottenburg and arrested a 22-year-old suspected drug dealer. Several hundred pills, including pregabalin and diazepam, plus cash and US dollars were seized in the car and his apartment.

title: Auf dem Dach gelandet
summary: An 81-year-old woman lost control of her car, hit two parked vehicles and the car overturned onto its roof in Charlottenburg. She was rescued and taken to hospital.

title: Nationalfahnen angezündet und Flugblätter verteilt
summary: A woman burned two national flags, Germany's and Iran's, at Platz des 18. März and distributed leaflets containing Nazi symbols. The State Security unit is investigating.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Radfahrerin und Radfahrer verletzt
summary: Two cyclists collided on the Schöneberger Straße cycle lane when one overtook on the right as the other turned into a driveway. The 57-year-old female cyclist was seriously injured and taken to hospital, and the male cyclist (45) was lightly hurt.

title: Verkehrsunfall bei Einsatzfahrt
summary: Two police officers responding to an urgent call with blue lights and siren collided with a turning car in Hermsdorf. The two officers and the 83-year-old driver were injured.

title: Mit Schreckschusswaffe geschossen
summary: After an argument involving several people near a sports ground, an 18-year-old fired a blank-firing gun several times at two people who were fleeing. He was arrested at the scene and later released after identity checks.

title: Vermisste wieder da
summary: A 77-year-old woman with dementia who had been missing since 12 March 2026 has been found, after a public appeal led a hospital employee to recognise her. She is receiving medical treatment in hospital.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Beteiligung eines Einsatzwagens der Polizei
summary: A police patrol car with blue lights and siren collided with a VW turning left on Kaiser-Wilhelm-Straße in Lankwitz, damaging two parked cars. One police officer, the passenger, was injured in the arm.

title: Flucht vor der Polizei endet in Festnahme
summary: A 29-year-old woman fled a police traffic check at high speed in Neukölln, driving an unregistered car with stolen plates and without a licence. She was arrested after the car crashed on Rübelandstraße.

title: Mann nach Sturz mit Fahrrad im Krankenhaus
summary: A 61-year-old man fell from his bicycle on Kaiser-Wilhelm-Straße in Lankwitz and was seriously injured. He remains in intensive care, and a traffic unit is investigating the cause of the fall.

title: Fahrgäste mit einem Messer bedroht und erheblichen Widerstand geleistet
summary: A 50-year-old man allegedly boarded a tram with a knife, threatened passengers and damaged seats and windows before being overpowered by police. He was injured on one hand, taken to hospital and found to be under the influence of drugs.

title: Autofahrerin fährt gegen BVG-Wartehäuschen
summary: A 22-year-old woman drove her car off the road in Rahnsdorf and crashed into a bus shelter. She was taken to hospital with injuries.

title: Festnahmen nach räuberischem Diebstahl
summary: Two men were arrested after a suspect allegedly snatched 20 euros from a 41-year-old woman on a subway platform and then assaulted her and her companion. Both sides allegedly used weapons (a knife and an axe) during the confrontation.

title: Vermisster Mann tot geborgen
summary: A 31-year-old man reported missing in February 2026 was found dead in the Landwehrkanal. Police see no sign of a crime and an autopsy has been suggested.

title: Motorradfahrer fährt Seniorin an
summary: A motorcyclist hit an 85-year-old pedestrian who stepped into the road on Akazienstraße in Schöneberg. The pedestrian is in life-threatening condition and the motorcyclist was slightly injured.

title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenhändler mit scharfer Schusswaffe unterwegs – Haftbefehl erlassen
summary: Police observed a 28-year-old allegedly selling drugs at S-Bahnhof Tempelhof, then arrested him at S-Bahnhof Hermannstraße. He was carrying a real firearm, ammunition, drugs and a knife, and an arrest warrant was issued.

title: Festnahme und Haftbefehl nach zwei Wohnungseinbrüchen
summary: Police arrested a 31-year-old man suspected of two apartment burglaries after a witness alerted them; stolen goods were found in his backpack. A detention order was issued.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Polizeibeteiligung
summary: A police car with blue lights and siren collided with a motorcyclist at an intersection in Kreuzberg. The 23-year-old motorcyclist was treated at the scene and later went to a doctor himself.

title: Personengruppe greift Mann an
summary: A 23-year-old man was beaten with tools and objects by a group of about ten people after a dispute over money owed. Two suspects, aged 24 and 27, were temporarily arrested nearby.

title: Mann mit Glasflasche verletzt
summary: After an argument on a green space at Osloer Straße underground station, a 50-year-old allegedly stabbed a 37-year-old in the neck with a broken glass bottle. The suspect fled but was arrested in a nearby apartment; the victim is not in danger of dying.

title: Mutmaßlich mit Messer in Schulter gestochen
summary: A 32-year-old man was stabbed in the shoulder with a suspected knife by an unknown attacker on Am Sandhaus in Buch on the evening before publication. He was taken to hospital; police say his life was never in danger.

title: Verkehrsunfall und Festnahme nach Flucht vor Verkehrskontrolle – zwei Polizisten verletzt
summary: A 15-year-old driver fled a traffic check at high speed, then braked sharply at Uhlandstraße/Steinplatz, causing a collision with a police car. Two officers were slightly injured and the driver was arrested; he was allegedly under the influence of drugs and had no valid licence.

title: Kind erleidet Stichverletzung
summary: During a dispute between children and a group of about 20 youths, a 13-year-old was stabbed in the buttock with a knife. The victim was taken to hospital and the attackers fled on foot and e-scooters.

title: Toter Mann nach Wohnungsbrand geborgen
summary: A fully burning flat on the sixth floor of an apartment block in Tegel was extinguished, and a man believed to be the 63-year-old occupant was found dead. Six other residents were taken to hospital with suspected smoke inhalation.

title: Zwei Männer nach Auseinandersetzung verletzt
summary: A group of 15 to 20 people attacked two men with baseball bats and knives in front of a supermarket on Sonnenallee. One man suffered a stab wound and the other cuts to the face; both were taken to hospital.

title: Bekämpfung der Arzneimittelkriminalität
summary: Police searched eight properties, including two pharmacies in Charlottenburg and Steglitz, over suspected illegal trade in prescription medicines. About 300 packs of medication and 249,910 euros in cash were seized.

title: Mit Messer verletzt
summary: Two men were injured in an attack by a group of up to 15 men armed with knives, batons and pepper spray in Hellersdorf. One man was stabbed in the arm and taken to hospital.

title: Aktionswoche zum Schutz von zu Fuß gehenden Seniorinnen und Senioren
summary: Police Berlin run a traffic accident prevention campaign week from 16 to 20 March 2026 to protect elderly pedestrians, with events at weekly markets across the city. The events offer reaction tests and safety tips for seniors.

title: Beleidigung mit politischem Hintergrund
summary: A 44-year-old woman allegedly insulted two security employees working for the BVG with xenophobic and antisemitic remarks at the entrance of the U-Bahn station Schlesisches Tor. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Körperverletzung nach Streit in Gaststätte – Wirt verletzt
summary: After a dispute over alcohol service at a bar in Oberschöneweide, a 63-year-old guest allegedly punched the 54-year-old landlord in the face, and the landlord later suffered a serious head injury. The landlord was taken to hospital; his life is not in danger.

title: Radfahrer und Motorradfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A cyclist crossing Sonnenallee collided with a motorcyclist in the evening, and both fell to the ground. The cyclist was taken to hospital and admitted; the motorcyclist had minor abrasions.

title: Jugendliche flüchten vor der Polizei und verursachen Verkehrsunfall
summary: Four teenagers fled from police in a car without a number plate, causing several traffic violations and a crash into a bush at Bocksfeldplatz. Three were arrested and one slightly injured.

title: Verletzte bei Wohnungsbrand
summary: A fire broke out in a residential building in Falkenhagener Feld overnight. One woman was seriously hurt after escaping onto a neighbouring balcony, two others were treated for smoke inhalation, and 48 residents were evacuated.

title: Zeugenaufruf zu einem Tötungsdelikt
summary: A 45-year-old man was found dead in the Havel at the Freybrücke in Spandau on the morning of 9 March 2026. Police are treating it as a homicide and have appealed for witnesses.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Tramfahrer und Autofahrer
summary: A car driver turning left failed to yield to a tram, causing a collision in Prenzlauer Berg. The 45-year-old car driver was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Körperverletzung nach Streit im Straßenverkehr
summary: After a traffic dispute, a cyclist allegedly punched and kicked a 44-year-old driver, who suffered bruises and cuts and was taken to hospital. The cyclist fled before police arrived.

title: Versuchte Sprengung eines Geldautomaten
summary: Unknown perpetrators tried to blow up a cash machine in Moabit in the early morning, damaging the machine. The State Criminal Police Office's specialist unit is investigating.

title: Balkonbrand in Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: A balcony caught fire in an apartment building in Kreuzberg in the afternoon. Residents and emergency services were alerted, the fire was extinguished, and nobody was hurt; arson investigators are handling the case.

title: Hauswand mit politischem Inhalt beschmiert
summary: A building wall in Thulestraße was smeared with paint, including a political slogan and symbols. The case is being investigated by a specialist unit of the state criminal police office (LKA).

title: Vor der Polizei geflüchtet, verunfallt und festgenommen
summary: A 25-year-old driver fled from police at high speed in Staaken, ran a red light and crashed into five parked cars. He was arrested but could not show a driving licence.

title: Radfahrer bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 76-year-old cyclist was injured in a collision with a 27-year-old cyclist at the Dieffenbachstraße/Graefestraße crossing in Kreuzberg. The older cyclist was taken to hospital with head injuries.

title: Bedrohung mit einer Schreckschusswaffe – SEK-Einsatz
summary: A 21-year-old allegedly threatened a 25-year-old doorman with a blank-firing gun at a nightclub entrance and fled. He was later arrested by a SWAT team at his home after barricading himself in.

title: Frau bei Messerangriff verletzt
summary: After a knife attack in an apartment in Alt-Marzahn, a 27-year-old woman with a stab wound to the lower body was taken to hospital. Police arrested her 21-year-old partner, and an investigation for dangerous bodily harm in a domestic violence context is ongoing.

title: Mann bei Streit mit Messer verletzt
summary: A 29-year-old man was stabbed several times in the leg with a knife during a dispute in Karl-Marx-Straße. He was taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Mehrere Festnahmen nach mutmaßlichem Drogenhandel
summary: Police arrested five men on suspicion of commercial drug dealing in Kreuzberg and searched two flats in Neukölln used as bases. Cocaine, ketamine, LSD, cash and a machete were seized.

title: Obdachlosen in Wohnung gelockt und ausgeraubt
summary: A 43-year-old homeless man was lured into an apartment building and robbed of his bank card and PIN under threat of a firearm. The suspect is a 19-year-old; police searches found no evidence.

title: Mann nach Streitigkeiten niedergestochen
summary: After a dispute at Alexanderplatz S-Bahn station, an unknown man stabbed a 25-year-old in the abdomen with a pointed object and fled. The victim needed emergency surgery but was never in mortal danger.

title: Polizistin angegriffen
summary: An off-duty police officer who confronted a man making a Hitler salute in public was pushed away and sprayed with white paint in the face by him. The Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Brandstiftung an einem Veranstaltungsgebäude
summary: Fire set at the technical installation of an event building on Revaler Straße early in the morning, with Nazi symbols sprayed on the wall and ventilation system. Nobody was hurt; the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Mann mit Fahrrad von Tram angefahren
summary: A 79-year-old man crossing Osloer Straße with a bicycle or on foot was hit by a tram. He suffered several fractures and internal injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Fanartikel geraubt
summary: Up to 30 people surrounded four teenagers and threatened them with violence to demand their backpacks, tearing one off a 14-year-old. The group fled, and police later stopped eleven men nearby, with the link still under investigation.

title: Radfahrer stürzt und verstirbt später im Krankenhaus
summary: A 67-year-old cyclist fell off his bicycle on a pavement without outside interference and died later in hospital. Police traffic investigators are looking into the cause of death.

title: Brand in Einfamilienhaus – Mann tot aufgefunden
summary: A fire broke out in a residential house in Wilhelmstadt, Spandau, and nearly destroyed the building. An 81-year-old bedridden resident was found dead in his room, and six other residents escaped unhurt.

title: Durchsuchungen wegen gewerbsmäßiger Hehlerei von Mehrwegpfandkisten
summary: Police searched four addresses in Tempelhof and Kreuzberg over suspected commercial receiving of stolen reusable deposit crates worth about 841,000 euros. Over 8,000 crates and about 950,000 euros in cash were seized.

title: Versuchter Autodiebstahl - Festnahme
summary: Three men attempted to steal a car in Zehlendorf using a radio-wave jammer to gain access, but fled without loot when disturbed. Police arrested the suspects shortly afterwards.

title: Nationalsozialistische und antisemitische Parolen entfernt
summary: Unknown persons sprayed several National Socialist and antisemitic slogans on a station name sign at U-Bahnhof Ullsteinstraße. Police removed the slogans after photographing them, and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Autofahrer angegriffen
summary: After a honking dispute at a traffic light in Rummelsburg, an unknown driver reportedly attacked another motorist with a knife, cutting his finger. The victim was treated as an outpatient.

title: Während der Flucht auf Einsatzkräfte geschossen
summary: After a chase with reported shots from a moving car, two men were arrested in a basement after one of them fired a handgun at pursuing officers, who were not hit. An officer was injured during the arrest.

title: Einbruch in Feuerwehrwache
summary: Unknown perpetrators broke into a fire station in Frohnau overnight and stole equipment and protective gear worth five figures in euros. The State Criminal Police Office has taken over the investigation.

title: Waffen und Sprengstoff beschlagnahmt
summary: Police seized an unlawfully possessed firearm and black powder during a weapons storage inspection and search of a 79-year-old man's flat and car. The investigation is led by the State Criminal Police Office.

title: Autofahrerin fährt Fußgänger an
summary: A 58-year-old woman driver reversed her car while pulling away from the curb on Brunsbütteler Damm and allegedly hit a 32-year-old pedestrian. The pedestrian was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Gedenkstätte mit antisemitischen Schriftzug beschmiert
summary: An antisemitic inscription was sprayed on the outer wall of a memorial site in Neukölln and reported via the online police station. The State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Vor der Polizei geflüchtet und festgenommen
summary: A 29-year-old driver fled a police traffic check at high speed in Niederschöneweide and was stopped at a construction site. Drugs and a knife were seized, and the driver was later released; investigations cover illegal racing and drug offences.

title: Mann nach Wohnungsbrand verstorben
summary: A fire broke out in an apartment in a multi-family building, and a 61-year-old man was found dead. The cause of the fire is still under investigation.

title: Jugendliche beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: A 16-year-old girl was insulted over her headscarf and attacked by an unknown man, who pulled the scarf so it choked her. The Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Bilanz zur Verkehrssicherheitslage 2025 in Berlin
summary: Berlin police and state authorities published the 2025 road safety statistics: 137,373 traffic accidents, 1,840 seriously injured and 37 killed. Compared with the previous year, serious injuries and fatalities both fell.

title: Schussabgaben im Volkspark Friedrichshain - Zeugenaufruf
summary: Shots were fired in Volkspark Friedrichshain overnight; a 50-year-old man was found with life-threatening gunshot wounds and taken to hospital. Police are investigating attempted manslaughter and appealing for witnesses.

title: Mehrere Polizisten bei Festnahme verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old man was arrested after insulting and violently resisting police in Wilhelmstadt, injuring several officers. His father and an acquaintance then tried to stop the measures with physical force, and police used pepper spray.

title: Umzäunung des Görlitzer Parks beschädigt
summary: Damage was found on the fence of Görlitzer Park overnight, and bicycle locks and adhesive had been placed on six gate locks around midnight during a demonstration. Police removed the locks so the gates could be closed.

title: Rettungskräfte mit Schusswaffe bedroht
summary: A man threatened paramedics with a blank-firing pistol (Schreckschusspistole) at an apartment after a domestic violence call; he was arrested and the weapon seized. A 17-year-old woman was taken to hospital for treatment.

title: Verdacht des Fahrens unter Einfluss von Lachgas – Fahrer gestoppt
summary: A 19-year-old driver suspected of driving under the influence of nitrous oxide and speeding was stopped in Hellersdorf after a witness alerted police. The driver resisted checks, was arrested, and his driving licence was seized.

title: Versuchter Einbruch in Sicherheitsfirma
summary: Several men attempted to break into a security company's building at night, damaging a fence and a fire door. They failed to overcome a further security system and fled toward Buchberger Straße.

title: Flucht vor der Polizei auf der Autobahn
summary: A driver fled from a plainclothes police patrol on the A100 motorway at high speed, driving on the hard shoulder and crashing into two cars before escaping. Nobody was injured.

title: Raubüberfall auf Hotel – Öffentlichkeitsfahndung erledigt
summary: A man armed with a knife robbed a hotel reception of cash in the early morning. The suspect has since been identified; investigations continue.

title: Festnahme nach versuchtem Autoeinbruch
summary: A 24-year-old man was arrested in Schöneberg after allegedly tampering with a parked car with a tool in an attempted car break-in. The investigation is ongoing.

title: E-Scooter-Fahrerin bei Unfall verletzt
summary: A car turning left into Flottenstraße hit a 16-year-old e-scooter rider on Roedernallee, who fell and was injured. She was taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Mann mit Stichverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: After an argument between two groups outside a bar, one man was stabbed several times in the torso and two others were punched in the face. The unknown attackers fled.

title: Bei Verkehrsunfall tödlich verletzt
summary: A 29-year-old driver died after his car left the road and hit a tree in Aroser Allee in the night. Two passengers aged 29 and 30 were seriously injured.

title: Sachbeschädigung an Zugangstor im Görlitzer Park
summary: A swing gate at the Görlitzer Park access point was found damaged, with its lower mounting bolt cut through with a tool. The police state security unit has taken over the investigation for property damage.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach mutmaßlichem Rennen
summary: A 19-year-old driver rear-ended a car on Alt-Friedrichsfelde after a suspected street race with an unidentified vehicle. Two women were slightly injured, and the driver's car and licence were seized.

title: Mutmaßlicher Raub
summary: Two 18-year-olds were approached in a park, and one had his cannabis taken by force; the other was chased, threatened, choked and robbed of his phone. The victim was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Mutmaßlicher Raub mit Messer
summary: A 20-year-old man was robbed of his backpack by three unknown men on Edenkobener Steg in Steglitz, and one of them cut him with a knife. The victim was treated as an outpatient and the investigation is ongoing.

title: Durchsuchungsbeschlüsse vollstreckt – mehrere Festnahmen
summary: Police and prosecutors executed nine search warrants in Märkisches Viertel over drug trafficking and a 2022 armed robbery, arresting six people. Several hundred grams of cocaine, about 2.5 kg of marijuana and cash were seized.

title: Sachbeschädigung an Wahlkreisbüro
summary: White paint was sprayed onto a bench in front of a constituency office in Wilmersdorf. The Staatsschutz unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Mutmaßliche Autodiebe festgenommen
summary: A car was stolen overnight in Bohnsdorf. Police found it in a car park on Adlergestell and arrested three occupants aged 17, 21 and 27.

title: Autofahrer durch Personengruppe angegriffen
summary: Several unknown people attacked an 18-year-old driver at the Mehringplatz/Friedrichstraße junction, smashing his car window, pulling him out and beating him with stones, fists and feet. He was taken to hospital with injuries to the head, arm and torso.

title: Festnahme nach mehreren Betrugsversuchen
summary: Two men aged 24 and 39 were arrested after allegedly attempting purchases with stolen bank cards in shops on Alboinstraße. The 39-year-old allegedly used a forged driving licence and the car had stolen number plates.

title: Schockanrufe in russischer Sprache – hohe Schadenssummen in sehr kurzer Zeit
summary: Since January 2026, about 20 shock calls in Russian targeting elderly Berliners have caused roughly 400,000 euros in damage. In one case on 23 February, an 84-year-old in Spandau handed over money to a courier posing as a police officer's contact.

title: Van-Fahrer fährt Kind an
summary: A 64-year-old van driver turning into a driveway hit a 10-year-old boy on the pavement, who was run over by the van. The boy suffered head injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Frau nach Angriff verletzt
summary: A 25-year-old man struck a 41-year-old woman in the face outside a shop in Müllerstraße, Wedding, and fled. He was arrested at Wedding U-Bahn station and the woman was taken to hospital.

title: Festnahme nach Einbruch
summary: Two men aged 40 and 58 were arrested after breaking into a detached house in Lankwitz; searches of their homes followed and both were remanded in custody. Investigators are checking whether they belong to a group linked to other break-ins since mid-2025.

title: Brand in Mehrfamilienhaus
summary: A fire broke out in a stairwell of an apartment building in Schildhornstraße in the evening, and the building was evacuated. Three people were treated for suspected smoke inhalation, and 25 residents were placed in emergency accommodation.

title: Kind von Autofahrer angefahren
summary: A car driver hit a four-year-old boy crossing the road with his father and drove on without stopping. The child was injured and taken to hospital; a 92-year-old man was later identified as the suspected driver.

title: Mit Stichverletzungen im Krankenhaus
summary: A 24-year-old woman was stabbed multiple times in Neukölln by her former partner, a 24-year-old man, and underwent emergency surgery. A second 24-year-old man with a leg stab wound was treated as an outpatient; police seized a bloodstained knife.

title: Frau bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A 65-year-old man lost control of his car while reversing after a medical emergency and ran over his 59-year-old wife, who was behind the vehicle. She suffered multiple fractures and was taken to hospital.

title: Frau fremdenfeindlich beleidigt und angegriffen
summary: A 19-year-old woman was verbally abused with xenophobic insults and hit on a bus of line M48 in Steglitz. The Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Drei Autos nach Brandstiftung nicht mehr fahrbereit
summary: Three cars were set on fire overnight in Neu-Hohenschönhausen after a burning Renault in Zingster Straße spread to a neighbouring Audi and Mazda. All three vehicles were rendered undrivable; nobody was hurt, and an unknown man fled the scene.

title: Sicherheitsdienstmitarbeiter angegriffen und verletzt
summary: A 26-year-old resident allegedly attacked a security guard with a knife at a refugee accommodation in Buch after being refused a cigarette. The guard was injured and taken to hospital; he is not in danger of his life.

title: Zigarettenautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators blew up a cigarette vending machine in Hellersdorf overnight and took cigarette packs. Nobody was injured.

title: Kind angefahren und verletzt
summary: A 63-year-old driver struck a 13-year-old boy who ran onto the road in Baumschulenweg. The boy suffered head injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Nach Verkehrsunfall verstorben
summary: A 35-year-old driver died after his BMW skidded and hit a tree on Mariendorfer Damm late at night. The cause of the crash is still under investigation.

title: Jugendliche mit Messer angegriffen
summary: Two teenage girls attempted to extort valuables from two other girls at Rathaus Spandau subway station, then attacked one of them and threatened her with a knife, injuring her hand. The attackers fled without loot.

title: Politisch motivierte Sachbeschädigungen an einem Bürokomplex
summary: Overnight, windows were smashed and signs and a logo were smeared with red paint at an office building of an insurance company in Adlershof. Two flags were stolen, and the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Zwei Festnahmen nach Geschäftseinbruch
summary: Two teenagers, 17 and 15, broke into a shop on Wollankstraße at night and took the cash register; both were arrested nearby shortly after. Police found suspected burglary tools and pepper spray on the 17-year-old.

title: Mehrere Verletzte nach Verkehrsunfall mit BVG-Bus
summary: A car driver crossed into oncoming traffic on Gatower Straße in Gatow and collided with a BVG bus, which then hit a tree. One person was flown to hospital and 13 others were injured.

title: Queerfeindlicher Angriff
