summary: A 30-year-old woman was grabbed and repeatedly punched by an unknown man on Schlesische Straße in the early morning. She suffered facial injuries and needs inpatient hospital treatment; the State Security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Auto nach Verkehrsunfall überschlagen – Fahrerin im Krankenhaus
summary: A 40-year-old woman lost control of her car after a collision with a minibus at a junction and overturned several times, landing on a tram track. She was taken to hospital.

title: Spätkauf überfallen – Räuber mit Schusswaffe bewaffnet
summary: An unknown man threatened a convenience store employee with a firearm shortly before midnight and demanded money and tobacco products. He fled without taking the goods after the employee activated the shutters; the employee was unhurt.

title: Wohnungseinbrecher auf frischer Tat gefasst
summary: Three suspected burglars were caught in the act at a residential building after entering and trying to escape through a stairwell window with stolen goods and burglary tools. The suspects, aged 43, 47 and 49, were taken into custody.

title: Schüsse mit Schreckschusspistole abgegeben
summary: After an argument on a sidewalk, a 22-year-old fired several shots with a blank-firing gun past a 37-year-old, who was reported to have insulted and hit him. The 37-year-old reported ear pain and declined medical treatment; the 22-year-old was unhurt.

title: Jugendliche fremdenfeindlich beleidigt
summary: A 45-year-old man verbally abused a 16-year-old girl with xenophobic insults in Adalbertstraße in Kreuzberg. The case was taken over by the State Security unit (Staatsschutz).

title: Transmann angespuckt
summary: A 32-year-old trans man was stopped and spat at by an unknown man at Rosenthaler Platz while crossing a street. The Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation as a transphobic attack.

title: Angriff auf Besatzung eines Rettungswagens
summary: A 17-year-old patient attacked the crew of an ambulance transporting him to hospital, hitting and biting them. Two fire service paramedics were injured and had to end their shift.

title: Autofahrer fährt Fußgänger an
summary: A 35-year-old driver turned left and struck a 75-year-old pedestrian at a junction in Köpenick, who fell and suffered head injuries. The pedestrian is being treated in hospital.

title: Autofahrer flüchtete vor Überprüfung - Festnahme
summary: A 29-year-old driver fled a police check at high speed through several streets, endangering other road users and dragging an officer along the car door. He was arrested after being blocked, and drugs were seized from the vehicle.

title: Fußgängerin bei Verkehrsunfall verletzt
summary: A car driver hit a 58-year-old pedestrian crossing Nonnendammallee when the lights turned green. The pedestrian was injured in one arm and taken to hospital.

title: Raubüberfall – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: An unknown suspect pushed a 64-year-old woman away from her rollator and snatched the handbag attached to it. A witness chased the suspect and recovered the bag; police are seeking witnesses.

title: Ermittlungserfolg – Festnahmen und Schusswaffen beschlagnahmt
summary: Police with about 160 officers searched a bar and other premises and vehicles in Gesundbrunnen for illegal firearms. Five real firearms were seized and three people were arrested.

title: Überfall auf Hotel
summary: A masked man entered a hotel reception around 2 a.m., threatened a 21-year-old employee with a knife and demanded money, then fled with the cash. The employee was not injured.

title: Unfall beim Abbiegen
summary: A 31-year-old driver turning left collided with an oncoming car in Buckow on the evening before publication. Two people were injured and taken to hospital.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit zwei Verletzten
summary: A 58-year-old truck driver struck two women, aged 39, on a open area in Rahnsdorf; one was run over and taken to hospital for inpatient treatment. The second woman suffered an arm injury and received outpatient treatment.

title: Transphober Angriff
summary: A 22-year-old man allegedly attacked a 40-year-old trans woman at night, hitting her on the head with a phone and insulting her. The State Security unit is investigating the case as a possible hate crime.

title: Vermisster wieder da
summary: A 71-year-old man reported missing since 16 February 2026 has been found and is in hospital. The police had appealed for public help in the search.

title: Angriff auf ein Lokal – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Unknown persons attacked the bar "Fischladen" with hammers and took a banner before fleeing. The State Security unit is seeking witnesses.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit verletzter Radfahrerin
summary: A car and a cyclist collided at the junction of Hanns-Eisler-Straße and Michelangelostraße in Prenzlauer Berg. The 37-year-old cyclist suffered head injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Kind nach Unfall im Krankenhaus
summary: An 82-year-old driver allegedly ran a red light on Landsberger Allee and hit a 37-year-old pedestrian and a four-year-old child crossing the road. The 37-year-old was treated as an outpatient and the child was hospitalised with head injuries.

title: Mann mit Schussverletzung im Krankenhaus
summary: Shortly after 3 a.m., a masked man shot a 19-year-old in the leg in Herbertstraße and fled by car. The injured man went to a nearby fire station and was hospitalized.

title: Autofahrer stößt mit Tram zusammen
summary: A 78-year-old car driver turning left collided with a tram in Marzahn. The driver was seriously hurt and a passenger was slightly injured.

title: Toilette besprüht und Jugendlichen geschlagen
summary: A 19-year-old sprayed paint in a public toilet at a park in Karlshorst and then sprayed paint into a 17-year-old's face and punched him twice. The suspect was arrested and later released after a breath test showed about 1.6 per mille.

title: Tödlicher Verkehrsunfall
summary: A 39-year-old woman drove her car into a lorry trailer parked on Hellersdorfer Straße and later died in hospital. Her 13-year-old daughter was taken to hospital for observation.

title: Mutter und Kind nach Wohnungsbrand verstorben
summary: A fire in an apartment building in Friedrichsfelde killed a nine-month-old baby; the mother and a five-year-old brother later died of their injuries. Around 40 residents were treated at the scene.

title: Verkehrsunfall – Fußgängerin verletzt
summary: A 20-year-old driver hit a 15-year-old pedestrian crossing Falkenberger Chaussee in Neu-Höhenschonhausen on the evening before publication. The pedestrian suffered head and internal injuries and was taken to hospital.

title: Lebensbedrohliche Verletzungen nach Schüssen auf Mann im Fahrzeug
summary: An unknown gunman fired several shots at a 37-year-old man sitting in a vehicle in Tegel, seriously injuring him, and then fled. The 37-year-old is now out of mortal danger, and the homicide unit is searching for the shooter.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: A 79-year-old driver struck a six-year-old girl crossing Buckower Chaussee in Lichtenrade. The child was taken to hospital with lower-body injuries.

title: Autofahrer nach Flucht und Verkehrsunfall festgenommen
summary: A 23-year-old driver fled police from Neukölln, drove against oncoming traffic and crashed into three cars under the Tempelhofer Damm motorway bridge. Three drivers were injured and the suspect was arrested on foot.

title: Schüsse auf eine Wohnungstür
summary: Unknown persons fired several shots at the door of an apartment in a multi-family building on Grünauer Straße in Köpenick. No one was in the apartment and nobody was injured.

title: Autofahrerin fährt gegen Fußgänger
summary: A 35-year-old woman driving a Jeep hit a 60-year-old pedestrian while leaving a shopping centre car park onto Karl-Marx-Straße, and the car ran over him. The pedestrian suffered serious injuries but is not in danger of his life.

title: Versuchter schwerer Diebstahl aus Pkw
summary: Two men aged 31 and 32 were arrested after attempting to steal from a parked car in Neukölln. One allegedly searched a Peugeot while the other acted as lookout; a signal jammer was seized.

title: Drei Festnahmen nach Verdacht des Betäubungsmittelhandels
summary: Three men were arrested on suspicion of illegal drug trafficking after police checks and searches in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg. Cannabis, cocaine, MDMA, amphetamines and ecstasy were seized.

title: Festnahmen nach schwerer Brandstiftung
summary: Two suspects, a 45-year-old woman and her 39-year-old companion, were arrested after a serious arson in a 16th-floor flat on Frankfurter Allee. Both were injured and treated at the scene.

title: U-Bahnwagons beschmiert - Festnahmen
summary: Two 21-year-old men were arrested after allegedly spraying graffiti on two BVG subway cars at Spichernstraße station in the early hours. Spray cans and other evidence were seized.

title: Räuberischer Diebstahl in Einkaufscenter – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen
summary: A 26-year-old man took cash from a cash register drawer at a shopping centre and fled, grabbing away from the cashier who tried to hold him. He was arrested by off-duty police officers, who were slightly injured.

title: Gedenktafel zerstört
summary: Unknown perpetrators destroyed a memorial plaque at a Jewish cemetery in Mitte. The Staatsschutz has taken over the investigation.

title: Geldausgabeautomat gesprengt
summary: Unknown perpetrators broke into a supermarket in Weißensee at about 2:50 a.m. and blew up the cash machine inside before fleeing with the cash. No one was injured, but the store entrance and sales area were heavily damaged.

title: Nach Verkehrsunfall reanimiert
summary: A 49-year-old driver suffered a medical emergency while driving on Altstädter Ring, causing a crash in which he was resuscitated. His 40-year-old passenger was also injured.

title: Vermisster junger Mann wieder da
summary: A 25-year-old man reported missing on 2 February 2026 has been found and is receiving medical treatment. He had been believed to be in a psychological emergency.

title: Auf BVG-Bus geschossen
summary: Shots were fired at a BVG bus in Wilhelmstadt overnight, leaving a bullet hole in a side window. A witness sitting behind the window was not injured.

title: Schüsse auf Lokal
summary: Bullet holes were found in the door frame and transom of a bar in Wilmersdorf; the shots were reportedly fired at night and nobody was inside or hurt. The LKA specialist unit has taken over the investigation with BAO Ferrum.

title: Verdacht auf ein Tötungsdelikt in Grünanlage
summary: A 40-year-old woman was found dead in a green area in Alt-Hohenschönhausen, and a 46-year-old suspect was arrested at the scene. The homicide unit is investigating.

title: Mehrere Autos in Brand
summary: Early in the morning, three cars burned out in the Falkenhagener Feld area, and the fire spread to five other parked vehicles. Police arson investigators have taken over the case.

title: Schüsse auf Bürogebäude
summary: An unknown person fired several shots at an office in a workshop building on Boschweg in Neukölln. Bullet holes were found in an office door, and nobody was hurt.

title: U-Bahnhof mit Farbe beschmiert
summary: A 50-year-old man was detained after spray-painting a multicolored inscription on a wall in the Seestraße subway station. The State Security unit (Staatsschutz) has taken over the investigation.

title: Mutmaßlich politisches Tatmotiv - Personengruppe greift zwei Männer an
summary: Two men aged 20 and 22 were chased by a group of masked people to a subway station and beaten, with a bottle thrown and a knuckle-duster used. The State Security unit took over the investigation due to a suspected political motive.

title: Bilanz zu gestrigen Versammlungen im Stadtgebiet
summary: Police deployed about 800 officers at several political assemblies in Mitte, Gesundbrunnen, Wedding and Märkisches Viertel; 30 people were arrested and 22 criminal investigations opened. One police officer was hurt during a blockade at a party event on Eichhorster Weg.

title: Verkehrsunfall zwischen Radfahrer und Tram
summary: A 26-year-old cyclist ran a red light on Schönhauser Allee and collided with a tram. A 65-year-old woman inside the tram was injured in the emergency braking; the cyclist was found to have alcohol and suspected drug use.

title: Gefährliche Körperverletzung durch Stichverletzungen
summary: A 19-year-old man suffered several stab wounds after an altercation with a group of five masked youths at a bus stop in Sonnenallee and was operated on in hospital. The attackers fled toward the Köllnische Heide S-Bahn station.

title: Mann nach mehreren Straftaten und Flucht vor der Polizei festgenommen
summary: A 31-year-old man broke into an apartment, threatened the resident and stole from her, then stole a car, damaged a swimming hall and led police on a chase before his arrest. A police officer was slightly injured during the arrest.

title: Verkehrsunfall nach Flucht vor Polizeikontrolle
summary: After fleeing a police traffic check, a car driver at high speed collided with another vehicle on Salzufer and then damaged three parked cars. The two occupants fled on foot; the driver and passenger remain unidentified.

title: Verdacht des Arzneimittelhandels - Wohnungsdurchsuchung
summary: Police searched a flat in Hakenfelde on suspicion of medicine trafficking, finding further suspect substances and a loaded handgun that turned out to be a police service weapon stolen 15 years ago in a burglary. The 26-year-old suspect was taken into custody for identification treatment and then released.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit mehreren beschädigten Fahrzeugen
summary: A 23-year-old driver lost control of his rented Audi on Brunsbütteler Damm and crashed into parked cars, suspected drunk driving and illegal racing. Injuries included a head cut and a suspected pelvic fracture to his 22-year-old passenger.

title: Fußgänger von Autofahrerin angefahren
summary: A 57-year-old woman driving a car struck a 64-year-old pedestrian crossing Heerstraße in Staaken early in the morning. The pedestrian suffered fractures and a head laceration and was taken to hospital.

title: Tote Person nach Feuer in einem Bungalow entdeckt
summary: A fire broke out in a bungalow in Altglienicke used by presumably homeless people, and one person was found dead after firefighters extinguished the flames. The Landeskriminalamt fire investigation unit has taken over the ongoing investigation.

title: Nach Einbruch Flüssigkeit verschüttet
summary: Unknown perpetrators broke into an office of a research institute in Adlershof through a window and stole precious metals from a safe. They poured a liquid, possibly to destroy traces, before fleeing.

title: Polizisten bedroht – Distanzelektroimpulsgerät gegen Tatverdächtigen eingesetzt
summary: Police were called to a garden allotment hut after a man threatened officers from inside it. When he came out toward an officer, he was hit with a stun device, resisted arrest and was taken to hospital; a small quantity of suspected narcotics was seized.

title: Verdacht der Schussabgabe auf Lokal
summary: Suspected shot fired at a bar in Otto-Suhr-Allee in the early morning; the bullet pierced the outer wall and lodged in the interior ceiling. No one was present in the affected area and nobody was hurt.

title: Nicht angezeigte Versammlung im Zusammenhang mit einem Stammtisch einer Partei
summary: An unregistered assembly gathered around a political party's regulars' table in a pub in Wittenau. Two people who entered the pub were carried out by police and resisted; the Staatsschutz took over the investigation.

title: Geldautomatensprengung verhindert
summary: Unknown perpetrators attempted to blow up a cash machine in a shopping centre in Neu-Hohenschönhausen overnight. A security guard interrupted the attempt and the suspect fled; no explosion occurred.

title: Mann attackiert Frau in Wohnung
summary: A 50-year-old man attacked a 45-year-old woman in an apartment in Weißensee and inflicted multiple stab wounds. He was arrested at the scene; the woman is not in mortal danger.

title: Baucontainer und Mofa in Brand gesetzt
summary: An unknown person set fire to a moped and other items next to a construction container used as shelter by homeless people, and the fire spread to the container. No one was inside; the moped and container were heavily damaged.

title: Frau und Mann bei Raubüberfall verletzt
summary: Three masked men robbed a jewelry and watch shop in Rudow in the morning, pouring an unknown liquid over the owner and an employee and forcing them to open the safe and cash register. Both victims were injured and treated at a hospital as outpatients.

title: Mutmaßlicher Räuber durch Kopfhörer überführt
summary: An 18-year-old was punched and robbed of cash and headphones on Grimmstraße, then forced to withdraw more money from an cash machine. A second 18-year-old suspect was arrested nearby with the stolen items and drugs.

title: Brand in Wohnungslosenlager
summary: A fire broke out at a homeless encampment on Yorckstraße in Kreuzberg, burning mattresses, a tent and a bin and spreading to a church door. Arson is suspected and the police arson unit is investigating.

title: Auseinandersetzung mit Messern
summary: During a confrontation at night in Charlottenburg, two men from a group of four allegedly drew knives and one injured a 19-year-old's hand; the others allegedly struck him with a bottle and sprayed pepper spray. The group then fled.

title: Passant stellt mutmaßlichen Räuber - Festnahme
summary: A 20-year-old man pushed a 54-year-old shopkeeper during a meeting over a watch offered online and fled with it. A passer-by chased him, detained him until police arrived, and he was arrested; a pocket knife was found on him.

title: Stein- und Flaschenwürfe bei Versammlung – Polizist verletzt
summary: During a demonstration in Wedding, participants threw stones, bottles and wooden planks, and a police officer was hit on the head by a bottle. The Staatsschutz took over the investigation of the riot charges.

title: Vermisste Frau wohlbehalten angetroffen
summary: A 61-year-old woman who had been missing since 17 January 2026 has been found safe and is back in her care facility. The police had appealed for public help in the search.

title: Mit Schreckschusswaffe geschossen
summary: After an argument at the Warschauer Straße station forecourt, a 42-year-old man allegedly fired a blank-firing starter pistol toward a 27-year-old's head. The 27-year-old was hurt in the nose and head, and the suspect was held until police arrived.

title: Mann nach Schussabgaben tödlich verletzt – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A 44-year-old man was fatally shot in his van in Weißensee after unknown offenders fired from a passing car. The homicide squad is seeking witnesses.

title: Über die Fahrbahn gerannt - Autofahrer fährt zwei Kinder an
summary: A car driver hit two nine-year-old girls who ran onto the road against a red light at a crossing in Wilmersdorf. Both girls were hurt and taken to hospital.

title: Verkehrskontrolle entzogen – Fahrzeug beschlagnahmt
summary: A 43-year-old man without a driving licence ran a red light in Tempelhof and fled a police check at high speed, crashing into a traffic light pole and a police car. Two police officers were hurt and the car was seized.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: A driver turning right hit a six-year-old boy crossing the road with his mother in Charlottenburg. The boy was taken to hospital with a suspected broken leg.

title: 21-Jähriger stirbt in Wohnung - Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: A 21-year-old man was found dead with stab wounds in an apartment in Mahlsdorf. A 30-year-old suspect was arrested near the scene and the homicide unit is investigating.

title: Geschlagen und beschossen
summary: An unknown man punched a 25-year-old in the face and then allegedly shot him in the face with a blank-firing pistol in Reinickendorf. The attacker fled, and the victim was taken to hospital.

title: Autofahrer fährt Kind an
summary: A 52-year-old driver hit a seven-year-old girl who stepped into the road from behind a stopped bus in Karow. The child suffered head injuries and the driver was also taken to hospital.

title: Cannabisplantage und scharfe Schusswaffe festgestellt - Festnahme
summary: Police searched an apartment in Wilmersdorf after a citizen tip about hydrogen and found a cannabis plantation with over 30 plants, cannabis material and a loaded pistol with ammunition. The 26-year-old occupant was arrested.

title: Verkehrsunfall - Fahrradfahrer verletzt
summary: A 25-year-old cyclist turned illegally across several lanes of Heerstraße and collided with an oncoming van. The cyclist was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Jugendlicher verletzt und fremdenfeindlich beleidigt
summary: A 45-year-old man allegedly pushed a 14-year-old boy and insulted him with xenophobic remarks after a verbal dispute. An unknown pedestrian then allegedly punched the man in the face; the state security unit is investigating.

title: Schüsse auf Restaurant
summary: Unknown persons fired shots at the front windows of a restaurant overnight; bullet holes were discovered on Tuesday morning. Nobody was hurt.

title: Brand in Krankenhauszimmer
summary: A fire broke out in a hospital patient room at night, spreading to the mattress. The arson investigation was taken over by a fire investigation unit after political motives were ruled out.

title: Computerbetrug
summary: Police seek a suspect in a gang-related computer fraud in which a forged passport was used at a Berliner Volksbank branch to obtain online banking access to a business account, followed by large unauthorized transfers. The incident date is 14 July 2025.

title: Zwei Autofahrerinnen und ein Beifahrer nach Verkehrsunfall im Krankenhaus
summary: A collision at an unlit intersection in Alt-Hohenschönhausen (traffic light out of order) sent two drivers and a passenger to hospital. The 65-year-old driver had no valid driving licence and is under investigation.

title: Volksverhetzung bei Gedenkveranstaltung
summary: A 59-year-old woman made antisemitic statements at a Holocaust memorial event in Westend and insulted a teenage participant. Police detained her at the scene and the State Security unit is investigating.

title: Autofahrer fährt Fußgängerin an
summary: A car driver hit a 43-year-old woman crossing Hohenzollerndamm in Wilmersdorf. She was seriously injured and taken to hospital.

title: Mann leistet Widerstand – DEIG eingesetzt
summary: A 37-year-old man was removed from a women's residence in Schöneberg after resisting arrest; police used a conducted energy device, and one officer was injured. The officer ended his shift because of the injury.

title: Frau mit Kind vermisst – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A 43-year-old woman and her seven-year-old son are missing after she collected him from a day-care centre on 26 January 2026; police believe she is in a psychological crisis. Police ask anyone who has seen them to come forward.

title: Zeuge hat sich gemeldet
summary: Two unknown men threatened a 28-year-old with a knife, beat him and kicked him to the ground on Baruther Straße, then stole his bag, cash, jewellery and phone. The police are still seeking a witness, who has since come forward.

title: Verkehrsunfälle mit Fahrradfahrerin und BVG-Bus
summary: A 63-year-old driver hit a cyclist at a crossing in Borsigwalde and then drove on without helping her, colliding shortly after with a waiting BVG bus. The cyclist and the driver were both injured and taken to hospital.

title: Schüsse in Wohnung – mehrere Verletzte
summary: After family disputes in an apartment, several shots were fired and four people were injured, including two with life-threatening wounds. Attempted manslaughter investigations were opened by the homicide unit.

title: Spätkauf mit Schusswaffe überfallen
summary: A masked unknown man robbed a convenience store at gunpoint on the evening of 24 January 2026 and fled with cash. The 42-year-old employee handed over the money and was not reported injured.

title: In den Gegenverkehr geraten – Verkehrsunfall mit mehreren Verletzten
summary: A 66-year-old driver lost control of his car and veered into oncoming traffic on Wupperstraße, colliding with a 51-year-old driver. Three people were injured, one seriously, and both vehicles were undrivable.

title: Angriff mit politischer Tatmotivation
summary: Four men insulted and punched a 29-year-old man in a supermarket queue after asking if he was Kurdish. He was injured and taken to hospital, and the State Security unit took over the investigation.

title: Beraubt und mit Messer verletzt - Notoperation
summary: Several unknown men robbed a 24-year-old man on a parking lot and stabbed him in the abdomen. The victim reached the bus station waiting hall, where bystanders gave first aid before he was taken to hospital and operated on.

title: Beifahrer im Krankenhaus verstorben
summary: A 16-year-old passenger injured in a hit-and-run crash into a parked truck has died in hospital; the driver fled and is being sought. Investigations are ongoing.

title: DEIG-Einsatz gegen akut eigengefährdete Frau
summary: Police used a conducted energy device (DEIG) against a 30-year-old woman who was threatening self-harm with a knife in Moabit. She was taken to hospital and the knife was secured.

title: Trickdiebstahl in Wohnung – Seniorin bestohlen
summary: Two unknown women posed as cleaning staff and visited an 87-year-old woman in her apartment, then left and took cash and a jewelry box while she was not looking. The case is being investigated by the LKA.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit verletzter Autofahrerin
summary: A car pulling out of a parking space collided with a Smart on Potsdamer Chaussee in Nikolassee, and the Smart overturned. The 41-year-old woman driver was injured and taken to hospital.

title: Mann mit Messer verletzt
summary: A 19-year-old man was stabbed in the abdomen and chest after refusing to hand over his belongings to two unknown men at a bus stop in Köpenick. He fled to his nearby flat and was taken to hospital, where he was operated on.

title: Jugendlicher nach Starkstromschlag im Gleisbett verstorben
summary: A 17-year-old died after an electric shock in the track bed at Deutsche Oper underground station while trying to retrieve an object. Police found no indication of third-party involvement.

title: Beschuldigter in Untersuchungshaft – Ermittlungen dauern an
summary: Two men posing as plainclothes police took cash from a car buyer during a planned car purchase, then fled and threatened a pursuer with a gun. A suspected fake officer, 42, was arrested and remains in pre-trial detention.

title: Durchsuchungen und Festnahmen nach Angriff und Schussabgaben auf 31-Jährigen
summary: Following up on a December 2025 shooting in Haselhorst, police and prosecutors searched 14 properties citywide and arrested suspects. Seven men aged 21 to 28 are suspected of attempted manslaughter over shots fired at a 31-year-old.

title: Fußgängerin von Auto angefahren
summary: A 37-year-old driver hit a 55-year-old pedestrian crossing Wiesenweg in Lankwitz while turning left. The pedestrian was taken to hospital with head injuries; the driver was unhurt.

title: Mitarbeiter eines Discounters überfallen
summary: Three men robbed a discount store employee after he locked up at about 22:30, forcing him to reopen the shop and hand over the takings. One of them hit the 37-year-old repeatedly on the head before the trio fled.

title: Mutmaßlicher Drogenhändler festgenommen
summary: Plainclothes officers arrested a 30-year-old suspected drug dealer in Moabit after he accelerated toward an officer during a traffic stop. Cocaine-containing containers, cash and the car were seized.

title: Senior vermisst – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: A 73-year-old man with dementia has been missing from Reinickendorf since 11 January 2026. Police are asking the public for information on his whereabouts.

title: Unbekannter nach gefährlicher Körperverletzung gesucht
summary: Police seek an unknown man who allegedly attacked two men aged 37 and 38 at Maaßenstraße corner Nollendorfplatz, punching and kicking them and hitting one with a sign stand. The appeal concerns grievous bodily harm.

title: Fußgänger angefahren und verletzt - Polizei sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen
summary: A car driven by an 18-year-old struck a 72-year-old pedestrian crossing Markstraße in Wedding early on New Year's Day. The pedestrian suffered life-threatening injuries, and police are seeking witnesses.

title: Raubüberfälle auf Tankstellen und Geschäfte – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe
summary: Series of eight armed robberies at petrol stations and shops in several Berlin districts between November 2025 and January 2026; police appeal for information. The first case listed is a robbery at a petrol station on 5 November 2025.

title: Mit Schreckschusswaffe verletzt und angefahren worden
summary: A 28-year-old man was injured after two unknown men fired a blank-firing pistol at him following a verbal dispute and a window was smashed. He was then struck by an unrelated car whose driver fled.

title: Mitarbeitende des BVG-Sicherheitspersonals angegriffen
summary: A group of seven men attacked four BVG security staff at Hermannplatz underground station after being asked to stop smoking on the platform. Two of the staff were injured and taken to hospital.

title: Fahrerflucht nach Fahrzeugkontrolle auf der A 100
summary: A driver fled a vehicle check on the A 100 motorway, dragging a police officer about ten metres and injuring his hand. The car was later found abandoned and seized on Sachsendamm.

title: Raub auf Spielcasino
summary: Two masked men attacked a casino employee with pepper spray and an axe at a casino on Roedernallee in the early hours. The 53-year-old was injured and taken to hospital; it is unclear whether anything was taken.

title: Schüsse auf Lokal
summary: Several shots were fired at a closed café in Schönleinstraße around 3 a.m. Nobody was injured, and bullet holes were found in the shop windows.

title: Mehrere Autos in Brand gesetzt
summary: Unknown people set three cars on fire on a residents' parking area, two of which burned out completely. Three further parked cars were damaged by the heat; nobody was hurt.

title: Sachbeschädigung mit homophoben Hintergrund
summary: An unknown person threw a paving stone through the glass door of an LGBTQ+ bar on Sachsendamm late at night, damaging the door. No one was hurt, and the State Security unit is investigating a possible homophobic motive.

title: Autofahrer fährt Fußgängerin an
summary: A car driver hit a 71-year-old pedestrian crossing the road in Marienfelde on the evening before, then drove off from the scene. The driver later turned himself in at a police station and faces investigation for hit-and-run.

title: Hitlergruß gezeigt und Bierflasche geworfen - Festnahme
summary: A man on a balcony allegedly gave a Hitler salute and made xenophobic remarks, then threw a beer bottle that hit a 17-year-old on the head. The Staatsschutz is investigating; the suspect was arrested and later released.

title: Brandstifter festgenommen
summary: Burning waste was found in front of a flat door on the 10th floor of a residential building, and was extinguished by two witnesses. A 25-year-old resident was arrested on suspicion of arson.

title: Autofahrer fährt E-Scooter-Fahrer an – 22-Jähriger im Krankenhaus
summary: A car driver turning left hit a 22-year-old e-scooter rider crossing Müllerstraße in the early hours. The rider was seriously injured and taken to hospital, and the driver was unhurt.

title: Fußgänger bei Verkehrsunfall mit Straßenbahn verletzt
summary: A tram struck a 63-year-old pedestrian in Greifswalder Straße at about 1:15 a.m., injuring his head. The 65-year-old tram driver was treated for shock.

title: Sicherheitsvorfall an der iranischen Botschaft
summary: Six people repeatedly gathered outside the Iranian embassy in Dahlem, and two of them climbed the fence, removed the Iranian flag and damaged the flagpole. Police detained the pair; the Staatsschutz is investigating.

title: Mann nach Wohnungsbrand verstorben
summary: A kitchen fire broke out in a fourth-floor flat in an apartment block in Fennpfuhl; the 44-year-old resident was found unresponsive and died in hospital. Police investigate on suspicion of negligent arson.

title: 73-Jährige tot geborgen
summary: A 73-year-old woman reported missing since 27 December 2025 from Lichterfelde was found dead in the Teltow Canal in Kleinmachnow. Brandenburg police are handling the death investigation and see no sign of third-party involvement so far.

title: Festnahmen wegen des Verdachts des illegalen Drogenhandels
summary: Police stopped a car on Herrmannstraße around 1 a.m. and seized over 240 bags of suspected cannabis; two men aged 17 and 19 were arrested. Forged vehicle registration documents were also seized during subsequent apartment searches.

title: Schlafende Wohnungslose attackiert
summary: Around midnight an unknown man attacked a 43-year-old woman sleeping on the ground, hitting and kicking her head and trying to take her sleeping bag. She fended him off and he fled before police arrived.

title: Rettungsring in die Havel geworfen, Widerstand geleistet und Einsatzkräfte beleidigt
summary: Three young men took a life buoy from the Havel bank at Schulenburgbrücke and threw it into the water. When police arrested them, the 18-year-old resisted, insulted officers and an officer was injured.

title: Passanten und Einsatzkräfte angegriffen
summary: A 36-year-old man who had reported a cash theft attacked a patrol crew and bystanders after police arrived. He resisted arrest and was taken into custody, with one injury to his face treated at a hospital.

title: Gestohlene Kopfhörer führten zu Drogen - Festnahme
summary: Police searched an apartment on Soldiner Straße after stolen headphones were traced there and found over one kilogram of suspected heroin and cash. A 31-year-old man was arrested and investigations into drug dealing continue.

title: Festnahme nach Verdacht des Betäubungsmittelhandels
summary: Police arrested a 37-year-old man suspected of drug trafficking after a traffic check in Halensee found drugs and a knife. A follow-up search of his home turned up more drugs and two blank-firing guns.

title: Großflächige Sachbeschädigungen mit kommunistischen Symbolen und Parolen
summary: Unknown persons covered building facades and a subway exit on Gudrunstraße and Frankfurter Allee with large communist slogans and symbols. The state security unit has taken over the investigation.

title: Festnahme nach Drogenhandel
summary: Plainclothes officers arrested three people suspected of drug dealing after a car was stopped at a crossing. Cocaine, a knife, a blank-firing pistol and dealing material were seized, and two officers were lightly injured.

title: Waffen in Bar gefunden
summary: Police inspection of a bar in Kreuzberg found several firearms and ammunition hidden in a pool table; two men aged 27 and 29 were arrested. The weapons and magazines were seized.

title: Mehrere Verletzte bei Auffahrunfall
summary: An 80-year-old driver rear-ended a car waiting at a red light in Oberschöneweide, causing a chain collision with three vehicles. Three people were taken to hospital and one man was unhurt.

title: Mieterin stirbt in brennender Wohnung
summary: A fire broke out in a second-floor flat on Greifswalder Straße in Prenzlauer Berg. Firefighters found an 88-year-old tenant dead in the kitchen; police are investigating suspected negligent arson.

title: Mutmaßliches Kokstaxi aufgespürt – zwei Festnahmen
summary: Plainclothes officers stopped a car in Uhlandstraße after smelling cannabis and found drug sale packages inside. Both occupants, aged 25 and 35, were arrested.

title: Mann verschanzte sich in Unterkunft - Festnahme
summary: A 51-year-old man barricaded himself in a shelter room on Heerstraße; a special forces unit with a police dog arrested him and found several Molotov cocktails. He was bitten by the dog and taken to hospital.

title: Alleinunfall mit verletzter Person
summary: A 57-year-old driver lost control of his car while overtaking on Wilhelm-Kabus-Straße, hitting a tree and a metal fence. The driver was injured and taken to hospital for inpatient treatment.

title: Versuchtes Tötungsdelikt – 5. Mordkommission ermittelt
summary: A 47-year-old man was found bound and injured in Görlitzer Park and left in the cold. He was taken to hospital, and a homicide unit has taken over the attempted killing investigation.

title: Trickdiebstahl bei Seniorin
summary: Two unknown men posing as a criminal police officer and an electricity network employee entered a 91-year-old woman's flat, obtained her bank card and PIN, and later stole her card. Police are investigating.

title: Zaunelement entwendet
summary: Unknown perpetrators removed a fence panel of about 2.4 by 2.5 metres at the entrance of Görlitzer Park overnight. Police searched the area but did not find it.

title: Mann bei Straßenraub verletzt
summary: Four unknown assailants attacked a 27-year-old man at a street corner in Spandau, beating and cutting him with a knife and taking his backpack and cash. The victim was taken to hospital for outpatient treatment.

title: Einbruchsversuch - Festnahmen
summary: Police arrested four men after an attempted break-in at a cash machine during a power outage in Nikolassee. Burglary tools were found in their car.

title: Autofahrer fährt Fußgänger an
summary: A car driver swerved after another car pulled out and hit a pedestrian getting into a parked car in Wedding. The pedestrian suffered rib and pelvic fractures and needed emergency surgery; five parked cars were damaged.

title: Seniorin nach Wohnungsbrand verstorben
summary: A fire broke out in a second-floor apartment in Zehdenicker Straße. The 91-year-old resident was found dead and resuscitation attempts by emergency services were unsuccessful.

title: Starkstromkabel angezündet – Zeuginnen und Zeugen gesucht
summary: Unknown perpetrators set several high-voltage power cables on fire near the Teltowkanal in Lichterfelde, causing a large-scale power outage. The State Security unit is investigating and appealing for witnesses.

title: Räuberische Erpressung bei Essenszustellung
summary: Two unknown men lured a 24-year-old delivery worker to a street under the pretext of a food order, held a knife to his neck and forced him to hand over his belongings and cash. The victim was not injured.

title: Verkehrsunfall mit Polizeibeteiligung
summary: A police car responding to an emergency with lights and siren collided at a junction with a Mercedes in Biesdorf. Two occupants of the car and the two officers in the police vehicle were injured.

title: Schüsse auf Wohnungstür
summary: An unknown person fired several shots at an apartment door in a residential building in Neukölln on the evening of 2026-01-01. No one was hurt, and the motive is unknown.

title: Brand eines Obdachlosenlagers
summary: A fire broke out in a homeless encampment of tents under a bridge on Lewishamstraße, destroying nearly the entire camp. Three men were rescued and no one was injured; police found no sign of deliberate action.

title: Kältebus eines gemeinnützigen Vereins in Brand gesetzt
summary: A cold-weather aid bus belonging to a charitable organisation was set on fire in Moabit. Security staff held the suspected arsonist until police arrived and arrested a 43-year-old man.

title: Polizist bei Fahrzeugüberprüfung mitgeschleift – Fahrer flüchtet
summary: During a vehicle check in Seestraße, a driver started the car and dragged a police officer several meters before fleeing. The officer fell to the road and was injured.

title: Gesprengter Geldausgabeautomat
summary: An unattended cash machine on a pavement in Alt-Reinickendorf was badly damaged by an explosion in the early morning. Two suspects were seen tampering with it shortly before and fled towards Roedernallee.

title: Geldausgabeautomaten aufgebrochen
summary: Unknown perpetrators broke into a supermarket in Köpenick at around 1 a.m. and heavily damaged a cash machine inside, then fled with the loot. The Landeskriminalamt investigation is ongoing.

title: Bilanz der polizeilichen Maßnahmen zum Jahreswechsel 2025/2026
summary: Police report on New Year's Eve 2025/2026 operations across Berlin: 35 officers injured, about 430 people arrested, and around 800 investigations opened. Attacks on emergency crews with fireworks were widespread, and 47 vehicles were set on fire.
